title: Acts 7:49
text: The heaven [is] my throne and the earth the footstool of my feet: what house will ye build me? saith [the] Lord, or where [is the] place of my rest?

title: Acts 7:50
text: has not my hand made all these things?

title: Acts 7:51
text: ¶O stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, *ye* do always resist the Holy Spirit; as your fathers, *ye* also.

title: Acts 7:52
text: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain those who announced beforehand concerning the coming of the Just One, of whom *ye* have now become deliverers up and murderers!

title: Acts 7:53
text: who have received the law as ordained by [the] ministry of angels, and have not kept [it].

title: Acts 7:54
text: ¶And hearing these things they were cut to the heart, and gnashed their teeth against him.

title: Acts 7:55
text: But being full of [the] Holy Spirit, having fixed his eyes on heaven, he saw [the] glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God,

title: Acts 7:56
text: and said, Lo, I behold the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing at the right hand of God.

title: Acts 7:57
text: And they cried out with a loud voice, and held their ears, and rushed upon him with one accord;

title: Acts 7:58
text: and having cast [him] out of the city, they stoned [him]. And the witnesses laid aside their clothes at the feet of a young man called Saul.

title: Acts 7:59
text: And they stoned Stephen, praying, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

title: Acts 7:60
text: And kneeling down, he cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And having said this, he fell asleep.

title: Acts 8:1
text: ¶And Saul was consenting to his being killed. And on that day there arose a great persecution against the assembly which was in Jerusalem, and all were scattered into the countries of Judaea and Samaria except the apostles.

title: Acts 8:2
text: And pious men buried Stephen and made great lamentation over him.

title: Acts 8:3
text: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into the houses one after another, and dragging off both men and women delivered them up to prison.

title: Acts 8:4
text: ¶Those then that had been scattered went through [the countries] announcing the glad tidings of the word.

title: Acts 8:5
text: And Philip, going down to a city of Samaria, preached the Christ to them;

title: Acts 8:6
text: and the crowds with one accord gave heed to the things spoken by Philip, when they heard [him] and saw the signs which he wrought.

title: Acts 8:7
text: For from many who had unclean spirits they went out, crying with a loud voice; and many that were paralysed and lame were healed.

title: Acts 8:8
text: And there was great joy in that city.

title: Acts 8:9
text: But a certain man, by name Simon, had been before in the city, using magic arts, and astonishing the nation of Samaria, saying that himself was some great one.

title: Acts 8:10
text: To whom they had all given heed, from small to great, saying, This is the power of God which is called great.

title: Acts 8:11
text: And they gave heed to him, because that for a long time he had astonished them by his magic arts.

title: Acts 8:12
text: But when they believed Philip announcing the glad tidings concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptised, both men and women.

title: Acts 8:13
text: And Simon also himself believed; and, having been baptised, continued constantly with Philip; and, beholding the signs and great works of power which took place, was astonished.

title: Acts 8:14
text: ¶And the apostles who were in Jerusalem, having heard that Samaria had received the word of God, sent to them Peter and John;

title: Acts 8:15
text: who, having come down, prayed for them that they might receive [the] Holy Spirit;

title: Acts 8:16
text: for he was not yet fallen upon any of them, only they were baptised to the name of the Lord Jesus.

title: Acts 8:17
text: Then they laid their hands upon them, and they received [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 8:18
text: But Simon, having seen that by the laying on of the hands of the apostles the [Holy] Spirit was given, offered them money,

title: Acts 8:19
text: saying, Give to me also this power, in order that on whomsoever I may lay hands he may receive [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 8:20
text: And Peter said to him, Thy money go with thee to destruction, because thou hast thought that the gift of God can be obtained by money.

title: Acts 8:21
text: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter, for thy heart is not upright before God.

title: Acts 8:22
text: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and supplicate the Lord, if indeed the thought of thy heart may be forgiven thee;

title: Acts 8:23
text: for I see thee to be in the gall of bitterness, and bond of unrighteousness.

title: Acts 8:24
text: And Simon answering said, Supplicate *ye* for me to the Lord, so that nothing may come upon me of the things of which ye have spoken.

title: Acts 8:25
text: They therefore, having testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and announced the glad tidings to many villages of the Samaritans.

title: Acts 8:26
text: ¶But [the] angel of [the] Lord spoke to Philip, saying, Rise up and go southward on the way which goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza: the same is desert.

title: Acts 8:27
text: And he rose up and went. And lo, an Ethiopian, a eunuch, a man in power under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to worship at Jerusalem,

title: Acts 8:28
text: was returning and sitting in his chariot: and he was reading the prophet Esaias.

title: Acts 8:29
text: And the Spirit said to Philip, Approach and join this chariot.

title: Acts 8:30
text: And Philip, running up, heard him reading the prophet Esaias, and said, Dost thou then know what thou art reading of?

title: Acts 8:31
text: And he said, How should I then be able unless some one guide me? And he begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

title: Acts 8:32
text: And the passage of the scripture which he read was this: He was led as a sheep to slaughter, and as a lamb is dumb in presence of him that shears him, thus he opens not his mouth.

title: Acts 8:33
text: In his humiliation his judgment has been taken away, and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

title: Acts 8:34
text: And the eunuch answering Philip said, I pray thee, concerning whom does the prophet say this? of himself or of some other?

title: Acts 8:35
text: And Philip, opening his mouth and beginning from that scripture, announced the glad tidings of Jesus to him.

title: Acts 8:36
text: And as they went along the way, they came upon a certain water, and the eunuch says, Behold water; what hinders my being baptised?

title: Acts 8:38
text: And he commanded the chariot to stop. And they went down both to the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptised him.

title: Acts 8:39
text: But when they came up out of the water [the] Spirit of [the] Lord caught away Philip, and the eunuch saw him no longer, for he went on his way rejoicing.

title: Acts 8:40
text: And Philip was found at Azotus, and passing through he announced the glad tidings to all the cities till he came to Caesarea.

title: Acts 9:1
text: ¶But Saul, still breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, came to the high priest

title: Acts 9:2
text: and asked of him letters to Damascus, to the synagogues, so that if he found any who were of the way, both men and women, he might bring [them] bound to Jerusalem.

title: Acts 9:3
text: But as he was journeying, it came to pass that he drew near to Damascus; and suddenly there shone round about him a light out of heaven,

title: Acts 9:4
text: and falling on the earth he heard a voice saying to him, Saul, Saul, why dost thou persecute me?

title: Acts 9:5
text: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And he [said], *I* am Jesus, whom *thou* persecutest.

title: Acts 9:6
text: But rise up and enter into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

title: Acts 9:7
text: But the men who were travelling with him stood speechless, hearing the voice but beholding no one.

title: Acts 9:8
text: And Saul rose up from the earth, and his eyes being opened he saw no one. But leading [him] by the hand they brought him into Damascus.

title: Acts 9:9
text: And he was three days without seeing, and neither ate nor drank.

title: Acts 9:10
text: ¶And there was a certain disciple in Damascus by name Ananias. And the Lord said to him in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, [here am] I, Lord.

title: Acts 9:11
text: And the Lord [said] to him, Rise up and go into the street which is called Straight, and seek in the house of Judas one by name Saul, [he is] of Tarsus: for, behold, he is praying,

title: Acts 9:12
text: and has seen [in a vision] a man by name Ananias coming in and putting his hand on him, so that he should see.

title: Acts 9:13
text: And Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard from many concerning this man how much evil he has done to thy saints at Jerusalem;

title: Acts 9:14
text: and here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call upon thy name.

title: Acts 9:15
text: And the Lord said to him, Go, for this [man] is an elect vessel to me, to bear my name before both nations and kings and [the] sons of Israel:

title: Acts 9:16
text: for *I* will shew to him how much he must suffer for my name.

title: Acts 9:17
text: And Ananias went and entered into the house; and laying his hands upon him he said, Saul, brother, the Lord has sent me, Jesus that appeared to thee in the way in which thou camest, that thou mightest see, and be filled with [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 9:18
text: And straightway there fell from his eyes as it were scales, and he saw, and rising up was baptised;

title: Acts 9:19
text: and, having received food, got strength. And he was with the disciples who [were] in Damascus certain days.

title: Acts 9:20
text: And straightway in the synagogues he preached Jesus that *he* is the Son of God.

title: Acts 9:21
text: And all who heard were astonished and said, Is not this *he* who destroyed in Jerusalem those who called on this name, and here was come for this purpose, that he might bring them bound to the chief priests?

title: Acts 9:22
text: But Saul increased the more in power, and confounded the Jews who dwelt in Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

title: Acts 9:23
text: ¶Now when many days were fulfilled, the Jews consulted together to kill him.

title: Acts 9:24
text: But their plot became known to Saul. And they watched also the gates both day and night, that they might kill him;

title: Acts 9:25
text: but the disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

title: Acts 9:26
text: And having arrived at Jerusalem he essayed to join himself to the disciples, and all were afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

title: Acts 9:27
text: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and related to them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had spoken boldly in the name of Jesus.

title: Acts 9:28
text: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem,

title: Acts 9:29
text: and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord. And he spoke and discussed with the Hellenists; but they sought to kill him.

title: Acts 9:30
text: And the brethren knowing it, brought him down to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus.

title: Acts 9:31
text: The assemblies then throughout the whole of Judaea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, being edified and walking in the fear of the Lord, and were increased through the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 9:32
text: ¶Now it came to pass that Peter, passing through all [quarters], descended also to the saints who inhabited Lydda.

title: Acts 9:33
text: And he found there a certain man, Aeneas by name, who had been lying for eight years upon a couch, who was paralysed.

title: Acts 9:34
text: And Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus, the Christ, heals thee: rise up, and make thy couch for thyself. And straightway he rose up.

title: Acts 9:35
text: And all who inhabited Lydda and the Saron saw him, who turned to the Lord.

title: Acts 9:36
text: ¶And in Joppa there was a certain female disciple, by name Tabitha, which being interpreted means Dorcas. She was full of good works and alms-deeds which she did.

title: Acts 9:37
text: And it came to pass in those days that she grew sick and died; and, having washed her, they put her in [the] upper room.

title: Acts 9:38
text: But Lydda being near to Joppa, the disciples having heard that Peter was there, sent two men to him, beseeching him, Thou must not delay coming to us.

title: Acts 9:39
text: And Peter rising up went with them, whom, when arrived, they brought up into the upper chamber; and all the widows stood by him weeping and shewing him the body-coats and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

title: Acts 9:40
text: But Peter, putting them all out, and kneeling down, prayed. And, turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes, and, seeing Peter, sat up.

title: Acts 9:41
text: And having given her [his] hand, he raised her up, and having called the saints and the widows, presented her living.

title: Acts 9:42
text: And it became known throughout the whole of Joppa, and many believed on the Lord.

title: Acts 9:43
text: And it came to pass that he remained many days in Joppa with a certain Simon, a tanner.

title: Acts 10:1
text: ¶But a certain man in Caesarea, --by name Cornelius, a centurion of the band called Italic,

title: Acts 10:2
text: pious, and fearing God with all his house, [both] giving much alms to the people, and supplicating God continually,

title: Acts 10:3
text: --saw plainly in a vision, about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of God coming unto him, and saying to him, Cornelius.

title: Acts 10:4
text: But he, having fixed his eyes upon him, and become full of fear, said, What is it, Lord? And he said to him, Thy prayers and thine alms have gone up for a memorial before God.

title: Acts 10:5
text: And now send men to Joppa and fetch Simon, who is surnamed Peter.

title: Acts 10:6
text: He lodges with a certain Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the sea.

title: Acts 10:7
text: And when the angel who was speaking to him had departed, having called two of his household and a pious soldier of those who were constantly with him,

title: Acts 10:8
text: and related all things to them, he sent them to Joppa.

title: Acts 10:9
text: ¶And on the morrow, as these were journeying and drawing near to the city, Peter went up on the house to pray, about the sixth hour.

title: Acts 10:10
text: And he became hungry and desired to eat. But as they were making ready an ecstasy came upon him:

title: Acts 10:11
text: and he beholds the heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending, as a great sheet, [bound] by [the] four corners [and] let down to the earth;

title: Acts 10:12
text: in which were all the quadrupeds and creeping things of the earth, and the fowls of the heaven.

title: Acts 10:13
text: And there was a voice to him, Rise, Peter, slay and eat.

title: Acts 10:14
text: And Peter said, In no wise, Lord; for I have never eaten anything common or unclean.

title: Acts 10:15
text: And [there was] a voice again the second time to him, What God has cleansed, do not *thou* make common.

title: Acts 10:16
text: And this took place thrice, and the vessel was straightway taken up into heaven.

title: Acts 10:17
text: And as Peter doubted in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold also the men who were sent by Cornelius, having sought out the house of Simon, stood at the gate,

title: Acts 10:18
text: and having called [some one], they inquired if Simon who was surnamed Peter was lodged there.

title: Acts 10:19
text: ¶But as Peter continued pondering over the vision, the Spirit said to him, Behold, three men seek thee;

title: Acts 10:20
text: but rise up, go down, and go with them, nothing doubting, because *I* have sent them.

title: Acts 10:21
text: And Peter going down to the men said, Behold, *I* am he whom ye seek: what is the cause for which ye come?

title: Acts 10:22
text: And they said, Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man, and fearing God, and borne witness to by the whole nation of the Jews, has been divinely instructed by a holy angel to send for thee to his house, and hear words from thee.

title: Acts 10:23
text: Having therefore invited them in, he lodged them. And on the morrow, rising up he went away with them, and certain of the brethren from Joppa went with him.

title: Acts 10:24
text: And on the morrow they came to Caesarea. But Cornelius was looking for them, having called together his kinsmen and [his] intimate friends.

title: Acts 10:25
text: And when Peter was now coming in, Cornelius met him, and falling down did [him] homage.

title: Acts 10:26
text: But Peter made him rise, saying, Rise up: *I* myself also am a man.

title: Acts 10:27
text: And he went in, talking with him, and found many gathered together.

title: Acts 10:28
text: And he said to them, *Ye* know how it is unlawful for a Jew to be joined or come to one of a strange race, and to *me* God has shewn to call no man common or unclean.

title: Acts 10:29
text: Wherefore also, having been sent for, I came without saying anything against it. I inquire therefore for what reason ye have sent for me.

title: Acts 10:30
text: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I had been [fasting] unto this hour, and the ninth [I was] praying in my house, and lo, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

title: Acts 10:31
text: and said, Cornelius, thy prayer has been heard, and thy alms have come in remembrance before God.

title: Acts 10:32
text: Send therefore to Joppa and fetch Simon, who is surnamed Peter; he lodges in the house of Simon, a tanner, by the sea [who when he is come will speak to thee].

title: Acts 10:33
text: Immediately therefore I sent to thee, and *thou* hast well done in coming. Now therefore *we* are all present before God to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

title: Acts 10:34
text: ¶And Peter opening his mouth said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons,

title: Acts 10:35
text: but in every nation he that fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

title: Acts 10:36
text: The word which he sent to the sons of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ, (*he* is Lord of all things,)

title: Acts 10:37
text: *ye* know; the testimony which has spread through the whole of Judaea, beginning from Galilee after the baptism which John preached--

title: Acts 10:38
text: Jesus who [was] of Nazareth: how God anointed him with [the] Holy Spirit and with power; who went through [all quarters] doing good, and healing all that were under the power of the devil, because God was with him.

title: Acts 10:39
text: *We* also [are] witnesses of all things which he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also slew, having hanged him on a cross.

title: Acts 10:40
text: This [man] God raised up the third day and gave him to be openly seen,

title: Acts 10:41
text: not of all the people, but of witnesses who were chosen before of God, *us* who have eaten and drunk with him after he arose from among [the] dead.

title: Acts 10:42
text: And he commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify that *he* it is who was determinately appointed of God [to be] judge of living and dead.

title: Acts 10:43
text: To him all the prophets bear witness that every one that believes on him will receive through his name remission of sins.

title: Acts 10:44
text: ¶While Peter was yet speaking these words the Holy Spirit fell upon all those who were hearing the word.

title: Acts 10:45
text: And the faithful of the circumcision were astonished, as many as came with Peter, that upon the nations also the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out:

title: Acts 10:46
text: for they heard them speaking with tongues and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

title: Acts 10:47
text: Can any one forbid water that these should not be baptised, who have received the Holy Spirit as we also [did]?

title: Acts 10:48
text: And he commanded them to be baptised in the name of the Lord. Then they begged him to stay some days.

title: Acts 11:1
text: ¶And the apostles and the brethren who were in Judaea heard that the nations also had received the word of God;

title: Acts 11:2
text: and when Peter went up to Jerusalem, they of the circumcision contended with him,

title: Acts 11:3
text: saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised and hast eaten with them.

title: Acts 11:4
text: But Peter began and set forth [the matter] to them in order, saying,

title: Acts 11:5
text: I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in an ecstasy I saw a vision, a certain vessel descending like a great sheet, let down by four corners out of heaven, and it came even to me:

title: Acts 11:6
text: on which having fixed mine eyes, I considered, and saw the quadrupeds of the earth, and the wild beasts, and the creeping things, and the fowls of the heaven.

title: Acts 11:7
text: And I heard also a voice saying to me, Rise up, Peter, slay and eat.

title: Acts 11:8
text: And I said, In no wise, Lord, for common or unclean has never entered into my mouth.

title: Acts 11:9
text: And a voice answered the second time out of heaven, What God has cleansed, do not *thou* make common.

title: Acts 11:10
text: And this took place thrice, and again all was drawn up into heaven;

title: Acts 11:11
text: and lo, immediately three men were at the house in which I was, sent to me from Caesarea.

title: Acts 11:12
text: And the Spirit said to me to go with them, nothing doubting. And there went with me these six brethren also, and we entered into the house of the man,

title: Acts 11:13
text: and he related to us how he had seen the angel in his house, standing and saying [to him], Send [men] to Joppa and fetch Simon, who is surnamed Peter,

title: Acts 11:14
text: who shall speak words to thee whereby *thou* shalt be saved, thou and all thy house.

title: Acts 11:15
text: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them even as upon us also at the beginning.

title: Acts 11:16
text: And I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, John baptised with water, but *ye* shall be baptised with [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 11:17
text: If then God has given them the same gift as also to us when we had believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, who indeed was *I* to be able to forbid God?

title: Acts 11:18
text: And when they heard these things they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then indeed God has to the nations also granted repentance to life.

title: Acts 11:19
text: ¶They then who had been scattered abroad through the tribulation that took place on the occasion of Stephen, passed through [the country] to Phoenicia and Cyprus and Antioch, speaking the word to no one but to Jews alone.

title: Acts 11:20
text: But there were certain of them, Cyprians and Cyrenians, who entering into Antioch spoke to the Greeks also, announcing the glad tidings of the Lord Jesus.

title: Acts 11:21
text: And [the] Lord's hand was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

title: Acts 11:22
text: And the report concerning them reached the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem, and they sent out Barnabas to go through as far as Antioch:

title: Acts 11:23
text: who, having arrived and seeing the grace of God, rejoiced, and exhorted all with purpose of heart to abide with the Lord;

title: Acts 11:24
text: for he was a good man and full of [the] Holy Spirit and of faith; and a large crowd [of people] were added to the Lord.

title: Acts 11:25
text: And he went away to Tarsus to seek out Saul.

title: Acts 11:26
text: And having found [him], he brought him to Antioch. And so it was with them that for a whole year they were gathered together in the assembly and taught a large crowd: and the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

title: Acts 11:27
text: ¶Now in these days prophets went down from Jerusalem to Antioch;

title: Acts 11:28
text: and one from among them, by name Agabus, rose up and signified by the Spirit that there was going to be a great famine over all the inhabited earth, which also came to pass under Claudius.

title: Acts 11:29
text: And they determined, according as any one of the disciples was well off, each of them to send to the brethren who dwelt in Judaea, to minister [to them];

title: Acts 11:30
text: which also they did, sending it to the elders by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.

title: Acts 12:1
text: ¶At that time Herod the king laid his hands on some of those of the assembly to do them hurt,

title: Acts 12:2
text: and slew James, the brother of John, with the sword.

title: Acts 12:3
text: And seeing that it was pleasing to the Jews, he went on to take Peter also: (and they were the days of unleavened bread:)

title: Acts 12:4
text: whom having seized he put in prison, having delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep, purposing after the passover to bring him out to the people.

title: Acts 12:5
text: ¶Peter therefore was kept in the prison; but unceasing prayer was made by the assembly to God concerning him.

title: Acts 12:6
text: And when Herod was going to bring him forth, that night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and guards before the door kept the prison.

title: Acts 12:7
text: And lo, an angel of [the] Lord came there, and a light shone in the prison: and having smitten the side of Peter, he roused him up, saying, Rise up quickly. And his chains fell off his hands.

title: Acts 12:8
text: And the angel said to him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And he did so. And he says to him, Cast thine upper garment about thee and follow me.

title: Acts 12:9
text: And going forth he followed [him] and did not know that what was happening by means of the angel was real, but supposed he saw a vision.

title: Acts 12:10
text: And having passed through a first and second guard, they came to the iron gate which leads into the city, which opened to them of itself; and going forth they went down one street, and immediately the angel left him.

title: Acts 12:11
text: And Peter, being come to himself, said, Now I know certainly that [the] Lord has sent forth his angel and has taken me out of the hand of Herod and all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

title: Acts 12:12
text: And having become clearly conscious [in himself], he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was surnamed Mark, where were many gathered together and praying.

title: Acts 12:13
text: And when he had knocked at the door of the entry, a maid came to listen, by name Rhoda;

title: Acts 12:14
text: and having recognised the voice of Peter, through joy did not open the entry, but running in, reported that Peter was standing before the entry.

title: Acts 12:15
text: And they said to her, Thou art mad. But she maintained that it was so. And they said, It is his angel.

title: Acts 12:16
text: But Peter continued knocking: and having opened, they saw him and were astonished.

title: Acts 12:17
text: And having made a sign to them with his hand to be silent, he related [to them] how the Lord had brought him out of prison; and he said, Report these things to James and to the brethren. And he went out and went to another place.

title: Acts 12:18
text: And when it was day there was no small disturbance among the soldiers, what then was become of Peter.

title: Acts 12:19
text: And Herod having sought him and not found him, having examined the guards, commanded [them] to be executed. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea and stayed [there].

title: Acts 12:20
text: ¶And he was in bitter hostility with [the] Tyrians and Sidonians; but they came to him with one accord, and, having gained Blastus the king's chamberlain, sought peace, because their country was nourished by the king's.

title: Acts 12:21
text: And on a set day, clothed in royal apparel and sitting on the elevated seat [of honour], Herod made a public oration to them.

title: Acts 12:22
text: And the people cried out, A god's voice and not a man's.

title: Acts 12:23
text: And immediately an angel of [the] Lord smote him, because he did not give the glory to God, and he expired, eaten of worms.

title: Acts 12:24
text: But the word of God grew and spread itself.

title: Acts 12:25
text: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, having fulfilled the service [entrusted to them], taking also with them John, surnamed Mark.

title: Acts 13:1
text: ¶Now there were in Antioch, in the assembly which was [there], prophets and teachers: Barnabas, and Simeon who was called Niger, and Lucius the Cyrenian, and Manaen, foster-brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

title: Acts 13:2
text: And as they were ministering to the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, Separate me now Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.

title: Acts 13:3
text: Then, having fasted and prayed, and having laid [their] hands on them, they let [them] go.

title: Acts 13:4
text: ¶They therefore, having been sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia, and thence sailed away to Cyprus.

title: Acts 13:5
text: And being in Salamis, they announced the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. And they had John also as [their] attendant.

title: Acts 13:6
text: And having passed through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a certain man a magician, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus,

title: Acts 13:7
text: who was with the proconsul Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man. *He*, having called Barnabas and Saul to [him], desired to hear the word of God.

title: Acts 13:8
text: But Elymas the magician (for so his name is by interpretation) opposed them, seeking to turn away the proconsul from the faith.

title: Acts 13:9
text: But Saul, who also [is] Paul, filled with [the] Holy Spirit, fixing his eyes upon him,

title: Acts 13:10
text: said, O full of all deceit and all craft: son of [the] devil, enemy of all righteousness; wilt thou not cease perverting the right paths of [the] Lord?

title: Acts 13:11
text: And now behold, [the] Lord's hand [is] upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell upon him a mist and darkness; and going about he sought persons who should lead him by the hand.

title: Acts 13:12
text: Then the proconsul, seeing what had happened, believed, being amazed at the teaching of the Lord.

title: Acts 13:13
text: And having sailed from Paphos, Paul and his company came to Perga of Pamphylia; and John separated from them and returned to Jerusalem.

title: Acts 13:14
text: ¶But they, passing through from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia; and entering into the synagogue on the sabbath day they sat down.

title: Acts 13:15
text: And after the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, Brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation to the people, speak.

title: Acts 13:16
text: And Paul, rising up and making a sign with the hand, said, Israelites, and ye that fear God, hearken.

title: Acts 13:17
text: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people in their sojourn in [the] land of Egypt, and with a high arm brought them out of it,

title: Acts 13:18
text: and for a time of about forty years he nursed them in the desert.

title: Acts 13:19
text: And having destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land as an inheritance.

title: Acts 13:20
text: And after these things he gave [them] judges till Samuel the prophet, [to the end of] about four hundred and fifty years.

title: Acts 13:21
text: And then they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul, son of Kis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, during forty years.

title: Acts 13:22
text: And having removed him he raised up to them David for king, of whom also bearing witness he said, I have found David, the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who shall do all my will.

title: Acts 13:23
text: Of this man's seed according to promise has God brought to Israel a Saviour, Jesus;

title: Acts 13:24
text: John having proclaimed before the face of his entry [among the people] [the] baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

title: Acts 13:25
text: And as John was fulfilling his course he said, Whom do ye suppose that I am? *I* am not [he]. But behold, there comes one after me, the sandal of whose feet I am not worthy to loose.

title: Acts 13:26
text: Brethren, sons of Abraham's race, and those who among you fear God, to you has the word of this salvation been sent:

title: Acts 13:27
text: for those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, not having known him, have fulfilled also the voices of the prophets which are read on every sabbath, [by] judging [him].

title: Acts 13:28
text: And having found no cause of death [in him], they begged of Pilate that he might be slain.

title: Acts 13:29
text: And when they had fulfilled all things written concerning him, they took him down from the cross and put him in a sepulchre;

title: Acts 13:30
text: but God raised him from among [the] dead,

title: Acts 13:31
text: who appeared for many days to those who had come up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses to the people.

title: Acts 13:32
text: And *we* declare unto you the glad tidings of the promise made to the fathers,

title: Acts 13:33
text: that God has fulfilled this to us their children, having raised up Jesus; as it is also written in the second psalm, *Thou* art my Son: this day have *I* begotten thee.

title: Acts 13:34
text: But that he raised him from among [the] dead, no more to return to corruption, he spoke thus: I will give to you the faithful mercies of David.

title: Acts 13:35
text: Wherefore also he says in another, Thou wilt not suffer thy gracious one to see corruption.

title: Acts 13:36
text: For David indeed, having in his own generation ministered to the will of God, fell asleep, and was added to his fathers and saw corruption.

title: Acts 13:37
text: But he whom God raised up did not see corruption.

title: Acts 13:38
text: Be it known unto you, therefore, brethren, that through this man remission of sins is preached to you,

title: Acts 13:39
text: and from all things from which ye could not be justified in the law of Moses, in him every one that believes is justified.

title: Acts 13:40
text: See therefore that that which is spoken in the prophets do not come upon [you],

title: Acts 13:41
text: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder and perish; for *I* work a work in your days, a work which ye will in no wise believe if one declare it to you.

title: Acts 13:42
text: ¶And as they went out they begged that these words might be spoken to them the ensuing sabbath.

title: Acts 13:43
text: And the congregation of the synagogue having broken up, many of the Jews and of the worshipping proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

title: Acts 13:44
text: And on the coming sabbath almost all the city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

title: Acts 13:45
text: But the Jews, seeing the crowds, were filled with envy, and contradicted the things said by Paul, [contradicting and] speaking injuriously.

title: Acts 13:46
text: And Paul and Barnabas spoke boldly and said, It was necessary that the word of God should be first spoken to you; but, since ye thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, lo, we turn to the nations;

title: Acts 13:47
text: for thus has the Lord enjoined us: I have set thee for a light of the nations, that thou shouldest be for salvation to the end of the earth.

title: Acts 13:48
text: And [those of] the nations, hearing it, rejoiced, and glorified the word of the Lord, and believed, as many as were ordained to eternal life.

title: Acts 13:49
text: And the word of the Lord was carried through the whole country.

title: Acts 13:50
text: But the Jews excited the women of the upper classes who were worshippers, and the first people of the city, and raised a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and cast them out of their coasts.

title: Acts 13:51
text: But they, having shaken off the dust of their feet against them, came to Iconium.

title: Acts 13:52
text: And the disciples were filled with joy and [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 14:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in Iconium that they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake that a great multitude of both Jews and Greeks believed.

title: Acts 14:2
text: But the Jews who did not believe stirred up the minds of [those of] the nations and made [them] evil-affected against the brethren.

title: Acts 14:3
text: They stayed therefore a good while, speaking boldly, [confiding] in the Lord, who gave witness to the word of his grace, giving signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

title: Acts 14:4
text: And the multitude of the city was divided, and some were with the Jews and some with the apostles.

title: Acts 14:5
text: And when an assault was making, both of [those of] the nations and [the] Jews with their rulers, to use [them] ill and stone them,

title: Acts 14:6
text: they, being aware of it, fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra and Derbe, and the surrounding country,

title: Acts 14:7
text: and there they were announcing the glad tidings.

title: Acts 14:8
text: ¶And a certain man in Lystra, impotent in his feet, sat, [being] lame from his mother's womb, who had never walked.

title: Acts 14:9
text: This [man] heard Paul speaking, who, fixing his eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be healed,

title: Acts 14:10
text: said with a loud voice, Rise up straight upon thy feet: and he sprang up and walked.

title: Acts 14:11
text: But the crowds, who saw what Paul had done, lifted up their voices in Lycaonian, saying, The gods, having made themselves like men, are come down to us.

title: Acts 14:12
text: And they called Barnabas Jupiter, and Paul Mercury, because he took the lead in speaking.

title: Acts 14:13
text: And the priest of Jupiter who was before the city, having brought bulls and garlands to the gates, would have done sacrifice along with the crowds.

title: Acts 14:14
text: But the apostles Barnabas and Paul, having heard [it], rent their garments, and rushed out to the crowd, crying

title: Acts 14:15
text: and saying, Men, why do ye these things? *We* also are men of like passions with you, preaching to you to turn from these vanities to the living God, who made the heaven, and the earth, and the sea, and all things in them;

title: Acts 14:16
text: who in the past generations suffered all the nations to go in their own ways,

title: Acts 14:17
text: though indeed he did not leave himself without witness, doing good, and giving to you from heaven rain and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.

title: Acts 14:18
text: And saying these things, they with difficulty kept the crowds from sacrificing to them.

title: Acts 14:19
text: ¶But there came Jews from Antioch and Iconium, and having persuaded the crowds and stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing him to have died.

title: Acts 14:20
text: But while the disciples encircled him, he rose up and entered into the city. And on the morrow he went away with Barnabas to Derbe.

title: Acts 14:21
text: And having announced the glad tidings to that city, and having made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, and Iconium, and Antioch,

title: Acts 14:22
text: establishing the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to abide in the faith, and that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God.

title: Acts 14:23
text: And having chosen them elders in each assembly, having prayed with fastings, they committed them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.

title: Acts 14:24
text: And having passed through Pisidia they came to Pamphylia,

title: Acts 14:25
text: and having spoken the word in Perga, they came down to Attalia;

title: Acts 14:26
text: and thence they sailed away to Antioch, whence they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

title: Acts 14:27
text: And having arrived, and having brought together the assembly, they related to them all that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

title: Acts 14:28
text: And they stayed no little time with the disciples.

title: Acts 15:1
text: ¶And certain persons, having come down from Judaea, taught the brethren, If ye shall not have been circumcised according to the custom of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

title: Acts 15:2
text: A commotion therefore having taken place, and no small discussion on the part of Paul and Barnabas against them, they arranged that Paul and Barnabas, and certain others from amongst them, should go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

title: Acts 15:3
text: They therefore, having been set on their way by the assembly, passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, relating the conversion of [those of] the nations. And they caused great joy to all the brethren.

title: Acts 15:4
text: And being arrived at Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly, and the apostles, and the elders, and related all that God had wrought with them.

title: Acts 15:5
text: And some of those who were of the sect of the Pharisees, who believed, rose up from among [them], saying that they ought to circumcise them and enjoin them to keep the law of Moses.

title: Acts 15:6
text: ¶And the apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

title: Acts 15:7
text: And much discussion having taken place, Peter, standing up, said to them, Brethren, *ye* know that from the earliest days God amongst you chose that the nations by my mouth should hear the word of the glad tidings and believe.

title: Acts 15:8
text: And the heart-knowing God bore them witness, giving [them] the Holy Spirit as to us also,

title: Acts 15:9
text: and put no difference between us and them, having purified their hearts by faith.

title: Acts 15:10
text: Now therefore why tempt ye God, by putting a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we have been able to bear?

title: Acts 15:11
text: But we believe that we shall be saved by the grace of the Lord Jesus, in the same manner as they also.

title: Acts 15:12
text: And all the multitude kept silence and listened to Barnabas and Paul relating all the signs and wonders which God had wrought among the nations by them.

title: Acts 15:13
text: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Brethren, listen to me:

title: Acts 15:14
text: Simon has related how God first visited to take out of [the] nations a people for his name.

title: Acts 15:15
text: And with this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written:

title: Acts 15:16
text: After these things I will return, and will rebuild the tabernacle of David which is fallen, and will rebuild its ruins, and will set it up,

title: Acts 15:17
text: so that the residue of men may seek out the Lord, and all the nations on whom my name is invoked, saith [the] Lord, who does these things

title: Acts 15:18
text: known from eternity.

title: Acts 15:19
text: Wherefore *I* judge, not to trouble those who from the nations turn to God;

title: Acts 15:20
text: but to write to them to abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from what is strangled, and from blood.

title: Acts 15:21
text: For Moses, from generations of old, has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath.

title: Acts 15:22
text: ¶Then it seemed good to the apostles and to the elders, with the whole assembly, to send chosen men from among them with Paul and Barnabas to Antioch, Judas called Barsabas and Silas, leading men among the brethren,

title: Acts 15:23
text: having by their hand written [thus]: The apostles, and the elders, and the brethren, to the brethren who are from among [the] nations at Antioch, and [in] Syria and Cilicia, greeting:

title: Acts 15:24
text: Inasmuch as we have heard that some who went out from amongst us have troubled you by words, upsetting your souls, [saying that ye must be circumcised and keep the law]; to whom we gave no commandment;

title: Acts 15:25
text: it seemed good to us, having arrived at a common judgment, to send chosen men to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

title: Acts 15:26
text: men who have given up their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Acts 15:27
text: We have therefore sent Judas and Silas, who themselves also will tell you by word [of mouth] the same things.

title: Acts 15:28
text: For it has seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things:

title: Acts 15:29
text: to abstain from things sacrificed to idols, and from blood, and from what is strangled, and from fornication; keeping yourselves from which ye will do well. Farewell.

title: Acts 15:30
text: They therefore, being let go, came to Antioch, and having gathered the multitude delivered to [them] the epistle.

title: Acts 15:31
text: And having read it, they rejoiced at the consolation.

title: Acts 15:32
text: And Judas and Silas, being themselves also prophets, exhorted the brethren with much discourse, and strengthened them.

title: Acts 15:33
text: And having passed some time [there], they were let go in peace from the brethren to those who sent them.

title: Acts 15:35
text: And Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and announcing the glad tidings, with many others also, of the word of the Lord.

title: Acts 15:36
text: ¶But after certain days Paul said to Barnabas, Let us return now and visit the brethren in every city where we have announced the word of the Lord, [and see] how they are getting on.

title: Acts 15:37
text: And Barnabas proposed to take with [them] John also, called Mark;

title: Acts 15:38
text: but Paul thought it not well to take with them him who had abandoned them, [going back] from Pamphylia, and had not gone with them to the work.

title: Acts 15:39
text: There arose therefore very warm feeling, so that they separated from one another; and Barnabas taking Mark sailed away to Cyprus;

title: Acts 15:40
text: but Paul having chosen Silas went forth, committed by the brethren to the grace of God.

title: Acts 15:41
text: And he passed through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the assemblies.

title: Acts 16:1
text: ¶And he came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, by name Timotheus, son of a Jewish believing woman, but [the] father a Greek,

title: Acts 16:2
text: who had a [good] testimony of the brethren in Lystra and Iconium.

title: Acts 16:3
text: Him would Paul have go forth with him, and took [him and] circumcised him on account of the Jews who were in those places, for they all knew his father that he was a Greek.

title: Acts 16:4
text: And as they passed through the cities they instructed them to observe the decrees determined on by the apostles and elders who were in Jerusalem.

title: Acts 16:5
text: The assemblies therefore were confirmed in the faith, and increased in number every day.

title: Acts 16:6
text: ¶And having passed through Phrygia and the Galatian country, having been forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia,

title: Acts 16:7
text: having come down to Mysia, they attempted to go to Bithynia, and the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them;

title: Acts 16:8
text: and having passed by Mysia they descended to Troas.

title: Acts 16:9
text: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night: There was a certain Macedonian man, standing and beseeching him, and saying, Pass over into Macedonia and help us.

title: Acts 16:10
text: And when he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go forth to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to announce to them the glad tidings.

title: Acts 16:11
text: Having sailed therefore away from Troas, we went in a straight course to Samothracia, and on the morrow to Neapolis,

title: Acts 16:12
text: and thence to Philippi, which is [the] first city of that part of Macedonia, a colony. And we were staying in that city certain days.

title: Acts 16:13
text: And on the sabbath day we went outside the gate by the river, where it was the custom for prayer to be, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had assembled.

title: Acts 16:14
text: And a certain woman, by name Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, who worshipped God, heard; whose heart the Lord opened to attend to the things spoken by Paul.

title: Acts 16:15
text: And when she had been baptised and her house, she besought [us], saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and abide [there]. And she constrained us.

title: Acts 16:16
text: ¶And it came to pass as we were going to prayer that a certain female slave, having a spirit of Python, met us, who brought much profit to her masters by prophesying.

title: Acts 16:17
text: She, having followed Paul and us, cried saying, These men are bondmen of the Most High God, who announce to you [the] way of salvation.

title: Acts 16:18
text: And this she did many days. And Paul, being distressed, turned, and said to the spirit, I enjoin thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And it came out the same hour.

title: Acts 16:19
text: And her masters, seeing that the hope of their gains was gone, having seized Paul and Silas, dragged [them] into the market before the magistrates;

title: Acts 16:20
text: and having brought them up to the praetors, said, These men utterly trouble our city, being Jews,

title: Acts 16:21
text: and announce customs which it is not lawful for us to receive nor practise, being Romans.

title: Acts 16:22
text: And the crowd rose up too against them; and the praetors, having torn off their clothes, commanded to scourge [them].

title: Acts 16:23
text: And having laid many stripes upon them they cast [them] into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely;

title: Acts 16:24
text: who, having received such a charge, cast them into the inner prison, and secured their feet to the stocks.

title: Acts 16:25
text: ¶And at midnight Paul and Silas, in praying, were praising God with singing, and the prisoners listened to them.

title: Acts 16:26
text: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison shook, and all the doors were immediately opened, and the bonds of all loosed.

title: Acts 16:27
text: And the jailor being awakened out of his sleep, and seeing the doors of the prison opened, having drawn a sword was going to kill himself, thinking the prisoners had fled.

title: Acts 16:28
text: But Paul called out with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm, for we are all here.

title: Acts 16:29
text: And having asked for lights, he rushed in, and, trembling, fell down before Paul and Silas.

title: Acts 16:30
text: And leading them out said, Sirs, what must I do that I may be saved?

title: Acts 16:31
text: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus and thou shalt be saved, thou and thy house.

title: Acts 16:32
text: And they spoke to him the word of the Lord, with all that were in his house.

title: Acts 16:33
text: And he took them the same hour of the night and washed [them] from their stripes; and was baptised, he and all his straightway.

title: Acts 16:34
text: And having brought them into his house he laid the table [for them], and rejoiced with all his house, having believed in God.

title: Acts 16:35
text: ¶And when it was day, the praetors sent the lictors, saying, Let those men go.

title: Acts 16:36
text: And the jailor reported these words to Paul: The praetors have sent that ye may be let go. Now therefore go out and depart in peace.

title: Acts 16:37
text: But Paul said to them, Having beaten us publicly uncondemned, us who are Romans, they have cast us into prison, and now they thrust us out secretly? no, indeed, but let them come themselves and bring us out.

title: Acts 16:38
text: And the lictors reported these words to the praetors. And they were afraid when they heard they were Romans.

title: Acts 16:39
text: And they came and besought them, and having brought them out, asked them to go out of the city.

title: Acts 16:40
text: And having gone out of the prison, they came to Lydia; and having seen the brethren, they exhorted them and went away.

title: Acts 17:1
text: ¶And having journeyed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was the synagogue of the Jews.

title: Acts 17:2
text: And according to Paul's custom he went in among them, and on three sabbaths reasoned with them from the scriptures,

title: Acts 17:3
text: opening and laying down that the Christ must have suffered and risen up from among the dead, and that this is the Christ, Jesus whom *I* announce to you.

title: Acts 17:4
text: And some of them believed, and joined themselves to Paul and Silas, and of the Greeks who worshipped, a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

title: Acts 17:5
text: But the Jews having been stirred up to jealousy, and taken to [themselves] certain wicked men of the lowest rabble, and having got a crowd together, set the city in confusion; and having beset the house of Jason sought to bring them out to the people;

title: Acts 17:6
text: and not having found them, dragged Jason and certain brethren before the politarchs, crying out, These [men] that have set the world in tumult, are come here also,

title: Acts 17:7
text: whom Jason has received; and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying, that there is another king, Jesus.

title: Acts 17:8
text: And they troubled the crowd and the politarchs when they heard these things.

title: Acts 17:9
text: And having taken security of Jason and the rest, they let them go.

title: Acts 17:10
text: ¶But the brethren immediately sent away, in the night, Paul and Silas to Berea; who, being arrived, went away into the synagogue of the Jews.

title: Acts 17:11
text: And these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, receiving the word with all readiness of mind, daily searching the scriptures if these things were so.

title: Acts 17:12
text: Therefore many from among them believed, and of Grecian women of the upper classes and men not a few.

title: Acts 17:13
text: But when the Jews from Thessalonica knew that the word of God was announced in Berea also by Paul, they came there also, stirring up the crowds.

title: Acts 17:14
text: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as to the sea; but Silas and Timotheus abode there.

title: Acts 17:15
text: But they that conducted Paul brought him as far as Athens; and, having received a commandment to Silas and Timotheus, that they should come to him as quickly as possible, they departed.

title: Acts 17:16
text: ¶But in Athens, while Paul was waiting for them, his spirit was painfully excited in him seeing the city given up to idolatry.

title: Acts 17:17
text: He reasoned therefore in the synagogue with the Jews, and those who worshipped, and in the market-place every day with those he met with.

title: Acts 17:18
text: But some also of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers attacked him. And some said, What would this chatterer say? and some, He seems to be an announcer of foreign demons, because he announced the glad tidings of Jesus and the resurrection [to them].

title: Acts 17:19
text: And having taken hold on him they brought [him] to Areopagus, saying, Might we know what this new doctrine which is spoken by thee [is]?

title: Acts 17:20
text: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears. We wish therefore to know what these things may mean.

title: Acts 17:21
text: Now all [the] Athenians and the strangers sojourning there spent their time in nothing else than to tell and to hear the news.

title: Acts 17:22
text: ¶And Paul standing in the midst of Areopagus said, Athenians, in every way I see you given up to demon worship;

title: Acts 17:23
text: for, passing through and beholding your shrines, I found also an altar on which was inscribed, To the unknown God. Whom therefore ye reverence, not knowing [him], him I announce to you.

title: Acts 17:24
text: The God who has made the world and all things which are in it, *he*, being Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made with hands,

title: Acts 17:25
text: nor is served by men's hands as needing something, himself giving to all life and breath and all things;

title: Acts 17:26
text: and has made of one blood every nation of men to dwell upon the whole face of the earth, having determined ordained times and the boundaries of their dwelling,

title: Acts 17:27
text: that they may seek God; if indeed they might feel after him and find him, although he is not far from each one of us:

title: Acts 17:28
text: for in him we live and move and exist; as also some of the poets amongst you have said, For we are also his offspring.

title: Acts 17:29
text: Being therefore [the] offspring of God, we ought not to think that which is divine to be like gold or silver or stone, [the] graven form of man's art and imagination.

title: Acts 17:30
text: God therefore, having overlooked the times of ignorance, now enjoins men that they shall all everywhere repent,

title: Acts 17:31
text: because he has set a day in which he is going to judge the habitable earth in righteousness by [the] man whom he has appointed, giving the proof [of it] to all [in] having raised him from among [the] dead.

title: Acts 17:32
text: ¶And when they heard [of the] resurrection of the dead, some mocked, and some said, We will hear thee again also concerning this.

title: Acts 17:33
text: Thus Paul went out of their midst.

title: Acts 17:34
text: But some men joining themselves to him believed; among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman by name Damaris, and others with them.

title: Acts 18:1
text: ¶And after these things, having left Athens, he came to Corinth;

title: Acts 18:2
text: and finding a certain Jew by name Aquila, of Pontus by race, just come from Italy, and Priscilla his wife, (because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome,) came to them,

title: Acts 18:3
text: and because they were of the same trade abode with them, and wrought. For they were tent-makers by trade.

title: Acts 18:4
text: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

title: Acts 18:5
text: And when both Silas and Timotheus came down from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in respect of the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

title: Acts 18:6
text: But as they opposed and spoke injuriously, he shook his clothes, and said to them, Your blood be upon your own head: *I* [am] pure; from henceforth I will go to the nations.

title: Acts 18:7
text: ¶And departing thence he came to the house of a certain [man], by name Justus, who worshipped God, whose house adjoined the synagogue.

title: Acts 18:8
text: But Crispus the ruler of the synagogue believed in the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing, believed, and were baptised.

title: Acts 18:9
text: And the Lord said by vision in [the] night to Paul, Fear not, but speak and be not silent;

title: Acts 18:10
text: because *I* am with thee, and no one shall set upon thee to injure thee; because I have much people in this city.

title: Acts 18:11
text: And he remained [there] a year and six months, teaching among them the word of God.

title: Acts 18:12
text: ¶But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one consent rose against Paul and led him to the judgment-seat,

title: Acts 18:13
text: saying, This [man] persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.

title: Acts 18:14
text: But as Paul was going to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, If indeed it was some wrong or wicked criminality, O Jews, of reason I should have borne with you;

title: Acts 18:15
text: but if it be questions about words, and names, and the law that ye have, see to it yourselves; [for] *I* do not intend to be judge of these things.

title: Acts 18:16
text: And he drove them from the judgment-seat.

title: Acts 18:17
text: And having all laid hold on Sosthenes the ruler of the synagogue, they beat him before the judgment-seat. And Gallio troubled himself about none of these things.

title: Acts 18:18
text: ¶And Paul, having yet stayed [there] many days, took leave of the brethren and sailed thence to Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila, having shorn his head in Cenchrea, for he had a vow;

title: Acts 18:19
text: and he arrived at Ephesus, and left them there. But entering himself into the synagogue he reasoned with the Jews.

title: Acts 18:20
text: And when they asked him that he would remain for a longer time [with them] he did not accede,

title: Acts 18:21
text: but bade them farewell, saying, [I must by all means keep the coming feast at Jerusalem]; I will return to you again, if God will: and he sailed away from Ephesus.

title: Acts 18:22
text: And landing at Caesarea, and having gone up and saluted the assembly, he went down to Antioch.

title: Acts 18:23
text: And having stayed [there] some time, he went forth, passing in order through the country of Galatia and Phrygia, establishing all the disciples.

title: Acts 18:24
text: ¶But a certain Jew, Apollos by name, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, who was mighty in the scriptures, arrived at Ephesus.

title: Acts 18:25
text: He was instructed in the way of the Lord, and being fervent in his spirit, he spoke and taught exactly the things concerning Jesus, knowing only the baptism of John.

title: Acts 18:26
text: And *he* began to speak boldly in the synagogue. And Aquila and Priscilla, having heard him, took him to [them] and unfolded to him the way of God more exactly.

title: Acts 18:27
text: And when he purposed to go into Achaia, the brethren wrote to the disciples engaging them to receive him, who, being come, contributed much to those who believed through grace.

title: Acts 18:28
text: For he with great force convinced the Jews publicly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

title: Acts 19:1
text: ¶And it came to pass, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper districts, came to Ephesus, and finding certain disciples,

title: Acts 19:2
text: he said to them, Did ye receive [the] Holy Spirit when ye had believed? And they [said] to him, We did not even hear if [the] Holy Spirit was [come].

title: Acts 19:3
text: And he said, To what then were ye baptised? And they said, To the baptism of John.

title: Acts 19:4
text: And Paul said, John indeed baptised [with] the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe on him that was coming after him, that is, on Jesus.

title: Acts 19:5
text: And when they heard that, they were baptised to the name of the Lord Jesus.

title: Acts 19:6
text: And Paul having laid [his] hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke with tongues and prophesied.

title: Acts 19:7
text: And all the men were about twelve.

title: Acts 19:8
text: ¶And entering into the synagogue, he spoke boldly during three months, reasoning and persuading [the things] concerning the kingdom of God.

title: Acts 19:9
text: But when some were hardened and disbelieved, speaking evil of the way before the multitude, he left them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

title: Acts 19:10
text: And this took place for two years, so that all that inhabited Asia heard the word of the Lord, both Jews and Greeks.

title: Acts 19:11
text: And God wrought no ordinary miracles by the hands of Paul,

title: Acts 19:12
text: so that even napkins or aprons were brought from his body [and put] upon the sick, and the diseases left them, and the wicked spirits went out.

title: Acts 19:13
text: ¶And certain of the Jewish exorcists also, who went about, took in hand to call upon those who had wicked spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, I adjure you by Jesus, whom Paul preaches.

title: Acts 19:14
text: And there were certain [men], seven sons of Sceva, Jewish high priest, who were doing this.

title: Acts 19:15
text: But the wicked spirit answering said to them, Jesus I know, and Paul I am acquainted with; but *ye*, who are ye?

title: Acts 19:16
text: And the man in whom the wicked spirit was leaped upon them, and having mastered both, prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

title: Acts 19:17
text: And this became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who inhabited Ephesus, and fear fell upon all of them, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

title: Acts 19:18
text: And many of those that believed came confessing and declaring their deeds.

title: Acts 19:19
text: And many of those that practised curious arts brought their books [of charms] and burnt them before all. And they reckoned up the prices of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

title: Acts 19:20
text: Thus with might the word of the Lord increased and prevailed.

title: Acts 19:21
text: ¶And when these things were fulfilled, Paul purposed in his spirit to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia, saying, After I have been there I must see Rome also.

title: Acts 19:22
text: And having sent into Macedonia two of those ministering to him, Timotheus and Erastus, he remained himself awhile in Asia.

title: Acts 19:23
text: And there took place at that time no small disturbance about the way.

title: Acts 19:24
text: For a certain [man] by name Demetrius, a silver-beater, making silver temples of Artemis, brought no small gain to the artisans;

title: Acts 19:25
text: whom having brought together, and those who wrought in such things, he said, Men, ye know that our well-living arises from this work,

title: Acts 19:26
text: and ye see and hear that this Paul has persuaded and turned away a great crowd, not only of Ephesus, but almost of all Asia, saying that they are no gods which are made with hands.

title: Acts 19:27
text: Now not only there is danger for us that our business come into discredit, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis be counted for nothing, and that her greatness should be destroyed whom the whole of Asia and the world reveres.

title: Acts 19:28
text: And having heard [this], and being filled with rage, they cried out, saying, Great [is] Artemis of the Ephesians.

title: Acts 19:29
text: And the [whole] city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord to the theatre, having seized and carried off with [them] Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians, fellow-travellers of Paul.

title: Acts 19:30
text: But Paul intending to go in to the people, the disciples suffered him not;

title: Acts 19:31
text: and some of the Asiarchs also, who were his friends, sent to him and urged him not to throw himself into the theatre.

title: Acts 19:32
text: Different persons therefore cried out some different thing; for the assembly was tumultuous, and the most did not know for what cause they had come together.

title: Acts 19:33
text: But from among the crowd they put forward Alexander, the Jews pushing him forward. And Alexander, beckoning with his hand, would have made a defence to the people.

title: Acts 19:34
text: But, recognising that he was a Jew, there was one cry from all, shouting for about two hours, Great [is] Artemis of the Ephesians.

title: Acts 19:35
text: And the townclerk, having quieted the crowd, said, Ephesians, what man is there then who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is temple-keeper of Artemis the great, and of the [image] which fell down from heaven?

title: Acts 19:36
text: These things therefore being undeniable, it is necessary that ye should be calm and do nothing headlong.

title: Acts 19:37
text: For ye have brought these men, [who are] neither temple-plunderers, nor speak injuriously of your goddess.

title: Acts 19:38
text: If therefore Demetrius and the artisans who [are] with him have a matter against any one, the courts are being held, and there are proconsuls: let them accuse one another.

title: Acts 19:39
text: But if ye inquire anything concerning other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

title: Acts 19:40
text: For also we are in danger to be put in accusation for sedition for this [affair] of to-day, no cause existing in reference to which we shall be able to give a reason for this concourse.

title: Acts 19:41
text: And having said these things, he dismissed the assembly.

title: Acts 20:1
text: ¶But after the tumult had ceased, Paul having called the disciples to [him] and embraced [them], went away to go to Macedonia.

title: Acts 20:2
text: And having passed through those parts, and having exhorted them with much discourse, he came to Greece.

title: Acts 20:3
text: And having spent three months [there], a treacherous plot against him having been set on foot by the Jews, as he was going to sail to Syria, [the] resolution was adopted of returning through Macedonia.

title: Acts 20:4
text: And there accompanied him as far as Asia, Sopater [son] of Pyrrhus, a Berean; and of Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus, and Gaius and Timotheus of Derbe, and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

title: Acts 20:5
text: These going before waited for us in Troas;

title: Acts 20:6
text: but we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and we came to them to Troas in five days, where we spent seven days.

title: Acts 20:7
text: ¶And the first day of the week, we being assembled to break bread, Paul discoursed to them, about to depart on the morrow. And he prolonged the discourse till midnight.

title: Acts 20:8
text: And there were many lights in the upper room where we were assembled.

title: Acts 20:9
text: And a certain youth, by name Eutychus, sitting at the window-opening, overpowered by deep sleep, while Paul discoursed very much at length, having been overpowered by the sleep, fell from the third story down to the bottom, and was taken up dead.

title: Acts 20:10
text: But Paul descending fell upon him, and enfolding [him] [in his arms], said, Be not troubled, for his life is in him.

title: Acts 20:11
text: And having gone up, and having broken the bread, and eaten, and having long spoken until daybreak, so he went away.

title: Acts 20:12
text: And they brought [away] the boy alive, and were no little comforted.

title: Acts 20:13
text: ¶And we, having gone before on board ship, sailed off to Assos, going to take in Paul there; for so he had directed, he himself being about to go on foot.

title: Acts 20:14
text: And when he met with us at Assos, having taken him on board, we came to Mitylene;

title: Acts 20:15
text: and having sailed thence, on the morrow arrived opposite Chios, and the next day put in at Samos; and having stayed at Trogyllium, the next day we came to Miletus:

title: Acts 20:16
text: for Paul thought it desirable to sail by Ephesus, so that he might not be made to spend time in Asia; for he hastened, if it was possible for him, to be the day of Pentecost at Jerusalem.

title: Acts 20:17
text: ¶But from Miletus having sent to Ephesus, he called over [to him] the elders of the assembly.

title: Acts 20:18
text: And when they were come to him, he said to them, *Ye* know how I was with you all the time from the first day that I arrived in Asia,

title: Acts 20:19
text: serving the Lord with all lowliness, and tears, and temptations, which happened to me through the plots of the Jews;

title: Acts 20:20
text: how I held back nothing of what is profitable, so as not to announce [it] to you, and to teach you publicly and in every house,

title: Acts 20:21
text: testifying to both Jews and Greeks repentance towards God, and faith towards our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Acts 20:22
text: And now, behold, bound in my spirit *I* go to Jerusalem, not knowing what things shall happen to me in it;

title: Acts 20:23
text: only that the Holy Spirit testifies to me in every city, saying that bonds and tribulations await me.

title: Acts 20:24
text: But I make no account of [my] life [as] dear to myself, so that I finish my course, and the ministry which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the glad tidings of the grace of God.

title: Acts 20:25
text: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom [of God], shall see my face no more.

title: Acts 20:26
text: Wherefore I witness to you this day, that I am clean from the blood of all,

title: Acts 20:27
text: for I have not shrunk from announcing to you all the counsel of God.

title: Acts 20:28
text: Take heed therefore to yourselves, and to all the flock, wherein the Holy Spirit has set you as overseers, to shepherd the assembly of God, which he has purchased with the blood of his own.

title: Acts 20:29
text: [For] *I* know [this,] that there will come in amongst you after my departure grievous wolves, not sparing the flock;

title: Acts 20:30
text: and from among your own selves shall rise up men speaking perverted things to draw away the disciples after them.

title: Acts 20:31
text: Wherefore watch, remembering that for three years, night and day, I ceased not admonishing each one [of you] with tears.

title: Acts 20:32
text: And now I commit you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build [you] up and give [to you] an inheritance among all the sanctified.

title: Acts 20:33
text: I have coveted [the] silver or gold or clothing of no one.

title: Acts 20:34
text: Yourselves know that these hands have ministered to my wants, and to those who were with me.

title: Acts 20:35
text: I have shewed you all things, that thus labouring [we] ought to come in aid of the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

title: Acts 20:36
text: ¶And having said these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

title: Acts 20:37
text: And they all wept sore; and falling upon the neck of Paul they ardently kissed him,

title: Acts 20:38
text: specially pained by the word which he had said, that they would no more see his face. And they went down with him to the ship.

title: Acts 21:1
text: ¶And when, having got away from them, we at last sailed away, we came by a direct course to Cos, and on the morrow to Rhodes, and thence to Patara.

title: Acts 21:2
text: And having found a ship passing over into Phoenicia, we went on board and sailed;

title: Acts 21:3
text: and having sighted Cyprus, and left it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria, and made the land at Tyre, for there the ship was to discharge her cargo.

title: Acts 21:4
text: And having found out the disciples, we remained there seven days; who said to Paul by the Spirit not to go up to Jerusalem.

title: Acts 21:5
text: But when we had completed the days, we set out and took our journey, all of them accompanying us, with wives and children, till [we were] out of the city. And kneeling down upon the shore we prayed.

title: Acts 21:6
text: And having embraced one another, we went on board ship, and they returned home.

title: Acts 21:7
text: And we, having completed the voyage, arrived from Tyre at Ptolemais, and having saluted the brethren, we remained one day with them.

title: Acts 21:8
text: ¶And leaving on the morrow, we came to Caesarea; and entering into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was of the seven, we abode with him.

title: Acts 21:9
text: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

title: Acts 21:10
text: And as we stayed there many days, a certain man, by name Agabus, a prophet, came down from Judaea,

title: Acts 21:11
text: and coming to us and taking the girdle of Paul, and having bound his own hands and feet, said, Thus saith the Holy Spirit, The man whose this girdle is shall the Jews thus bind in Jerusalem, and deliver him up into the hands of [the] Gentiles.

title: Acts 21:12
text: And when we heard these things, both we and those of the place besought [him] not to go up to Jerusalem.

title: Acts 21:13
text: But Paul answered, What do ye, weeping and breaking my heart? for *I* am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

title: Acts 21:14
text: And when he would not be persuaded, we were silent, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

title: Acts 21:15
text: ¶And after these days, having got our effects ready, we went up to Jerusalem.

title: Acts 21:16
text: And [some] of the disciples from Caesarea went with us, bringing [with them] a certain Mnason, a Cyprian, an old disciple, with whom we were to lodge.

title: Acts 21:17
text: And when we arrived at Jerusalem the brethren gladly received us.

title: Acts 21:18
text: And on the morrow Paul went in with us to James, and all the elders came there.

title: Acts 21:19
text: And having saluted them, he related one by one the things which God had wrought among the nations by his ministry.

title: Acts 21:20
text: And they having heard [it] glorified God, and said to him, Thou seest, brother, how many myriads there are of the Jews who have believed, and all are zealous of the law.

title: Acts 21:21
text: And they have been informed concerning thee, that thou teachest all the Jews among the nations apostasy from Moses, saying that they should not circumcise their children, nor walk in the customs.

title: Acts 21:22
text: What is it then? a multitude must necessarily come together, for they will hear that thou art come.

title: Acts 21:23
text: This do therefore that we say to thee: We have four men who have a vow on them;

title: Acts 21:24
text: take these and be purified with them, and pay their expenses, that they may have their heads shaved; and all will know that [of those things] of which they have been informed about thee nothing is [true]; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, keeping the law.

title: Acts 21:25
text: But concerning [those of] the nations who have believed, we have written, deciding that they should [observe no such thing, only to] keep themselves both from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication.

title: Acts 21:26
text: Then Paul, taking the men, on the next day, having been purified, entered with them into the temple, signifying the time the days of the purification would be fulfilled, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

title: Acts 21:27
text: ¶And when the seven days were nearly completed, the Jews from Asia, having seen him in the temple, set all the crowd in a tumult, and laid hands upon him,

title: Acts 21:28
text: crying, Israelites, help! this is the man who teaches all everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place, and has brought Greeks too into the temple, and profaned this holy place.

title: Acts 21:29
text: For they had before seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.

title: Acts 21:30
text: And the whole city was moved, and there was a concourse of the people; and having laid hold on Paul they drew him out of the temple, and immediately the doors were shut.

title: Acts 21:31
