title: Romans 11:16
text: Now if the first-fruit [be] holy, the lump also; and if the root [be] holy, the branches also.

title: Romans 11:17
text: Now if some of the branches have been broken out, and *thou*, being a wild olive tree, hast been grafted in amongst them, and hast become a fellow-partaker of the root and of the fatness of the olive tree,

title: Romans 11:18
text: boast not against the branches; but if thou boast, [it is] not *thou* bearest the root, but the root thee.

title: Romans 11:19
text: Thou wilt say then, The branches have been broken out in order that *I* might be grafted in.

title: Romans 11:20
text: Right: they have been broken out through unbelief, and *thou* standest through faith. Be not high-minded, but fear:

title: Romans 11:21
text: if God indeed has not spared the natural branches; lest it might be he spare not thee either.

title: Romans 11:22
text: Behold then [the] goodness and severity of God: upon them who have fallen, severity; upon thee goodness of God, if thou shalt abide in goodness, since [otherwise] *thou* also wilt be cut away.

title: Romans 11:23
text: And *they* too, if they abide not in unbelief, shall be grafted in; for God is able again to graft them in.

title: Romans 11:24
text: For if *thou* hast been cut out of the olive tree wild by nature, and, contrary to nature, hast been grafted into the good olive tree, how much rather shall they, who are according to nature be grafted into their own olive tree?

title: Romans 11:25
text: For I do not wish you to be ignorant, brethren, of this mystery, that ye may not be wise in your own conceits, that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the nations be come in;

title: Romans 11:26
text: and so all Israel shall be saved. According as it is written, The deliverer shall come out of Zion; he shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

title: Romans 11:27
text: And this is the covenant from me to them, when I shall have taken away their sins.

title: Romans 11:28
text: As regards the glad tidings, [they are] enemies on your account; but as regards election, beloved on account of the fathers.

title: Romans 11:29
text: For the gifts and the calling of God [are] not subject to repentance.

title: Romans 11:30
text: For as indeed *ye* [also] once have not believed in God, but now have been objects of mercy through the unbelief of *these*;

title: Romans 11:31
text: so these also have now not believed in your mercy, in order that *they* also may be objects of mercy.

title: Romans 11:32
text: For God hath shut up together all in unbelief, in order that he might shew mercy to all.

title: Romans 11:33
text: ¶O depth of riches both of [the] wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable his judgments, and untraceable his ways!

title: Romans 11:34
text: For who has known [the] mind of [the] Lord, or who has been his counsellor?

title: Romans 11:35
text: or who has first given to him, and it shall be rendered to him?

title: Romans 11:36
text: For of him, and through him, and for him [are] all things: to him be glory for ever. Amen.

title: Romans 12:1
text: ¶I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the compassions of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, [which is] your intelligent service.

title: Romans 12:2
text: And be not conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of [your] mind, that ye may prove what [is] the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.

title: Romans 12:3
text: For I say, through the grace which has been given to me, to every one that is among you, not to have high thoughts above what he should think; but to think so as to be wise, as God has dealt to each a measure of faith.

title: Romans 12:4
text: For, as in one body we have many members, but all the members have not the same office;

title: Romans 12:5
text: thus we, [being] many, are one body in Christ, and each one members one of the other.

title: Romans 12:6
text: But having different gifts, according to the grace which has been given to us, whether [it be] prophecy, [let us prophesy] according to the proportion of faith;

title: Romans 12:7
text: or service, [let us occupy ourselves] in service; or he that teaches, in teaching;

title: Romans 12:8
text: or he that exhorts, in exhortation; he that gives, in simplicity; he that leads, with diligence; he that shews mercy, with cheerfulness.

title: Romans 12:9
text: Let love be unfeigned; abhorring evil; cleaving to good:

title: Romans 12:10
text: as to brotherly love, kindly affectioned towards one another: as to honour, each taking the lead in paying it to the other:

title: Romans 12:11
text: as to diligent zealousness, not slothful; in spirit fervent; serving the Lord.

title: Romans 12:12
text: As regards hope, rejoicing: as regards tribulation, enduring: as regards prayer, persevering:

title: Romans 12:13
text: distributing to the necessities of the saints; given to hospitality.

title: Romans 12:14
text: Bless them that persecute you; bless, and curse not.

title: Romans 12:15
text: Rejoice with those that rejoice, weep with those that weep.

title: Romans 12:16
text: Have the same respect one for another, not minding high things, but going along with the lowly: be not wise in your own eyes:

title: Romans 12:17
text: recompensing to no one evil for evil: providing things honest before all men:

title: Romans 12:18
text: if possible, as far as depends on you, living in peace with all men;

title: Romans 12:19
text: not avenging yourselves, beloved, but give place to wrath; for it is written, Vengeance [belongs] to me, *I* will recompense, saith the Lord.

title: Romans 12:20
text: If therefore thine enemy should hunger, feed him; if he should thirst, give him drink; for, so doing, thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head.

title: Romans 12:21
text: Be not overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

title: Romans 13:1
text: ¶Let every soul be subject to the authorities that are above [him]. For there is no authority except from God; and those that exist are set up by God.

title: Romans 13:2
text: So that he that sets himself in opposition to the authority resists the ordinance of God; and they who [thus] resist shall bring sentence of guilt on themselves.

title: Romans 13:3
text: For rulers are not a terror to a good work, but to an evil [one]. Dost thou desire then not to be afraid of the authority? practise [what is] good, and thou shalt have praise from it;

title: Romans 13:4
text: for it is God's minister to thee for good. But if thou practisest evil, fear; for it bears not the sword in vain; for it is God's minister, an avenger for wrath to him that does evil.

title: Romans 13:5
text: Wherefore it is necessary to be subject, not only on account of wrath, but also on account of conscience.

title: Romans 13:6
text: For on this account ye pay tribute also; for they are God's officers, attending continually on this very thing.

title: Romans 13:7
text: ¶Render to all their dues: to whom tribute [is due], tribute; to whom custom, custom; to whom fear, fear; to whom honour, honour.

title: Romans 13:8
text: Owe no one anything, unless to love one another: for he that loves another has fulfilled the law.

title: Romans 13:9
text: For, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not lust; and if there be any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

title: Romans 13:10
text: Love works no ill to its neighbour; love therefore [is the] whole law.

title: Romans 13:11
text: ¶This also, knowing the time, that it is already time that *we* should be aroused out of sleep; for now [is] our salvation nearer than when we believed.

title: Romans 13:12
text: The night is far spent, and the day is near; let us cast away therefore the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

title: Romans 13:13
text: As in the day, let us walk becomingly; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and lasciviousness, not in strife and emulation.

title: Romans 13:14
text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not take forethought for the flesh to [fulfil its] lusts.

title: Romans 14:1
text: ¶Now him that is weak in the faith receive, not to [the] determining of questions of reasoning.

title: Romans 14:2
text: One man is assured that he may eat all things; but the weak eats herbs.

title: Romans 14:3
text: Let not him that eats make little of him that eats not; and let not him that eats not judge him that eats: for God has received him.

title: Romans 14:4
text: Who art *thou* that judgest the servant of another? to his own master he stands or falls. And he shall be made to stand; for the Lord is able to make him stand.

title: Romans 14:5
text: One man esteems day more than day; another esteems every day [alike]. Let each be fully persuaded in his own mind.

title: Romans 14:6
text: He that regards the day, regards it to [the] Lord. And he that eats, eats to [the] Lord, for he gives God thanks; and he that does not eat, [it is] to [the] Lord he does not eat, and gives God thanks.

title: Romans 14:7
text: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

title: Romans 14:8
text: For both if we should live, [it is] to the Lord we live; and if we should die, [it is] to the Lord we die: both if we should live then, and if we should die, we are the Lord's.

title: Romans 14:9
text: For to this [end] Christ has died and lived [again], that he might rule over both dead and living.

title: Romans 14:10
text: But thou, why judgest thou thy brother? or again, thou, why dost thou make little of thy brother? for we shall all be placed before the judgment-seat of God.

title: Romans 14:11
text: For it is written, *I* live, saith [the] Lord, that to me shall bow every knee, and every tongue shall confess to God.

title: Romans 14:12
text: So then each of us shall give an account concerning himself to God.

title: Romans 14:13
text: Let us no longer therefore judge one another; but judge ye this rather, not to put a stumbling-block or a fall-trap before his brother.

title: Romans 14:14
text: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except to him who reckons anything to be unclean, to that man [it is] unclean.

title: Romans 14:15
text: For if on account of meat thy brother is grieved, thou walkest no longer according to love. Destroy not him with thy meat for whom Christ has died.

title: Romans 14:16
text: Let not then your good be evil spoken of;

title: Romans 14:17
text: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, and peace, and joy in [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 14:18
text: For he that in this serves the Christ [is] acceptable to God and approved of men.

title: Romans 14:19
text: So then let us pursue the things which tend to peace, and things whereby one shall build up another.

title: Romans 14:20
text: For the sake of meat do not destroy the work of God. All things indeed [are] pure; but [it is] evil to that man who eats while stumbling [in doing so].

title: Romans 14:21
text: [It is] right not to eat meat, nor drink wine, nor [do anything] in which thy brother stumbles, or is offended, or is weak.

title: Romans 14:22
text: Hast *thou* faith? have [it] to thyself before God. Blessed [is] he who does not judge himself in what he allows.

title: Romans 14:23
text: But he that doubts, if he eat, is condemned; because [it is] not of faith; but whatever [is] not of faith is sin.

title: Romans 15:1
text: ¶But *we* ought, we that are strong, to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

title: Romans 15:2
text: Let each one of us please his neighbour with a view to what is good, to edification.

title: Romans 15:3
text: For the Christ also did not please himself; but according as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproach thee have fallen upon me.

title: Romans 15:4
text: For as many things as have been written before have been written for our instruction, that through endurance and through encouragement of the scriptures we might have hope.

title: Romans 15:5
text: ¶Now the God of endurance and of encouragement give to you to be like-minded one toward another, according to Christ Jesus;

title: Romans 15:6
text: that ye may with one accord, with one mouth, glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Romans 15:7
text: ¶Wherefore receive ye one another, according as the Christ also has received you to [the] glory of God.

title: Romans 15:8
text: For I say that Jesus Christ became a minister of [the] circumcision for [the] truth of God, to confirm the promises of the fathers;

title: Romans 15:9
text: and that the nations should glorify God for mercy; according as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among [the] nations, and will sing to thy name.

title: Romans 15:10
text: And again he says, Rejoice, nations, with his people.

title: Romans 15:11
text: And again, Praise the Lord, all [ye] nations, and let all the peoples laud him.

title: Romans 15:12
text: And again, Esaias says, There shall be the root of Jesse, and one that arises, to rule over [the] nations: in him shall [the] nations hope.

title: Romans 15:13
text: ¶Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that ye should abound in hope by [the] power of [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 15:14
text: ¶But I am persuaded, my brethren, I myself also, concerning you, that yourselves also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

title: Romans 15:15
text: But I have written to you the more boldly, [brethren,] in part, as putting you in mind, because of the grace given to me by God,

title: Romans 15:16
text: for me to be minister of Christ Jesus to the nations, carrying on as a sacrificial service the [message of] glad tidings of God, in order that the offering up of the nations might be acceptable, sanctified by [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 15:17
text: ¶I have therefore [whereof to] boast in Christ Jesus in the things which pertain to God.

title: Romans 15:18
text: For I will not dare to speak anything of the things which Christ has not wrought by me, for [the] obedience of [the] nations, by word and deed,

title: Romans 15:19
text: in [the] power of signs and wonders, in [the] power of [the] Spirit of God; so that I, from Jerusalem, and in a circuit round to Illyricum, have fully preached the glad tidings of the Christ;

title: Romans 15:20
text: and so aiming to announce the glad tidings, not where Christ has been named, that I might not build upon another's foundation;

title: Romans 15:21
text: but according as it is written, To whom there was nothing told concerning him, they shall see; and they that have not heard shall understand.

title: Romans 15:22
text: ¶Wherefore also I have been often hindered from coming to you.

title: Romans 15:23
text: But now, having no longer place in these regions, and having great desire to come to you these many years,

title: Romans 15:24
text: whenever I should go to Spain; (for I hope to see you as I go through, and by you to be set forward thither, if first I shall have been in part filled with your company;)

title: Romans 15:25
text: but now I go to Jerusalem, ministering to the saints;

title: Romans 15:26
text: for Macedonia and Achaia have been well pleased to make a certain contribution for the poor of the saints who [are] in Jerusalem.

title: Romans 15:27
text: They have been well pleased indeed, and they are their debtors; for if the nations have participated in their spiritual things, they ought also in fleshly to minister to them.

title: Romans 15:28
text: Having finished this therefore, and having sealed to them this fruit, I will set off by you into Spain.

title: Romans 15:29
text: But I know that, coming to you, I shall come in [the] fulness of [the] blessing of Christ.

title: Romans 15:30
text: ¶But I beseech you, brethren, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in prayers for me to God;

title: Romans 15:31
text: that I may be saved from those that do not believe in Judaea; and that my ministry which [I have] for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

title: Romans 15:32
text: in order that I may come to you in joy by God's will, and that I may be refreshed with you.

title: Romans 15:33
text: And the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

title: Romans 16:1
text: ¶But I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is minister of the assembly which is in Cenchrea;

title: Romans 16:2
text: that ye may receive her in [the] Lord worthily of saints, and that ye may assist her in whatever matter she has need of you; for *she* also has been a helper of many, and of myself.

title: Romans 16:3
text: Salute Prisca and Aquila, my fellow-workmen in Christ Jesus,

title: Romans 16:4
text: (who for my life staked their own neck; to whom not *I* only am thankful, but also all the assemblies of the nations,)

title: Romans 16:5
text: and the assembly at their house. Salute Epaenetus, my beloved, who is [the] first-fruits of Asia for Christ.

title: Romans 16:6
text: Salute Maria, who laboured much for you.

title: Romans 16:7
text: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen and fellow-captives, who are of note among the apostles; who were also in Christ before me.

title: Romans 16:8
text: Salute Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

title: Romans 16:9
text: Salute Urbanus, our fellow-workman in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

title: Romans 16:10
text: Salute Apelles, approved in Christ. Salute those who belong to Aristobulus.

title: Romans 16:11
text: Salute Herodion, my kinsman. Salute those who belong to Narcissus, who are in [the] Lord.

title: Romans 16:12
text: Salute Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labour in [the] Lord. Salute Persis, the beloved, who has laboured much in [the] Lord.

title: Romans 16:13
text: Salute Rufus, chosen in [the] Lord; and his mother and mine.

title: Romans 16:14
text: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren with them.

title: Romans 16:15
text: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints with them.

title: Romans 16:16
text: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the assemblies of Christ salute you.

title: Romans 16:17
text: ¶But I beseech you, brethren, to consider those who create divisions and occasions of falling, contrary to the doctrine which *ye* have learnt, and turn away from them.

title: Romans 16:18
text: For such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly, and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.

title: Romans 16:19
text: For your obedience has reached to all. I rejoice therefore as it regards you; but I wish you to be wise [as] to that which is good, and simple [as] to evil.

title: Romans 16:20
text: But the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you.

title: Romans 16:21
text: ¶Timotheus, my fellow-workman, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

title: Romans 16:22
text: I Tertius, who have written this epistle, salute you in [the] Lord.

title: Romans 16:23
text: Gaius, my host and of the whole assembly, salutes you. Erastus, the steward of the city, salutes you, and the brother Quartus.

title: Romans 16:24
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

title: Romans 16:25
text: ¶Now to him that is able to establish you, according to my glad tidings and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to [the] revelation of [the] mystery, as to which silence has been kept in [the] times of the ages,

title: Romans 16:26
text: but [which] has now been made manifest, and by prophetic scriptures, according to commandment of the eternal God, made known for obedience of faith to all the nations--

title: Romans 16:27
text: [the] only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

title: I Corinthians 1:1
text: ¶Paul, [a] called apostle of Jesus Christ, by God's will, and Sosthenes the brother,

title: I Corinthians 1:2
text: to the assembly of God which is in Corinth, to [those] sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all that in every place call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, both theirs and ours:

title: I Corinthians 1:3
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:4
text: I thank my God always about you, in respect of the grace of God given to you in Christ Jesus;

title: I Corinthians 1:5
text: that in everything ye have been enriched in him, in all word [of doctrine], and all knowledge,

title: I Corinthians 1:6
text: (according as the testimony of the Christ has been confirmed in you,)

title: I Corinthians 1:7
text: so that ye come short in no gift, awaiting the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: I Corinthians 1:8
text: who shall also confirm you to [the] end, unimpeachable in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:9
text: God [is] faithful, by whom ye have been called into [the] fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: I Corinthians 1:10
text: ¶Now I exhort you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all say the same thing, and that there be not among you divisions; but that ye be perfectly united in the same mind and in the same opinion.

title: I Corinthians 1:11
text: For it has been shewn to me concerning you, my brethren, by those of [the house of] Chloe, that there are strifes among you.

title: I Corinthians 1:12
text: But I speak of this, that each of you says, *I* am of Paul, and *I* of Apollos, and *I* of Cephas, and *I* of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:13
text: Is the Christ divided? has Paul been crucified for you? or have ye been baptised unto the name of Paul?

title: I Corinthians 1:14
text: ¶I thank God that I have baptised none of you, unless Crispus and Gaius,

title: I Corinthians 1:15
text: that no one may say that I have baptised unto my own name.

title: I Corinthians 1:16
text: Yes, I baptised also the house of Stephanas; for the rest I know not if I have baptised any other.

title: I Corinthians 1:17
text: ¶For Christ has not sent me to baptise, but to preach glad tidings; not in wisdom of word, that the cross of the Christ may not be made vain.

title: I Corinthians 1:18
text: For the word of the cross is to them that perish foolishness, but to us that are saved it is God's power.

title: I Corinthians 1:19
text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and set aside the understanding of the understanding ones.

title: I Corinthians 1:20
text: Where [is the] wise? where scribe? where disputer of this world? has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

title: I Corinthians 1:21
text: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world by wisdom has not known God, God has been pleased by the foolishness of the preaching to save those that believe.

title: I Corinthians 1:22
text: Since Jews indeed ask for signs, and Greeks seek wisdom;

title: I Corinthians 1:23
text: but *we* preach Christ crucified, to Jews an offence, and to nations foolishness;

title: I Corinthians 1:24
text: but to those that [are] called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ God's power and God's wisdom.

title: I Corinthians 1:25
text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

title: I Corinthians 1:26
text: For consider your calling, brethren, that [there are] not many wise according to flesh, not many powerful, not many high-born.

title: I Corinthians 1:27
text: But God has chosen the foolish things of the world, that he may put to shame the wise; and God has chosen the weak things of the world, that he may put to shame the strong things;

title: I Corinthians 1:28
text: and the ignoble things of the world, and the despised, has God chosen, [and] things that are not, that he may annul the things that are;

title: I Corinthians 1:29
text: so that no flesh should boast before God.

title: I Corinthians 1:30
text: But of him are *ye* in Christ Jesus, who has been made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness, and holiness, and redemption;

title: I Corinthians 1:31
text: that according as it is written, He that boasts, let him boast in [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 2:1
text: ¶And *I*, when I came to you, brethren, came not in excellency of word, or wisdom, announcing to you the testimony of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:2
text: For I did not judge [it well] to know anything among you save Jesus Christ, and *him* crucified.

title: I Corinthians 2:3
text: And *I* was with you in weakness and in fear and in much trembling;

title: I Corinthians 2:4
text: and my word and my preaching, not in persuasive words of wisdom, but in demonstration of [the] Spirit and of power;

title: I Corinthians 2:5
text: that your faith might not stand in men's wisdom, but in God's power.

title: I Corinthians 2:6
text: ¶But we speak wisdom among the perfect; but wisdom not of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, who come to nought.

title: I Corinthians 2:7
text: But we speak God's wisdom in [a] mystery, that hidden [wisdom] which God had predetermined before the ages for our glory:

title: I Corinthians 2:8
text: which none of the princes of this age knew, (for had they known, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory;)

title: I Corinthians 2:9
text: but according as it is written, Things which eye has not seen, and ear not heard, and which have not come into man's heart, which God has prepared for them that love him,

title: I Corinthians 2:10
text: but God has revealed to us by [his] Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, even the depths of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:11
text: For who of men hath known the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? thus also the things of God knows no one except the Spirit of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:12
text: But *we* have received, not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which [is] of God, that we may know the things which have been freely given to us of God:

title: I Corinthians 2:13
text: which also we speak, not in words taught by human wisdom, but in those taught by the Spirit, communicating spiritual [things] by spiritual [means].

title: I Corinthians 2:14
text: But [the] natural man does not receive the things of the Spirit of God, for they are folly to him; and he cannot know [them] because they are spiritually discerned;

title: I Corinthians 2:15
text: but the spiritual discerns all things, and *he* is discerned of no one.

title: I Corinthians 2:16
text: For who has known the mind of [the] Lord, who shall instruct him? But *we* have the mind of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:1
text: ¶And *I*, brethren, have not been able to speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly; as to babes in Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:2
text: I have given you milk to drink, not meat, for ye have not yet been able, nor indeed are ye yet able;

title: I Corinthians 3:3
text: for ye are yet carnal. For whereas [there are] among you emulation and strife, are ye not carnal, and walk according to man?

title: I Corinthians 3:4
text: For when one says, *I* am of Paul, and another, *I* of Apollos, are ye not men?

title: I Corinthians 3:5
text: ¶Who then is Apollos, and who Paul? Ministering servants, through whom ye have believed, and as the Lord has given to each.

title: I Corinthians 3:6
text: *I* have planted; Apollos watered; but God has given the increase.

title: I Corinthians 3:7
text: So that neither the planter is anything, nor the waterer; but God the giver of the increase.

title: I Corinthians 3:8
text: But the planter and the waterer are one; but each shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.

title: I Corinthians 3:9
text: For we are God's fellow-workmen; ye are God's husbandry, God's building.

title: I Corinthians 3:10
text: According to the grace of God which has been given to me, as a wise architect, I have laid the foundation, but another builds upon it. But let each see how he builds upon it.

title: I Corinthians 3:11
text: ¶For other foundation can no man lay besides that which [is] laid, which is Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:12
text: Now if any one build upon [this] foundation, gold, silver, precious stones, wood, grass, straw,

title: I Corinthians 3:13
text: the work of each shall be made manifest; for the day shall declare [it], because it is revealed in fire; and the fire shall try the work of each what it is.

title: I Corinthians 3:14
text: If the work of any one which he has built upon [the foundation] shall abide, he shall receive a reward.

title: I Corinthians 3:15
text: If the work of any one shall be consumed, he shall suffer loss, but *he* shall be saved, but so as through [the] fire.

title: I Corinthians 3:16
text: ¶Do ye not know that ye are [the] temple of God, and [that] the Spirit of God dwells in you?

title: I Corinthians 3:17
text: If any one corrupt the temple of God, *him* shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, and such are *ye*.

title: I Corinthians 3:18
text: ¶Let no one deceive himself: if any one thinks himself to be wise among you in this world, let him become foolish, that he may be wise.

title: I Corinthians 3:19
text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God; for it is written, He who takes the wise in their craftiness.

title: I Corinthians 3:20
text: And again, [The] Lord knows the reasonings of the wise that they are vain.

title: I Corinthians 3:21
text: ¶So that let no one boast in men; for all things are yours.

title: I Corinthians 3:22
text: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or [the] world, or life, or death, or things present, or things coming, all are yours;

title: I Corinthians 3:23
text: and *ye* [are] Christ's, and Christ [is] God's.

title: I Corinthians 4:1
text: ¶Let a man so account of us as servants of Christ, and stewards of [the] mysteries of God.

title: I Corinthians 4:2
text: Here, further, it is sought in stewards, that a man be found faithful.

title: I Corinthians 4:3
text: But for me it is the very smallest matter that I be examined of you or of man's day. Nor do I even examine myself.

title: I Corinthians 4:4
text: For I am conscious of nothing in myself; but I am not justified by this: but he that examines me is the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 4:5
text: So that do not judge anything before [the] time, until the Lord shall come, who shall also both bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and shall make manifest the counsels of hearts; and then shall each have [his] praise from God.

title: I Corinthians 4:6
text: Now these things, brethren, I have transferred, in their application, to myself and Apollos, for your sakes, that ye may learn in us the [lesson of] not [letting your thoughts go] above what is written, that ye may not be puffed up one for [such a] one against another.

title: I Corinthians 4:7
text: ¶For who makes thee to differ? and what hast thou which thou hast not received? but if also thou hast received, why boastest thou as not receiving?

title: I Corinthians 4:8
text: Already ye are filled; already ye have been enriched; ye have reigned without us; and I would that ye reigned, that *we* also might reign with you.

title: I Corinthians 4:9
text: For I think that God has set us the apostles for the last, as appointed to death. For we have become a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

title: I Corinthians 4:10
text: *We* [are] fools for Christ's sake, but *ye* prudent in Christ: *we* weak, but *ye* strong: *ye* glorious, but *we* in dishonour.

title: I Corinthians 4:11
text: To the present hour we both hunger and thirst, and are in nakedness, and buffeted, and wander without a home,

title: I Corinthians 4:12
text: and labour, working with our own hands. Railed at, we bless; persecuted, we suffer [it];

title: I Corinthians 4:13
text: insulted, we entreat: we are become as [the] offscouring of the world, [the] refuse of all, until now.

title: I Corinthians 4:14
text: ¶Not [as] chiding do I write these things to you, but as my beloved children I admonish [you].

title: I Corinthians 4:15
text: For if ye should have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet not many fathers; for in Christ Jesus *I* have begotten you through the glad tidings.

title: I Corinthians 4:16
text: I entreat you therefore, be my imitators.

title: I Corinthians 4:17
text: ¶For this reason I have sent to you Timotheus, who is my beloved and faithful child in [the] Lord, who shall put you in mind of my ways [as] they [are] in Christ, according as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

title: I Corinthians 4:18
text: But some have been puffed up, as if I were not coming to you;

title: I Corinthians 4:19
text: but I will come quickly to you, if the Lord will; and I will know, not the word of those that are puffed up, but the power.

title: I Corinthians 4:20
text: For the kingdom of God [is] not in word, but in power.

title: I Corinthians 4:21
text: What will ye? that I come to you with a rod; or in love, and [in] a spirit of meekness?

title: I Corinthians 5:1
text: ¶It is universally reported [that there is] fornication among you, and such fornication as [is] not even among the nations, so that one should have his father's wife.

title: I Corinthians 5:2
text: And *ye* are puffed up, and ye have not rather mourned, in order that he that has done this deed might be taken away out of the midst of you.

title: I Corinthians 5:3
text: For *I*, [as] absent in body but present in spirit, have already judged as present,

title: I Corinthians 5:4
text: [to deliver,] in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ (ye and my spirit being gathered together, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ), him that has so wrought this:

title: I Corinthians 5:5
text: to deliver him, [I say,] [being] such, to Satan for destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

title: I Corinthians 5:6
text: Your boasting [is] not good. Do ye not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?

title: I Corinthians 5:7
text: ¶Purge out the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, according as ye are unleavened. For also our passover, Christ, has been sacrificed;

title: I Corinthians 5:8
text: so that let us celebrate the feast, not with old leaven, nor with leaven of malice and wickedness, but with unleavened [bread] of sincerity and truth.

title: I Corinthians 5:9
text: ¶I have written to you in the epistle not to mix with fornicators;

title: I Corinthians 5:10
text: not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the avaricious and rapacious, or idolaters, since [then] ye should go out of the world.

title: I Corinthians 5:11
text: But now I have written to you, if any one called brother be fornicator, or avaricious, or idolater, or abusive, or a drunkard, or rapacious, not to mix with [him]; with such a one not even to eat.

title: I Corinthians 5:12
text: For what have *I* [to do] with judging those outside also? *ye*, do not ye judge them that are within?

title: I Corinthians 5:13
text: But those without God judges. Remove the wicked person from amongst yourselves.

title: I Corinthians 6:1
text: ¶Dare any one of you, having a matter against another, prosecute his suit before the unjust, and not before the saints?

title: I Corinthians 6:2
text: Do ye not then know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world is judged by you, are ye unworthy of [the] smallest judgments?

title: I Corinthians 6:3
text: Do ye not know that we shall judge angels? and not then matters of this life?

title: I Corinthians 6:4
text: If then ye have judgments as to things of this life, set those [to judge] who are little esteemed in the assembly.

title: I Corinthians 6:5
text: I speak to you [to put you] to shame. Thus there is not a wise person among you, not even one, who shall be able to decide between his brethren!

title: I Corinthians 6:6
text: But brother prosecutes his suit with brother, and that before unbelievers.

title: I Corinthians 6:7
text: Already indeed then it is altogether a fault in you that ye have suits between yourselves. Why do ye not rather suffer wrong? why are ye not rather defrauded?

title: I Corinthians 6:8
text: But *ye* do wrong, and defraud, and this [your] brethren.

title: I Corinthians 6:9
text: ¶Do ye not know that unrighteous [persons] shall not inherit [the] kingdom of God? Do not err: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor those who make women of themselves, nor who abuse themselves with men,

title: I Corinthians 6:10
text: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor abusive persons, nor [the] rapacious, shall inherit [the] kingdom of God.

title: I Corinthians 6:11
text: And these things were some of you; but ye have been washed, but ye have been sanctified, but ye have been justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

title: I Corinthians 6:12
text: ¶All things are lawful to me, but all things do not profit; all things are lawful to me, but *I* will not be brought under the power of any.

title: I Corinthians 6:13
text: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats; but God will bring to nothing both it and them: but the body [is] not for fornication, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

title: I Corinthians 6:14
text: And God has both raised up the Lord, and will raise us up from among [the dead] by his power.

title: I Corinthians 6:15
text: Do ye not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then, taking the members of the Christ, make [them] members of a harlot? Far be the thought.

title: I Corinthians 6:16
text: Do ye not know that he [that is] joined to the harlot is one body? for the two, he says, shall be one flesh.

title: I Corinthians 6:17
text: But he that [is] joined to the Lord is one Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 6:18
text: Flee fornication. Every sin which a man may practise is without the body, but he that commits fornication sins against his own body.

title: I Corinthians 6:19
text: Do ye not know that your body is [the] temple of the Holy Spirit which [is] in you, which ye have of God; and ye are not your own?

title: I Corinthians 6:20
text: for ye have been bought with a price: glorify now then God in your body.

title: I Corinthians 7:1
text: ¶But concerning the things of which ye have written [to me]: [It is] good for a man not to touch a woman;

title: I Corinthians 7:2
text: but on account of fornications, let each have his own wife, and each [woman] have her own husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:3
text: Let the husband render her due to the wife, and in like manner the wife to the husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:4
text: The wife has not authority over her own body, but the husband: in like manner also the husband has not authority over his own body, but the wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:5
text: Defraud not one another, unless, it may be, by consent for a time, that ye may devote yourselves to prayer, and again be together, that Satan tempt you not because of your incontinency.

title: I Corinthians 7:6
text: But this I say, as consenting [to], not as commanding [it].

title: I Corinthians 7:7
text: Now I wish all men to be even as myself: but every one has his own gift of God: one man thus, and another thus.

title: I Corinthians 7:8
text: But I say to the unmarried and to the widows, It is good for them that they remain even as I.

title: I Corinthians 7:9
text: But if they have not control over themselves, let them marry; for it is better to marry than to burn.

title: I Corinthians 7:10
text: ¶But to the married I enjoin, not *I*, but the Lord, Let not wife be separated from husband;

title: I Corinthians 7:11
text: (but if also she shall have been separated, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband;) and let not husband leave wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:12
text: But as to the rest, *I* say, not the Lord, If any brother have an unbelieving wife, and *she* consent to dwell with him, let him not leave her.

title: I Corinthians 7:13
text: And a woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he consents to dwell with her, let her not leave [her] husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:14
text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the brother; since [otherwise] indeed your children are unclean, but now they are holy.

title: I Corinthians 7:15
text: But if the unbeliever go away, let them go away; a brother or a sister is not bound in such [cases], but God has called us in peace.

title: I Corinthians 7:16
text: For what knowest thou, O wife, if thou shalt save thy husband? or what knowest thou, O husband, if thou shalt save thy wife?

title: I Corinthians 7:17
text: ¶However, as the Lord has divided to each, as God has called each, so let him walk; and thus I ordain in all the assemblies.

title: I Corinthians 7:18
text: Has any one been called circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised: has any one been called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.

title: I Corinthians 7:19
text: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing; but keeping God's commandments.

title: I Corinthians 7:20
text: Let each abide in that calling in which he has been called.

title: I Corinthians 7:21
text: Hast thou been called [being] a bondman, let it not concern thee; but and if thou canst become free, use [it] rather.

title: I Corinthians 7:22
text: For the bondman that is called in [the] Lord is the Lord's freedman; in like manner [also] the freeman being called is Christ's bondman.

title: I Corinthians 7:23
text: Ye have been bought with a price; do not be the bondmen of men.

title: I Corinthians 7:24
text: Let each, wherein he is called, brethren, therein abide with God.

title: I Corinthians 7:25
text: ¶But concerning virgins, I have no commandment of [the] Lord; but I give my opinion, as having received mercy of [the] Lord to be faithful.

title: I Corinthians 7:26
text: I think then that this is good, on account of the present necessity, that [it is] good for a man to remain so as he is.

title: I Corinthians 7:27
text: Art thou bound to a wife? seek not to be loosed; art thou free from a wife? do not seek a wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:28
text: But if thou shouldest also marry, thou hast not sinned; and if the virgin marry, they have not sinned: but such shall have tribulation in the flesh; but I spare you.

title: I Corinthians 7:29
text: But this I say, brethren, the time is straitened. For the rest, that they who have wives, be as not having [any]:

title: I Corinthians 7:30
text: and they that weep, as not weeping; and they that rejoice, as not rejoicing; and they that buy, as not possessing;

title: I Corinthians 7:31
text: and they that use the world, as not disposing of it as their own; for the fashion of this world passes.

title: I Corinthians 7:32
text: But I wish you to be without care. The unmarried cares for the things of the Lord, how he shall please the Lord;

title: I Corinthians 7:33
text: but he that has married cares for the things of the world, how he shall please his wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:34
text: There is a difference between the wife and the virgin. The unmarried cares for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and spirit; but she that has married cares for the things of the world, how she shall please her husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:35
text: But I say this for your own profit; not that I may set a snare before you, but for what [is] seemly, and waiting on the Lord without distraction.

title: I Corinthians 7:36
text: ¶But if any one think that he behaves unseemly to his virginity, if he be beyond the flower of his age, and so it must be, let him do what he will, he does not sin: let them marry.

title: I Corinthians 7:37
text: But he who stands firm in his heart, having no need, but has authority over his own will, and has judged this in his heart to keep his own virginity, he does well.

title: I Corinthians 7:38
text: So that he that marries himself does well; and he that does not marry does better.

title: I Corinthians 7:39
text: ¶A wife is bound for whatever time her husband lives; but if the husband be fallen asleep, she is free to be married to whom she will, only in [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 7:40
text: But she is happier if she so remain, according to my judgment; but I think that *I* also have God's Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 8:1
text: ¶But concerning things sacrificed to idols, we know, (for we all have knowledge: knowledge puffs up, but love edifies.

title: I Corinthians 8:2
text: If any one think he knows anything, he knows nothing yet as he ought to know [it].

title: I Corinthians 8:3
text: But if any one love God, *he* is known of him):

title: I Corinthians 8:4
text: ¶--concerning then the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that an idol [is] nothing in [the] world, and that there [is] no other God save one.

title: I Corinthians 8:5
text: For and if indeed there are [those] called gods, whether in heaven or on earth, (as there are gods many, and lords many,)

title: I Corinthians 8:6
text: yet to us [there is] one God, the Father, of whom all things, and *we* for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, by whom [are] all things, and *we* by him.

title: I Corinthians 8:7
text: ¶But knowledge [is] not in all: but some, with conscience of the idol, until now eat as of a thing sacrificed to idols; and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

title: I Corinthians 8:8
text: But meat does not commend us to God; neither if we should not eat do we come short; nor if we should eat have we an advantage.

title: I Corinthians 8:9
text: But see lest anywise this your right [to eat] itself be a stumbling-block to the weak.

title: I Corinthians 8:10
text: For if any one see thee, who hast knowledge, sitting at table in an idol-house, shall not his conscience, he being weak, be emboldened to eat the things sacrificed to the idol?

title: I Corinthians 8:11
text: and the weak [one], the brother for whose sake Christ died, will perish through thy knowledge.

title: I Corinthians 8:12
text: Now, thus sinning against the brethren, and wounding their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.

title: I Corinthians 8:13
text: Wherefore if meat be a fall-trap to my brother, I will eat no flesh for ever, that I may not be a fall-trap to my brother.

title: I Corinthians 9:1
text: ¶Am I not free? am I not an apostle? have I not seen Jesus our Lord? are not *ye* my work in [the] Lord?

title: I Corinthians 9:2
text: If I am not an apostle to others, yet at any rate I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are *ye* in [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 9:3
text: ¶My defence to those who examine me is this:

title: I Corinthians 9:4
text: Have we not a right to eat and to drink?

title: I Corinthians 9:5
text: have we not a right to take round a sister [as] wife, as also the other apostles, and the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

title: I Corinthians 9:6
text: Or *I* alone and Barnabas, have we not a right not to work?

title: I Corinthians 9:7
text: Who ever carries on war at his own charges? who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? or who herds a flock and does not eat of the milk of the flock?

title: I Corinthians 9:8
text: Do I speak these things as a man, or does not the law also say these things?

title: I Corinthians 9:9
text: For in the law of Moses it is written, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that is treading out corn. Is God occupied about the oxen,

title: I Corinthians 9:10
text: or does he say [it] altogether for our sakes? For for our sakes it has been written, that the plougher should plough in hope, and he that treads out corn, in hope of partaking of [it].

title: I Corinthians 9:11
text: If we have sown to you spiritual things, [is it a] great [thing] if *we* shall reap your carnal things?

title: I Corinthians 9:12
text: If others partake of this right over you, should not rather *we*? But we have not used this right, but we bear all things, that we may put no hindrance in the way of the glad tidings of the Christ.

title: I Corinthians 9:13
text: Do ye not know that they who labour [at] sacred things eat of the [offerings offered in the] temple; they that attend at the altar partake with the altar?

title: I Corinthians 9:14
text: So also the Lord has ordained to those that announce the glad tidings to live of the glad tidings.

title: I Corinthians 9:15
text: ¶But *I* have used none of these things. Now I have not written these things that it should be thus in my case; for [it were] good for me rather to die than that any one should make vain my boast.

title: I Corinthians 9:16
text: For if I announce the glad tidings, I have nothing to boast of; for a necessity is laid upon me; for it is woe to me if I should not announce the glad tidings.

title: I Corinthians 9:17
text: For if I do this voluntarily, I have a reward; but if not of my own will, I am entrusted with an administration.

title: I Corinthians 9:18
text: What is the reward then that I have? That in announcing the glad tidings I make the glad tidings costless [to others], so as not to have made use, as belonging to me, of my right in [announcing] the glad tidings.

title: I Corinthians 9:19
text: ¶For being free from all, I have made myself bondman to all, that I might gain the most [possible].

title: I Corinthians 9:20
text: And I became to the Jews as a Jew, in order that I might gain the Jews: to those under law, as under law, not being myself under law, in order that I might gain those under law:

title: I Corinthians 9:21
text: to those without law, as without law, (not as without law to God, but as legitimately subject to Christ,) in order that I might gain [those] without law.

title: I Corinthians 9:22
text: I became to the weak, [as] weak, in order that I might gain the weak. To all I have become all things, in order that at all events I might save some.

title: I Corinthians 9:23
text: And I do all things for the sake of the glad tidings, that I may be fellow-partaker with them.

title: I Corinthians 9:24
text: ¶Know ye not that they who run in [the] race-course run all, but one receives the prize? Thus run in order that ye may obtain.

title: I Corinthians 9:25
text: But every one that contends [for a prize] is temperate in all things: *they* then indeed that they may receive a corruptible crown, but *we* an incorruptible.

title: I Corinthians 9:26
text: *I* therefore thus run, as not uncertainly; so I combat, as not beating the air.

title: I Corinthians 9:27
text: But I buffet my body, and lead it captive, lest [after] having preached to others I should be myself rejected.

title: I Corinthians 10:1
text: ¶For I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

title: I Corinthians 10:2
text: and all were baptised unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

title: I Corinthians 10:3
text: and all ate the same spiritual food,

title: I Corinthians 10:4
text: and all drank the same spiritual drink, for they drank of a spiritual rock which followed [them]: (now the rock was the Christ;)

title: I Corinthians 10:5
text: yet God was not pleased with the most of them, for they were strewed in the desert.

title: I Corinthians 10:6
text: ¶But these things happened [as] types of us, that we should not be lusters after evil things, as they also lusted.

title: I Corinthians 10:7
text: Neither be ye idolaters, as some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

title: I Corinthians 10:8
text: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed fornication, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

title: I Corinthians 10:9
text: Neither let us tempt the Christ, as some of them tempted, and perished by serpents.

title: I Corinthians 10:10
text: Neither murmur ye, as some of them murmured, and perished by the destroyer.

title: I Corinthians 10:11
text: Now all these things happened to them [as] types, and have been written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages are come.

title: I Corinthians 10:12
text: So that let him that thinks that he stands take heed lest he fall.

title: I Corinthians 10:13
text: No temptation has taken you but such as is according to man's nature; and God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above what ye are able [to bear], but will with the temptation make the issue also, so that [ye] should be able to bear [it].

title: I Corinthians 10:14
text: Wherefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

title: I Corinthians 10:15
text: ¶I speak as to intelligent [persons]: do *ye* judge what I say.

title: I Corinthians 10:16
text: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not [the] communion of the blood of the Christ? The bread which we break, is it not [the] communion of the body of the Christ?

title: I Corinthians 10:17
text: Because we, [being] many, are one loaf, one body; for we all partake of that one loaf.

title: I Corinthians 10:18
text: See Israel according to flesh: are not they who eat the sacrifices in communion with the altar?

title: I Corinthians 10:19
text: What then do I say? that what is sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

title: I Corinthians 10:20
text: But that what [the nations] sacrifice they sacrifice to demons, and not to God. Now I do not wish you to be in communion with demons.

title: I Corinthians 10:21
text: Ye cannot drink [the] Lord's cup, and [the] cup of demons: ye cannot partake of [the] Lord's table, and of [the] table of demons.

title: I Corinthians 10:22
text: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

title: I Corinthians 10:23
text: ¶All things are lawful, but all are not profitable; all things are lawful, but all do not edify.

title: I Corinthians 10:24
text: Let no one seek his own [advantage], but that of the other.

title: I Corinthians 10:25
text: Everything sold in the shambles eat, making no inquiry for conscience sake.

title: I Corinthians 10:26
text: For the earth [is] the Lord's and its fulness.

title: I Corinthians 10:27
text: But if any one of the unbelievers invite you, and ye are minded to go, all that is set before you eat, making no inquiry for conscience sake.

title: I Corinthians 10:28
text: But if any one say to you, This is offered to holy purposes, do not eat, for his sake that pointed it out, and conscience sake;

title: I Corinthians 10:29
text: but conscience, I mean, not thine own, but that of the other: for why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

title: I Corinthians 10:30
text: If *I* partake with thanksgiving, why am I spoken evil of for what *I* give thanks for?

title: I Corinthians 10:31
text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatever ye do, do all things to God's glory.

title: I Corinthians 10:32
text: Give no occasion to stumbling, whether to Jews, or Greeks, or the assembly of God.

title: I Corinthians 10:33
text: Even as *I* also please all in all things; not seeking my own profit, but that of the many, that they may be saved.

title: I Corinthians 11:1
text: ¶Be my imitators, even as *I* also [am] of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 11:2
text: Now I praise you, that in all things ye are mindful of me; and that as I have directed you, ye keep the directions.

title: I Corinthians 11:3
text: But I wish you to know that the Christ is the head of every man, but woman's head [is] the man, and the Christ's head God.

title: I Corinthians 11:4
text: Every man praying or prophesying, having [anything] on his head, puts his head to shame.

title: I Corinthians 11:5
text: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered puts her own head to shame; for it is one and the same as a shaved [woman].

title: I Corinthians 11:6
text: For if a woman be not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if [it be] shameful to a woman to have her hair cut off or to be shaved, let her be covered.

title: I Corinthians 11:7
text: For man indeed ought not to have his head covered, being God's image and glory; but woman is man's glory.

title: I Corinthians 11:8
text: For man is not of woman, but woman of man.

title: I Corinthians 11:9
text: For also man was not created for the sake of the woman, but woman for the sake of the man.

title: I Corinthians 11:10
text: Therefore ought the woman to have authority on her head, on account of the angels.

title: I Corinthians 11:11
text: However, neither [is] woman without man, nor man without woman, in [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 11:12
text: For as the woman [is] of the man, so also [is] the man by the woman, but all things of God.

title: I Corinthians 11:13
text: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman should pray to God uncovered?

title: I Corinthians 11:14
text: Does not even nature itself teach you, that man, if he have long hair, it is a dishonour to him?

title: I Corinthians 11:15
text: But woman, if she have long hair, [it is] glory to her; for the long hair is given [to her] in lieu of a veil.

title: I Corinthians 11:16
text: But if any one think to be contentious, *we* have no such custom, nor the assemblies of God.

title: I Corinthians 11:17
text: ¶But [in] prescribing [to you on] this [which I now enter on], I do not praise, [namely,] that ye come together, not for the better, but for the worse.

title: I Corinthians 11:18
text: For first, when ye come together in assembly, I hear there exist divisions among you, and I partly give credit [to it].

title: I Corinthians 11:19
text: For there must also be sects among you, that the approved may become manifest among you.

title: I Corinthians 11:20
text: When ye come therefore together into one place, it is not to eat [the] Lord's supper.

title: I Corinthians 11:21
text: For each one in eating takes his *own* supper before [others], and one is hungry and another drinks to excess.

title: I Corinthians 11:22
text: Have ye not then houses for eating and drinking? or do ye despise the assembly of God, and put to shame them who have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you? In this [point] I do not praise.

title: I Corinthians 11:23
text: ¶For *I* received from the Lord, that which I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus, in the night in which he was delivered up, took bread,

title: I Corinthians 11:24
text: and having given thanks broke [it], and said, This is my body, which [is] for you: this do in remembrance of me.

title: I Corinthians 11:25
text: In like manner also the cup, after having supped, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood: this do, as often as ye shall drink [it], in remembrance of me.

title: I Corinthians 11:26
text: For as often as ye shall eat this bread, and drink the cup, ye announce the death of the Lord, until he come.

title: I Corinthians 11:27
text: So that whosoever shall eat the bread, or drink the cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty in respect of the body and of the blood of the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 11:28
text: But let a man prove himself, and thus eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.

title: I Corinthians 11:29
text: For [the] eater and drinker eats and drinks judgment to himself, not distinguishing the body.

title: I Corinthians 11:30
text: On this account many among you [are] weak and infirm, and a good many are fallen asleep.

title: I Corinthians 11:31
text: But if we judged ourselves, so were we not judged.

title: I Corinthians 11:32
text: But being judged, we are disciplined of [the] Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

title: I Corinthians 11:33
text: So that, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, wait for one another.

title: I Corinthians 11:34
text: If any one be hungry, let him eat at home, that ye may not come together for judgment. But the other things, whenever I come, I will set in order.

title: I Corinthians 12:1
text: ¶But concerning spiritual [manifestations], brethren, I do not wish you to be ignorant.

title: I Corinthians 12:2
text: Ye know that when ye were [of the] nations [ye were] led away to dumb idols, in whatever way ye might be led.

title: I Corinthians 12:3
text: I give you therefore to know, that no one, speaking in [the power of the] Spirit of God, says, Curse [on] Jesus; and no one can say, Lord Jesus, unless in [the power of the] Holy Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 12:4
text: But there are distinctions of gifts, but the same Spirit;

title: I Corinthians 12:5
text: and there are distinctions of services, and the same Lord;

title: I Corinthians 12:6
text: and there are distinctions of operations, but the same God who operates all things in all.

title: I Corinthians 12:7
text: But to each the manifestation of the Spirit is given for profit.

title: I Corinthians 12:8
text: For to one, by the Spirit, is given [the] word of wisdom; and to another [the] word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;

title: I Corinthians 12:9
text: and to a different one faith, in [the power of] the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healing in [the power of] the same Spirit;

title: I Corinthians 12:10
text: and to another operations of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; and to a different one kinds of tongues; and to another interpretation of tongues.

title: I Corinthians 12:11
text: But all these things operates the one and the same Spirit, dividing to each in particular according as he pleases.

title: I Corinthians 12:12
text: ¶For even as the body is one and has many members, but all the members of the body, being many, are one body, so also [is] the Christ.

title: I Corinthians 12:13
text: For also in [the power of] one Spirit *we* have all been baptised into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bondmen or free, and have all been given to drink of one Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 12:14
text: For also the body is not one member but many.

title: I Corinthians 12:15
text: If the foot say, Because I am not a hand I am not of the body, is it on account of this not indeed of the body?

title: I Corinthians 12:16
text: And if the ear say, Because I am not an eye I am not of the body, is it on account of this not indeed of the body?

title: I Corinthians 12:17
text: If the whole body [were] an eye, where the hearing? if all hearing, where the smelling?

title: I Corinthians 12:18
text: But now God has set the members, each one of them in the body, according as it has pleased [him].

title: I Corinthians 12:19
text: But if all were one member, where the body?

title: I Corinthians 12:20
text: But now the members [are] many, and the body one.

title: I Corinthians 12:21
text: The eye cannot say to the hand, I have not need of thee; or again, the head to the feet, I have not need of you.

title: I Corinthians 12:22
text: But much rather, the members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary;

title: I Corinthians 12:23
text: and those [parts] of the body which we esteem to be the more void of honour, these we clothe with more abundant honour; and our uncomely [parts] have more abundant comeliness;

title: I Corinthians 12:24
text: but our comely [parts] have not need. But God has tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to [the part] that lacked;

title: I Corinthians 12:25
text: that there might be no division in the body, but that the members might have the same concern one for another.

title: I Corinthians 12:26
text: And if one member suffer, all the members suffer with [it]; and if one member be glorified, all the members rejoice with [it].

title: I Corinthians 12:27
text: ¶Now *ye* are Christ's body, and members in particular.

title: I Corinthians 12:28
text: And God has set certain in the assembly: first, apostles; secondly, prophets; thirdly, teachers; then miraculous powers; then gifts of healings; helps; governments; kinds of tongues.

title: I Corinthians 12:29
text: [Are] all apostles? [are] all prophets? [are] all teachers? [are] all [in possession of] miraculous powers?

title: I Corinthians 12:30
text: have all gifts of healings? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

title: I Corinthians 12:31
text: But desire earnestly the greater gifts, and yet shew I unto you a way of more surpassing excellence.

title: I Corinthians 13:1
text: ¶If I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

title: I Corinthians 13:2
text: And if I have prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

title: I Corinthians 13:3
text: And if I shall dole out all my goods in food, and if I deliver up my body that I may be burned, but have not love, I profit nothing.

title: I Corinthians 13:4
text: ¶Love has long patience, is kind; love is not emulous [of others]; love is not insolent and rash, is not puffed up,

title: I Corinthians 13:5
text: does not behave in an unseemly manner, does not seek what is its own, is not quickly provoked, does not impute evil,

title: I Corinthians 13:6
text: does not rejoice at iniquity but rejoices with the truth,

title: I Corinthians 13:7
text: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

title: I Corinthians 13:8
text: ¶Love never fails; but whether prophecies, they shall be done away; or tongues, they shall cease; or knowledge, it shall be done away.

title: I Corinthians 13:9
text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part:

title: I Corinthians 13:10
text: but when that which is perfect has come, that which is in part shall be done away.

title: I Corinthians 13:11
text: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I reasoned as a child; when I became a man, I had done with what belonged to the child.

title: I Corinthians 13:12
text: For we see now through a dim window obscurely, but then face to face; now I know partially, but then I shall know according as I also have been known.

title: I Corinthians 13:13
text: And now abide faith, hope, love; these three things; and the greater of these [is] love.

title: I Corinthians 14:1
text: ¶Follow after love, and be emulous of spiritual [manifestations], but rather that ye may prophesy.

title: I Corinthians 14:2
text: For he that speaks with a tongue does not speak to men but to God: for no one hears; but in spirit he speaks mysteries.

title: I Corinthians 14:3
text: But he that prophesies speaks to men [in] edification, and encouragement, and consolation.

title: I Corinthians 14:4
text: He that speaks with a tongue edifies himself; but he that prophesies edifies [the] assembly.

title: I Corinthians 14:5
text: Now I desire that ye should all speak with tongues, but rather that ye should prophesy. But greater is he that prophesies than he that speaks with tongues, unless he interpret, that the assembly may receive edification.

title: I Corinthians 14:6
text: ¶And now, brethren, if I come to you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, unless I shall speak to you either in revelation, or in knowledge, or in prophecy, or in teaching?

title: I Corinthians 14:7
text: Even lifeless things giving a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they give not distinction to the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

title: I Corinthians 14:8
text: For also, if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself for war?

title: I Corinthians 14:9
text: Thus also *ye* with the tongue, unless ye give a distinct speech, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye will be speaking to the air.

title: I Corinthians 14:10
text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of undistinguishable sound.

title: I Corinthians 14:11
text: If therefore I do not know the power of the sound, I shall be to him that speaks a barbarian, and he that speaks a barbarian for me.

title: I Corinthians 14:12
text: Thus *ye* also, since ye are desirous of spirits, seek that ye may abound for the edification of the assembly.

title: I Corinthians 14:13
text: Wherefore let him that speaks with a tongue pray that he may interpret.

title: I Corinthians 14:14
text: For if I pray with a tongue, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

title: I Corinthians 14:15
text: ¶What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, but I will pray also with the understanding; I will sing with the spirit, but I will sing also with the understanding.

title: I Corinthians 14:16
text: Since otherwise, if thou blessest with [the] spirit, how shall he who fills the place of the simple [Christian] say Amen, at thy giving of thanks, since he does not know what thou sayest?

title: I Corinthians 14:17
text: For *thou* indeed givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

title: I Corinthians 14:18
text: I thank God I speak in a tongue more than all of you:

title: I Corinthians 14:19
text: but in [the] assembly I desire to speak five words with my understanding, that I may instruct others also, [rather] than ten thousand words in a tongue.

title: I Corinthians 14:20
text: Brethren, be not children in [your] minds, but in malice be babes; but in [your] minds be grown [men].

title: I Corinthians 14:21
text: ¶It is written in the law, By people of other tongues, and by strange lips, will I speak to this people; and neither thus will they hear me, saith the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 14:22
text: So that tongues are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to unbelievers; but prophecy, not to unbelievers, but to those who believe.

title: I Corinthians 14:23
text: If therefore the whole assembly come together in one place, and all speak with tongues, and simple [persons] enter in, or unbelievers, will not they say ye are mad?

title: I Corinthians 14:24
text: But if all prophesy, and some unbeliever or simple [person] come in, he is convicted of all, he is judged of all;

title: I Corinthians 14:25
text: the secrets of his heart are manifested; and thus, falling upon [his] face, he will do homage to God, reporting that God is indeed amongst you.

title: I Corinthians 14:26
text: ¶What is it then, brethren? whenever ye come together, each [of you] has a psalm, has a teaching, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done to edification.

title: I Corinthians 14:27
text: If any one speak with a tongue, [let it be] two, or at the most three, and separately, and let one interpret;

title: I Corinthians 14:28
text: but if there be no interpreter, let him be silent in [the] assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

title: I Corinthians 14:29
text: And let two or three prophets speak, and let the others judge.

title: I Corinthians 14:30
text: But if there be a revelation to another sitting [there], let the first be silent.

title: I Corinthians 14:31
text: For ye can all prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all be encouraged.

title: I Corinthians 14:32
text: And spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.

title: I Corinthians 14:33
text: For God is not [a God] of disorder but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

title: I Corinthians 14:34
text: ¶Let [your] women be silent in the assemblies, for it is not permitted to them to speak; but to be in subjection, as the law also says.

title: I Corinthians 14:35
text: But if they wish to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is a shame for a woman to speak in assembly.

title: I Corinthians 14:36
text: ¶Did the word of God go out from you, or did it come to you only?

title: I Corinthians 14:37
text: If any one thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognise the things that I write to you, that it is [the] Lord's commandment.

title: I Corinthians 14:38
text: But if any be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

title: I Corinthians 14:39
text: So that, brethren, desire to prophesy, and do not forbid the speaking with tongues.

title: I Corinthians 14:40
text: But let all things be done comelily and with order.

title: I Corinthians 15:1
text: ¶But I make known to you, brethren, the glad tidings which I announced to you, which also ye received, in which also ye stand,

title: I Corinthians 15:2
text: by which also ye are saved, (if ye hold fast the word which I announced to you as the glad tidings,) unless indeed ye have believed in vain.

title: I Corinthians 15:3
text: For I delivered to you, in the first place, what also I had received, that Christ died for our sins, according to the scriptures;

title: I Corinthians 15:4
text: and that he was buried; and that he was raised the third day, according to the scriptures;

title: I Corinthians 15:5
text: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

title: I Corinthians 15:6
text: Then he appeared to above five hundred brethren at once, of whom the most remain until now, but some also have fallen asleep.

title: I Corinthians 15:7
text: Then he appeared to James; then to all the apostles;

title: I Corinthians 15:8
text: and last of all, as to an abortion, he appeared to *me* also.

title: I Corinthians 15:9
text: For *I* am the least of the apostles, who am not fit to be called apostle, because I have persecuted the assembly of God.

title: I Corinthians 15:10
text: But by God's grace I am what I am; and his grace, which [was] towards me, has not been vain; but I have laboured more abundantly than they all, but not *I*, but the grace of God which [was] with me.

title: I Corinthians 15:11
text: Whether, therefore, I or they, thus we preach, and thus ye have believed.

title: I Corinthians 15:12
text: ¶Now if Christ is preached that he is raised from among [the] dead, how say some among you that there is not a resurrection of [those that are] dead?

title: I Corinthians 15:13
text: But if there is not a resurrection of [those that are] dead, neither is Christ raised:

title: I Corinthians 15:14
text: but if Christ is not raised, then, indeed, vain also [is] our preaching, and vain also your faith.

title: I Corinthians 15:15
text: And we are found also false witnesses of God; for we have witnessed concerning God that he raised the Christ, whom he has not raised if indeed [those that are] dead are not raised.

title: I Corinthians 15:16
text: For if [those that are] dead are not raised, neither is Christ raised;

title: I Corinthians 15:17
text: but if Christ be not raised, your faith [is] vain; ye are yet in your sins.

title: I Corinthians 15:18
text: Then indeed also those who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

title: I Corinthians 15:19
text: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are [the] most miserable of all men.

title: I Corinthians 15:20
text: ¶(But now Christ is raised from among [the] dead, first-fruits of those fallen asleep.

title: I Corinthians 15:21
text: For since by man [came] death, by man also resurrection of [those that are] dead.

title: I Corinthians 15:22
text: For as in the Adam all die, thus also in the Christ all shall be made alive.

title: I Corinthians 15:23
text: But each in his own rank: [the] first-fruits, Christ; then those that are the Christ's at his coming.

title: I Corinthians 15:24
text: Then the end, when he gives up the kingdom to him [who is] God and Father; when he shall have annulled all rule and all authority and power.

title: I Corinthians 15:25
text: For he must reign until he put all enemies under his feet.

title: I Corinthians 15:26
text: [The] last enemy [that] is annulled [is] death.

title: I Corinthians 15:27
text: For he has put all things in subjection under his feet. But when he says that all things are put in subjection, [it is] evident that [it is] except him who put all things in subjection to him.

title: I Corinthians 15:28
text: But when all things shall have been brought into subjection to him, then the Son also himself shall be placed in subjection to him who put all things in subjection to him, that God may be all in all.)

title: I Corinthians 15:29
text: Since what shall the baptised for the dead do if [those that are] dead rise not at all? why also are they baptised for them?

title: I Corinthians 15:30
text: Why do *we* also endanger ourselves every hour?

title: I Corinthians 15:31
text: Daily I die, by your boasting which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: I Corinthians 15:32
text: If, [to speak] after the manner of man, I have fought with beasts in Ephesus, what is the profit to me if [those that are] dead do not rise? let us eat and drink; for to-morrow we die.

title: I Corinthians 15:33
text: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

title: I Corinthians 15:34
text: Awake up righteously, and sin not; for some are ignorant of God: I speak to you as a matter of shame.

title: I Corinthians 15:35
text: ¶But some one will say, How are the dead raised? and with what body do they come?

title: I Corinthians 15:36
text: Fool; what *thou* sowest is not quickened unless it die.

title: I Corinthians 15:37
text: And what thou sowest, thou sowest not the body that shall be, but a bare grain: it may be of wheat, or some one of the rest:

title: I Corinthians 15:38
text: and God gives to it a body as he has pleased, and to each of the seeds its own body.

title: I Corinthians 15:39
text: Every flesh [is] not the same flesh, but one [is] of men, and another flesh of beasts, and another [flesh] of birds, and another of fishes.

title: I Corinthians 15:40
text: And [there are] heavenly bodies, and earthly bodies: but different is the glory of the heavenly, different that of the earthly:

title: I Corinthians 15:41
text: one [the] sun's glory, and another [the] moon's glory, and another [the] stars' glory; for star differs from star in glory.

title: I Corinthians 15:42
text: Thus also [is] the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption, it is raised in incorruptibility.

title: I Corinthians 15:43
text: It is sown in dishonour, it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness, it is raised in power.

title: I Corinthians 15:44
text: It is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body: if there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual [one].

title: I Corinthians 15:45
text: Thus also it is written, The first man Adam became a living soul; the last Adam a quickening spirit.

title: I Corinthians 15:46
text: But that which is spiritual [was] not first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual:

title: I Corinthians 15:47
text: the first man out of [the] earth, made of dust; the second man, out of heaven.

title: I Corinthians 15:48
text: Such as he made of dust, such also those made of dust; and such as the heavenly [one], such also the heavenly [ones].

title: I Corinthians 15:49
text: And as we have borne the image of the [one] made of dust, we shall bear also the image of the heavenly [one].

title: I Corinthians 15:50
text: But this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit God's kingdom, nor does corruption inherit incorruptibility.

title: I Corinthians 15:51
text: ¶Behold, I tell you a mystery: We shall not all fall asleep, but we shall all be changed,

title: I Corinthians 15:52
text: in an instant, in [the] twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet; for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and *we* shall be changed.

title: I Corinthians 15:53
text: For this corruptible must needs put on incorruptibility, and this mortal put on immortality.

title: I Corinthians 15:54
text: But when this corruptible shall have put on incorruptibility, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall come to pass the word written: Death has been swallowed up in victory.

title: I Corinthians 15:55
