text: Where, O death, [is] thy sting? where, O death, thy victory?

title: I Corinthians 15:56
text: Now the sting of death [is] sin, and the power of sin the law;

title: I Corinthians 15:57
text: but thanks to God, who gives us the victory by our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 15:58
text: ¶So then, my beloved brethren, be firm, immovable, abounding always in the work of the Lord, knowing that your toil is not in vain in [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 16:1
text: ¶Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I directed the assemblies of Galatia, so do *ye* do also.

title: I Corinthians 16:2
text: On [the] first of [the] week let each of you put by at home, laying up [in] whatever [degree] he may have prospered, that there may be no collections when I come.

title: I Corinthians 16:3
text: And when I am arrived, whomsoever ye shall approve, these I will send with letters to carry your bounty to Jerusalem:

title: I Corinthians 16:4
text: and if it be suitable that *I* also should go, they shall go with me.

title: I Corinthians 16:5
text: ¶But I will come to you when I shall have gone through Macedonia; for I do go through Macedonia.

title: I Corinthians 16:6
text: But perhaps I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that *ye* may set me forward wheresoever I may go.

title: I Corinthians 16:7
text: For I will not see you now in passing, for I hope to remain a certain time with you, if the Lord permit.

title: I Corinthians 16:8
text: But I remain in Ephesus until Pentecost.

title: I Corinthians 16:9
text: For a great door is opened to me and an effectual [one], and [the] adversaries many.

title: I Corinthians 16:10
text: ¶Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear; for he works the work of the Lord, even as I.

title: I Corinthians 16:11
text: Let not therefore any one despise him; but set him forward in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brethren.

title: I Corinthians 16:12
text: Now concerning the brother Apollos, I begged him much that he would go to you with the brethren; but it was not at all [his] will to go now; but he will come when he shall have good opportunity.

title: I Corinthians 16:13
text: ¶Be vigilant; stand fast in the faith; quit yourselves like men; be strong.

title: I Corinthians 16:14
text: Let all things ye do be done in love.

title: I Corinthians 16:15
text: But I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first-fruits of Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the saints for service,)

title: I Corinthians 16:16
text: that *ye* should also be subject to such, and to every one joined in the work and labouring.

title: I Corinthians 16:17
text: But I rejoice in the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus; because *they* have supplied what was lacking on your part.

title: I Corinthians 16:18
text: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: own therefore such.

title: I Corinthians 16:19
text: ¶The assemblies of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla, with the assembly in their house, salute you much in [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 16:20
text: All the brethren salute you. Salute one another with a holy kiss.

title: I Corinthians 16:21
text: The salutation of [me] Paul with my own hand.

title: I Corinthians 16:22
text: If any one love not the Lord [Jesus Christ] let him be Anathema Maranatha.

title: I Corinthians 16:23
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you.

title: I Corinthians 16:24
text: My love [be] with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

title: II Corinthians 1:1
text: ¶Paul, apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, and the brother Timotheus, to the assembly of God which is in Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia.

title: II Corinthians 1:2
text: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father, and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Corinthians 1:3
text: ¶Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassions, and God of all encouragement;

title: II Corinthians 1:4
text: who encourages us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to encourage those who are in any tribulation whatever, through the encouragement with which we ourselves are encouraged of God.

title: II Corinthians 1:5
text: Because, even as the sufferings of the Christ abound towards us, so through the Christ does our encouragement also abound.

title: II Corinthians 1:6
text: But whether we are in tribulation, [it is] for your encouragement and salvation, wrought in the endurance of the same sufferings which *we* also suffer,

title: II Corinthians 1:7
text: ¶(and our hope for you [is] sure;) or whether we are encouraged, [it is] for your encouragement and salvation: knowing that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so also of the encouragement.

title: II Corinthians 1:8
text: For we do not wish you to be ignorant, brethren, as to our tribulation which happened [to us] in Asia, that we were excessively pressed beyond [our] power, so as to despair even of living.

title: II Corinthians 1:9
text: But we ourselves had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not have our trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead;

title: II Corinthians 1:10
text: who has delivered us from so great a death, and does deliver; in whom we confide that he will also yet deliver;

title: II Corinthians 1:11
text: ye also labouring together by supplication for us that the gift towards us, through means of many persons, may be the subject of the thanksgiving of many for us.

title: II Corinthians 1:12
text: ¶For our boasting is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and sincerity before God, (not in fleshly wisdom but in God's grace,) we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly towards you.

title: II Corinthians 1:13
text: For we do not write other things to you but what ye well know and recognise; and I hope that ye will recognise to the end,

title: II Corinthians 1:14
text: even as also ye have recognised us in part, that we are your boast, even as *ye* [are] ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

title: II Corinthians 1:15
text: ¶And with this confidence I purposed to come to you previously, that ye might have a second favour;

title: II Corinthians 1:16
text: and to pass through to Macedonia by you, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be set forward by you to Judaea.

title: II Corinthians 1:17
text: Having therefore this purpose, did I then use lightness? Or what I purpose, do I purpose according to flesh, that there should be with me yea yea, and nay nay?

title: II Corinthians 1:18
text: Now God [is] faithful, that our word to you is not yea and nay.

title: II Corinthians 1:19
text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, he who has been preached by us among you (by me and Silvanus and Timotheus), did not become yea and nay, but yea *is* in him.

title: II Corinthians 1:20
text: For whatever promises of God [there are], in him is the yea, and in him the amen, for glory to God by us.

title: II Corinthians 1:21
text: Now he that establishes us with you in Christ, and has anointed us, [is] God,

title: II Corinthians 1:22
text: who also has sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

title: II Corinthians 1:23
text: But I call God to witness upon my soul that to spare you I have not yet come to Corinth.

title: II Corinthians 1:24
text: Not that we rule over your faith, but are fellow-workmen of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

title: II Corinthians 2:1
text: ¶But I have judged this with myself, not to come back to you in grief.

title: II Corinthians 2:2
text: For if *I* grieve you, who also [is] it that gladdens me, if not he that is grieved through me?

title: II Corinthians 2:3
text: And I have written this very [letter] [to you], that coming I may not have grief from those from whom I ought to have joy; trusting in you all that my joy is [that] of you all.

title: II Corinthians 2:4
text: For out of much tribulation and distress of heart I wrote to you, with many tears; not that ye may be grieved, but that ye may know the love which I have very abundantly towards you.

title: II Corinthians 2:5
text: ¶But if any one has grieved, he has grieved, not me, but in part (that I may not overcharge [you]) all of you.

title: II Corinthians 2:6
text: Sufficient to such a one [is] this rebuke which [has been inflicted] by the many;

title: II Corinthians 2:7
text: so that on the contrary ye should rather shew grace and encourage, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with excessive grief.

title: II Corinthians 2:8
text: Wherefore I exhort you to assure him of [your] love.

title: II Corinthians 2:9
text: For to this end also I have written, that I might know, by putting you to the test, if as to everything ye are obedient.

title: II Corinthians 2:10
text: But to whom ye forgive anything, *I* also; for I also, what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, [it is] for your sakes in [the] person of Christ;

title: II Corinthians 2:11
text: that we might not have Satan get an advantage against us, for we are not ignorant of *his* thoughts.

title: II Corinthians 2:12
text: ¶Now when I came to Troas for the [publication of the] glad tidings of the Christ, a door also being opened to me in [the] Lord,

title: II Corinthians 2:13
text: I had no rest in my spirit at not finding Titus my brother; but bidding them adieu, I came away to Macedonia.

title: II Corinthians 2:14
text: But thanks [be] to God, who always leads us in triumph in the Christ, and makes manifest the odour of his knowledge through us in every place.

title: II Corinthians 2:15
text: For we are a sweet odour of Christ to God, in the saved and in those that perish:

title: II Corinthians 2:16
text: to the one an odour from death unto death, but to the others an odour from life unto life; and who [is] sufficient for these things?

title: II Corinthians 2:17
text: For we do not, as the many, make a trade of the word of God; but as of sincerity, but as of God, before God, we speak in Christ.

title: II Corinthians 3:1
text: ¶Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or do we need, as some, commendatory letters to you, or [commendatory] from you?

title: II Corinthians 3:2
text: *Ye* are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read of all men,

title: II Corinthians 3:3
text: being manifested to be Christ's epistle ministered by us, written, not with ink, but [the] Spirit of [the] living God; not on stone tables, but on fleshy tables of [the] heart.

title: II Corinthians 3:4
text: And such confidence have we through the Christ towards God:

title: II Corinthians 3:5
text: not that we are competent of ourselves to think anything as of ourselves, but our competency [is] of God;

title: II Corinthians 3:6
text: ¶who has also made us competent, [as] ministers of [the] new covenant; not of letter, but of spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit quickens.

title: II Corinthians 3:7
text: (But if the ministry of death, in letters, graven in stones, began with glory, so that the children of Israel could not fix their eyes on the face of Moses, on account of the glory of his face, [a glory] which is annulled;

title: II Corinthians 3:8
text: how shall not rather the ministry of the Spirit subsist in glory?

title: II Corinthians 3:9
text: For if the ministry of condemnation [be] glory, much rather the ministry of righteousness abounds in glory.

title: II Corinthians 3:10
text: For also that [which was] glorified is not glorified in this respect, on account of the surpassing glory.

title: II Corinthians 3:11
text: For if that annulled [was introduced] with glory, much rather that which abides [subsists] in glory.

title: II Corinthians 3:12
text: ¶Having therefore such hope, we use much boldness:

title: II Corinthians 3:13
text: and not according as Moses put a veil on his own face, so that the children of Israel should not fix their eyes on the end of that annulled.

title: II Corinthians 3:14
text: But their thoughts have been darkened, for unto this day the same veil remains in reading the old covenant, unremoved, which in Christ is annulled.

title: II Corinthians 3:15
text: But unto this day, when Moses is read, the veil lies upon their heart.

title: II Corinthians 3:16
text: But when it shall turn to [the] Lord, the veil is taken away.)

title: II Corinthians 3:17
text: Now the Lord is the Spirit, but where the Spirit of [the] Lord [is, there is] liberty.

title: II Corinthians 3:18
text: But *we* all, looking on the glory of the Lord, with unveiled face, are transformed according to the same image from glory to glory, even as by [the] Lord [the] Spirit.

title: II Corinthians 4:1
text: ¶Therefore, having this ministry, as we have had mercy shewn us, we faint not.

title: II Corinthians 4:2
text: But we have rejected the hidden things of shame, not walking in deceit, nor falsifying the word of God, but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every conscience of men before God.

title: II Corinthians 4:3
text: But if also our gospel is veiled, it is veiled in those that are lost;

title: II Corinthians 4:4
text: in whom the god of this world has blinded the thoughts of the unbelieving, so that the radiancy of the glad tidings of the glory of the Christ, who is [the] image of God, should not shine forth [for them].

title: II Corinthians 4:5
text: For we do not preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus Lord, and ourselves your bondmen for Jesus' sake.

title: II Corinthians 4:6
text: Because [it is] the God who spoke that out of darkness light should shine who has shone in our hearts for the shining forth of the knowledge of the glory of God in [the] face of [Jesus] Christ.

title: II Corinthians 4:7
text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the surpassingness of the power may be of God, and not from us:

title: II Corinthians 4:8
text: ¶every way afflicted, but not straitened; seeing no apparent issue, but our way not entirely shut up;

title: II Corinthians 4:9
text: persecuted, but not abandoned; cast down, but not destroyed;

title: II Corinthians 4:10
text: always bearing about in the body the dying of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our body;

title: II Corinthians 4:11
text: for we who live are always delivered unto death on account of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our mortal flesh;

title: II Corinthians 4:12
text: so that death works in us, but life in you.

title: II Corinthians 4:13
text: And having the same spirit of faith, according to what is written, I have believed, therefore have I spoken; *we* also believe, therefore also we speak;

title: II Corinthians 4:14
text: knowing that he who has raised the Lord Jesus shall raise us also with Jesus, and shall present [us] with you.

title: II Corinthians 4:15
text: For all things [are] for your sakes, that the grace abounding through the many may cause thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

title: II Corinthians 4:16
text: Wherefore we faint not; but if indeed our outward man is consumed, yet the inward is renewed day by day.

title: II Corinthians 4:17
text: For our momentary [and] light affliction works for us in surpassing measure an eternal weight of glory;

title: II Corinthians 4:18
text: while we look not at the things that are seen, but at the things that are not seen; for the things that are seen [are] for a time, but those that are not seen eternal.

title: II Corinthians 5:1
text: ¶For we know that if our earthly tabernacle house be destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

title: II Corinthians 5:2
text: For indeed in this we groan, ardently desiring to have put on our house which [is] from heaven;

title: II Corinthians 5:3
text: if indeed being also clothed we shall not be found naked.

title: II Corinthians 5:4
text: For indeed we who are in the tabernacle groan, being burdened; while yet we do not wish to be unclothed, but clothed, that [what is] mortal may be swallowed up by life.

title: II Corinthians 5:5
text: Now he that has wrought us for this very thing [is] God, who also has given to us the earnest of the Spirit.

title: II Corinthians 5:6
text: Therefore [we are] always confident, and know that while present in the body we are absent from the Lord,

title: II Corinthians 5:7
text: (for we walk by faith, not by sight;)

title: II Corinthians 5:8
text: we are confident, I say, and pleased rather to be absent from the body and present with the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 5:9
text: Wherefore also we are zealous, whether present or absent, to be agreeable to him.

title: II Corinthians 5:10
text: For we must all be manifested before the judgment-seat of the Christ, that each may receive the things [done] in the body, according to those he has done, whether [it be] good or evil.

title: II Corinthians 5:11
text: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord we persuade men, but have been manifested to God, and I hope also that we have been manifested in your consciences.

title: II Corinthians 5:12
text: ¶[For] we do not again commend ourselves to you, but [we are] giving to you occasion of boast in our behalf, that ye may have [such] with those boasting in countenance, and not in heart.

title: II Corinthians 5:13
text: For whether we are beside ourselves, [it is] to God; or are sober, [it is] for you.

title: II Corinthians 5:14
text: For the love of the Christ constrains us, having judged this: that one died for all, then all have died;

title: II Corinthians 5:15
text: and he died for all, that they who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who died for them and has been raised.

title: II Corinthians 5:16
text: ¶So that *we* henceforth know no one according to flesh; but if even we have known Christ according to flesh, yet now we know [him thus] no longer.

title: II Corinthians 5:17
text: So if any one [be] in Christ, [there is] a new creation; the old things have passed away; behold all things have become new:

title: II Corinthians 5:18
text: and all things [are] of the God who has reconciled us to himself by [Jesus] Christ, and given to us the ministry of that reconciliation:

title: II Corinthians 5:19
text: how that God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their offences; and putting in us the word of that reconciliation.

title: II Corinthians 5:20
text: We are ambassadors therefore for Christ, God as [it were] beseeching by us, we entreat for Christ, Be reconciled to God.

title: II Corinthians 5:21
text: Him who knew not sin he has made sin for us, that *we* might become God's righteousness in him.

title: II Corinthians 6:1
text: ¶But [as] fellow-workmen, we also beseech that ye receive not the grace of God in vain:

title: II Corinthians 6:2
text: (for he says, I have listened to thee in an accepted time, and I have helped thee in a day of salvation: behold, now [is the] well-accepted time; behold, now [the] day of salvation:)

title: II Corinthians 6:3
text: giving no manner of offence in anything, that the ministry be not blamed;

title: II Corinthians 6:4
text: but in everything commending ourselves as God's ministers, in much endurance, in afflictions, in necessities, in straits,

title: II Corinthians 6:5
text: in stripes, in prisons, in riots, in labours, in watchings, in fastings,

title: II Corinthians 6:6
text: in pureness, in knowledge, in longsuffering, in kindness, in [the] Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,

title: II Corinthians 6:7
text: in [the] word of truth, in [the] power of God; through the arms of righteousness on the right hand and left,

title: II Corinthians 6:8
text: through glory and dishonour, through evil report and good report: as deceivers, and true;

title: II Corinthians 6:9
text: as unknown, and well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as disciplined, and not put to death;

title: II Corinthians 6:10
text: as grieved, but always rejoicing; as poor, but enriching many; as having nothing, and possessing all things.

title: II Corinthians 6:11
text: ¶Our mouth is opened to you, Corinthians, our heart is expanded.

title: II Corinthians 6:12
text: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your affections;

title: II Corinthians 6:13
text: but for an answering recompense, (I speak as to children,) let *your* heart also expand itself.

title: II Corinthians 6:14
text: Be not diversely yoked with unbelievers; for what participation [is there] between righteousness and lawlessness? or what fellowship of light with darkness?

title: II Corinthians 6:15
text: and what consent of Christ with Beliar, or what part for a believer along with an unbeliever?

title: II Corinthians 6:16
text: and what agreement of God's temple with idols? for *ye* are [the] living God's temple; according as God has said, I will dwell among them, and walk among [them]; and I will be their God, and they shall be to me a people.

title: II Corinthians 6:17
text: Wherefore come out from the midst of them, and be separated, saith [the] Lord, and touch not [what is] unclean, and *I* will receive you;

title: II Corinthians 6:18
text: and I will be to you for a Father, and ye shall be to me for sons and daughters, saith [the] Lord Almighty.

title: II Corinthians 7:1
text: ¶Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us purify ourselves from every pollution of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in God's fear.

title: II Corinthians 7:2
text: Receive us: we have injured no one, we have ruined no one, we have made gain of no one.

title: II Corinthians 7:3
text: I do not speak for condemnation, for I have already said that ye are in our hearts, to die together, and live together.

title: II Corinthians 7:4
text: Great [is] my boldness towards you, great my exulting in respect of you; I am filled with encouragement; I overabound in joy under all our affliction.

title: II Corinthians 7:5
text: ¶For indeed, when we came into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but [we were] afflicted in every way; without combats, within fears.

title: II Corinthians 7:6
text: But he who encourages those that are [brought] low, [even] God, encouraged us by the coming of Titus;

title: II Corinthians 7:7
text: and not by his coming only, but also through the encouragement with which he was encouraged as to you; relating to us your ardent desire, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I the more rejoiced.

title: II Corinthians 7:8
text: For if also I grieved you in the letter, I do not regret [it], if even I have regretted it; for I see that that letter, if even [it were] only for a time, grieved you.

title: II Corinthians 7:9
text: Now I rejoice, not that ye have been grieved, but that ye have been grieved to repentance; for ye have been grieved according to God, that in nothing ye might be injured by us.

title: II Corinthians 7:10
text: For grief according to God works repentance to salvation, never to be regretted; but the grief of the world works death.

title: II Corinthians 7:11
text: For, behold, this same thing, your being grieved according to God, how much diligence it wrought in *you*, but [what] excusing [of yourselves], but [what] indignation, but [what] fear, but [what] ardent desire, but [what] zeal, but [what] vengeance: in every way ye have proved yourselves to be pure in the matter.

title: II Corinthians 7:12
text: ¶So then, if also I wrote to you, [it was] not for the sake of him that injured, nor for the sake of him that was injured, but for the sake of our diligent zeal for you being manifested to you before God.

title: II Corinthians 7:13
text: For this reason we have been encouraged. And we the rather rejoiced in our encouragement more abundantly by reason of the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

title: II Corinthians 7:14
text: Because if I boasted to him anything about you, I have not been put to shame; but as we have spoken to you all things in truth, so also our boasting to Titus has been [the] truth;

title: II Corinthians 7:15
text: and his affections are more abundantly towards you, calling to mind the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

title: II Corinthians 7:16
text: I rejoice that in everything I am confident as to you.

title: II Corinthians 8:1
text: ¶But we make known to you, brethren, the grace of God bestowed in the assemblies of Macedonia;

title: II Corinthians 8:2
text: that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty has abounded to the riches of their [free-hearted] liberality.

title: II Corinthians 8:3
text: For according to [their] power, I bear witness, and beyond [their] power, [they were] willing of their own accord,

title: II Corinthians 8:4
text: begging of us with much entreaty [to give effect to] the grace and fellowship of the service which [was to be rendered] to the saints.

title: II Corinthians 8:5
text: And not according as we hoped, but they gave themselves first to the Lord, and to us by God's will.

title: II Corinthians 8:6
text: So that we begged Titus that, according as he had before begun, so he would also complete as to you this grace also;

title: II Corinthians 8:7
text: ¶but even as ye abound in every way, in faith, and word, and knowledge, and all diligence, and in love from you to us, that ye may abound in this grace also.

title: II Corinthians 8:8
text: I do not speak as commanding [it], but through the zeal of others, and proving the genuineness of your love.

title: II Corinthians 8:9
text: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that for your sakes he, being rich, became poor, in order that *ye* by *his* poverty might be enriched.

title: II Corinthians 8:10
text: And I give [my] opinion in this, for this is profitable for you who began before, not only to do, but also to be willing, a year ago.

title: II Corinthians 8:11
text: But now also complete the doing of it; so that as [there was] the readiness to be willing, so also to complete out of what ye have.

title: II Corinthians 8:12
text: For if the readiness be there, [a man is] accepted according to what he may have, not according to what he has not.

title: II Corinthians 8:13
text: For [it is] not in order that there may be ease for others, and for you distress,

title: II Corinthians 8:14
text: but [on the principle] of equality; in the present time your abundance for their lack, that their abundance may be for your lack, so that there should be equality.

title: II Corinthians 8:15
text: According as it is written, He who [gathered] much had no excess, and he who [gathered] little was nothing short.

title: II Corinthians 8:16
text: ¶But thanks [be] to God, who gives the same diligent zeal for you in the heart of Titus.

title: II Corinthians 8:17
text: For he received indeed the entreaty, but, being full of zeal, he went of his own accord to you;

title: II Corinthians 8:18
text: but we have sent with him the brother whose praise [is] in the glad tidings through all the assemblies;

title: II Corinthians 8:19
text: and not only [so], but [is] also chosen by the assemblies as our fellow-traveller with this grace, ministered by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and [a witness of] our readiness;

title: II Corinthians 8:20
text: avoiding this, that any one should blame us in this abundance [which is] administered by us;

title: II Corinthians 8:21
text: for we provide for things honest, not only before [the] Lord, but also before men.

title: II Corinthians 8:22
text: And we have sent with them our brother whom we have often proved to be of diligent zeal in many things, and now more diligently zealous through the great confidence [he has] as to you.

title: II Corinthians 8:23
text: Whether as regards Titus, [he is] my companion and fellow-labourer in your behalf; or our brethren, [they are] deputed messengers of assemblies, Christ's glory.

title: II Corinthians 8:24
text: Shew therefore to them, before the assemblies, the proof of your love, and of our boasting about you.

title: II Corinthians 9:1
text: ¶For concerning the ministration which [is] for the saints, it is superfluous my writing to you.

title: II Corinthians 9:2
text: For I know your readiness, which I boast of as respects you to Macedonians, that Achaia is prepared since a year ago, and the zeal [reported] of you has stimulated the mass [of the brethren].

title: II Corinthians 9:3
text: But I have sent the brethren, in order that our boasting about you may not be made void in this respect, in order that, as I have said, ye may be prepared;

title: II Corinthians 9:4
text: lest haply, if Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, *we*, that we say not *ye*, may be put to shame in this confidence.

title: II Corinthians 9:5
text: I thought it necessary therefore to beg the brethren that they would come to you, and complete beforehand your fore-announced blessing, that this may be ready thus as blessing, and not as got out of you.

title: II Corinthians 9:6
text: ¶But this [is true], he that sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he that sows in [the spirit of] blessing shall reap also in blessing:

title: II Corinthians 9:7
text: each according as he is purposed in his heart; not grievingly, or of necessity; for God loves a cheerful giver.

title: II Corinthians 9:8
text: But God is able to make every gracious gift abound towards you, that, having in every way always all-sufficiency, ye may abound to every good work:

title: II Corinthians 9:9
text: according as it is written, He has scattered abroad, he has given to the poor, his righteousness remains for ever.

title: II Corinthians 9:10
text: Now he that supplies seed to the sower and bread for eating shall supply and make abundant your sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness:

title: II Corinthians 9:11
text: enriched in every way unto all free-hearted liberality, which works through us thanksgiving to God.

title: II Corinthians 9:12
text: Because the ministration of this service is not only filling up the measure of what is lacking to the saints, but also abounding by many thanksgivings to God;

title: II Corinthians 9:13
text: they glorifying God through the proof of this ministration, by reason of your subjection, by profession, to the glad tidings of the Christ, and your free-hearted liberality in communicating towards them and towards all;

title: II Corinthians 9:14
text: and in their supplication for you, full of ardent desire for you, on account of the exceeding grace of God [which is] upon you.

title: II Corinthians 9:15
text: Thanks [be] to God for his unspeakable free gift.

title: II Corinthians 10:1
text: ¶But I myself, Paul, entreat you by the meekness and gentleness of the Christ, who, as to appearance, [when present] [am] mean among you, but absent am bold towards you;

title: II Corinthians 10:2
text: but I beseech that present I may not be bold with the confidence with which I think to be daring towards some who think of us as walking according to flesh.

title: II Corinthians 10:3
text: For walking in flesh, we do not war according to flesh.

title: II Corinthians 10:4
text: For the arms of our warfare [are] not fleshly, but powerful according to God to [the] overthrow of strongholds;

title: II Corinthians 10:5
text: overthrowing reasonings and every high thing that lifts itself up against the knowledge of God, and leading captive every thought into the obedience of the Christ;

title: II Corinthians 10:6
text: and having in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience shall have been fulfilled.

title: II Corinthians 10:7
text: ¶Do ye look at what concerns appearance? If any one has confidence in himself that he is of Christ, let him think this again in himself, that even as he [is] of Christ, so also [are] we.

title: II Corinthians 10:8
text: For and if I should boast even somewhat more abundantly of our authority, which the Lord has given [to us] for building up and not for your overthrowing, I shall not be put to shame;

title: II Corinthians 10:9
text: that I may not seem as if I was frightening you by letters:

title: II Corinthians 10:10
text: because his letters, he says, [are] weighty and strong, but his presence in the body weak, and his speech naught.

title: II Corinthians 10:11
text: Let such a one think this, that such as we are in word by letters [when] absent, such also present in deed.

title: II Corinthians 10:12
text: ¶For we dare not class ourselves or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves; but these, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are not intelligent.

title: II Corinthians 10:13
text: Now *we* will not boast out of measure, but according to the measure of the rule which the God of measure has apportioned to us, to reach to you also.

title: II Corinthians 10:14
text: For we do not, as not reaching to you, overstretch ourselves, (for we have come to you also in the glad tidings of the Christ;)

title: II Corinthians 10:15
text: not boasting out of measure in other people's labours, but having hope, your faith increasing, to be enlarged amongst you, according to our rule, yet more abundantly

title: II Corinthians 10:16
text: to announce the glad tidings to that [which is] beyond you, not to be boasting in another's rule of things made ready to hand.

title: II Corinthians 10:17
text: But he that boasts, let him boast in the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 10:18
text: For not *he* that commends himself is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

title: II Corinthians 11:1
text: ¶Would that ye would bear with me [in] a little folly; but indeed bear with me.

title: II Corinthians 11:2
text: For I am jealous as to you with a jealousy [which is] of God; for I have espoused you unto one man, to present [you] a chaste virgin to Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:3
text: But I fear lest by any means, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craft, [so] your thoughts should be corrupted from simplicity as to the Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:4
text: For if indeed he that comes preaches another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or ye get a different Spirit, which ye have not got, or a different glad tidings, which ye have not received, ye might well bear with [it].

title: II Corinthians 11:5
text: ¶For I reckon that in nothing I am behind those who are in surpassing degree apostles.

title: II Corinthians 11:6
text: But if [I am] a simple person in speech, yet not in knowledge, but in everything making [the truth] manifest in all things to you.

title: II Corinthians 11:7
text: Have I committed sin, abasing myself in order that *ye* might be exalted, because I gratuitously announced to you the glad tidings of God?

title: II Corinthians 11:8
text: I spoiled other assemblies, receiving hire for ministry towards you.

title: II Corinthians 11:9
text: And being present with you and lacking, I did not lazily burden any one, (for the brethren who came from Macedonia supplied what I lacked,) and in everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, and will keep myself.

title: II Corinthians 11:10
text: [The] truth of Christ is in me that this boasting shall not be stopped as to me in the regions of Achaia.

title: II Corinthians 11:11
text: Why? because I do not love you? God knows.

title: II Corinthians 11:12
text: But what I do, I will also do, that I may cut off the opportunity of those wishing [for] an opportunity, that wherein they boast they may be found even as we.

title: II Corinthians 11:13
text: For such [are] false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:14
text: And [it is] not wonderful, for Satan himself transforms himself into an angel of light.

title: II Corinthians 11:15
text: It is no great thing therefore if his ministers also transform themselves as ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

title: II Corinthians 11:16
text: ¶Again I say, Let not any one think me to be a fool; but if otherwise, receive me then even as a fool, that *I* also may boast myself some little.

title: II Corinthians 11:17
text: What I speak I do not speak according to [the] Lord, but as in folly, in this confidence of boasting.

title: II Corinthians 11:18
text: Since many boast according to flesh, *I* also will boast.

title: II Corinthians 11:19
text: For ye bear fools readily, being wise.

title: II Corinthians 11:20
text: For ye bear if any one bring you into bondage, if any one devour [you], if any one get [your money], if any one exalt himself, if any one beat you on the face.

title: II Corinthians 11:21
text: I speak as to dishonour, as though *we* had been weak; but wherein any one is daring, (I speak in folly,) *I* also am daring.

title: II Corinthians 11:22
text: ¶Are they Hebrews? *I* also. Are they Israelites? *I* also. Are they seed of Abraham? *I* also.

title: II Corinthians 11:23
text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as being beside myself) *I* above measure [so]; in labours exceedingly abundant, in stripes to excess, in prisons exceedingly abundant, in deaths oft.

title: II Corinthians 11:24
text: From the Jews five times have I received forty [stripes], save one.

title: II Corinthians 11:25
text: Thrice have I been scourged, once I have been stoned, three times I have suffered shipwreck, a night and day I passed in the deep:

title: II Corinthians 11:26
text: in journeyings often, in perils of rivers, in perils of robbers, in perils from [my own] race, in perils from [the] nations, in perils in [the] city, in perils in [the] desert, in perils on [the] sea, in perils among false brethren;

title: II Corinthians 11:27
text: in labour and toil, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

title: II Corinthians 11:28
text: Besides those things that are without, the crowd [of cares] pressing on me daily, the burden of all the assemblies.

title: II Corinthians 11:29
text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is stumbled, and I burn not?

title: II Corinthians 11:30
text: If it is needful to boast, I will boast in the things which concern my infirmity.

title: II Corinthians 11:31
text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus knows--he who is blessed for ever--that I do not lie.

title: II Corinthians 11:32
text: In Damascus the ethnarch of Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes shut up, wishing to take me;

title: II Corinthians 11:33
text: and through a window in a basket I was let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

title: II Corinthians 12:1
text: ¶Well, it is not of profit to me to boast, for I will come to visions and revelations of [the] Lord.

title: II Corinthians 12:2
text: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago, (whether in [the] body I know not, or out of the body I know not, God knows;) such [a one] caught up to [the] third heaven.

title: II Corinthians 12:3
text: And I know such a man, (whether in [the] body or out of the body I know not, God knows;)

title: II Corinthians 12:4
text: that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable things said which it is not allowed to man to utter.

title: II Corinthians 12:5
text: Of such [a one] I will boast, but of myself I will not boast, unless in my weaknesses.

title: II Corinthians 12:6
text: For if I shall desire to boast, I shall not be a fool; for I will say [the] truth; but I forbear, lest any one should think as to me above what he sees me [to be], or whatever he may hear of me.

title: II Corinthians 12:7
text: And that I might not be exalted by the exceeding greatness of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn for the flesh, a messenger of Satan that he might buffet me, that I might not be exalted.

title: II Corinthians 12:8
text: For this I thrice besought the Lord that it might depart from me.

title: II Corinthians 12:9
text: And he said to me, My grace suffices thee; for [my] power is perfected in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather boast in my weaknesses, that the power of the Christ may dwell upon me.

title: II Corinthians 12:10
text: Wherefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in insults, in necessities, in persecutions, in straits, for Christ: for when I am weak, then I am powerful.

title: II Corinthians 12:11
text: ¶I have become a fool; *ye* have compelled me; for *I* ought to have been commended by you; for I have been nothing behind those who were in surpassing degree apostles, if also I am nothing.

title: II Corinthians 12:12
text: The signs indeed of the apostle were wrought among you in all endurance, signs, and wonders, and works of power.

title: II Corinthians 12:13
text: For in what is it that ye have been inferior to the other assemblies, unless that I myself have not been in laziness a charge upon you? Forgive me this injury.

title: II Corinthians 12:14
text: Behold, this third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be in laziness a charge; for I do not seek yours, but you; for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

title: II Corinthians 12:15
text: Now *I* shall most gladly spend and be utterly spent for your souls, if even in abundantly loving you I should be less loved.

title: II Corinthians 12:16
text: But be it so. *I* did not burden you, but being crafty I took you by guile.

title: II Corinthians 12:17
text: Did I make gain of you by any of those whom I have sent to you?

title: II Corinthians 12:18
text: I begged Titus, and sent the brother with [him]: did Titus at all make gain of you? have we not walked in the same spirit? [have we] not in the same steps?

title: II Corinthians 12:19
text: Ye have long been supposing that we excuse ourselves to you: we speak before God in Christ; and all things, beloved, for your building up.

title: II Corinthians 12:20
text: For I fear lest perhaps coming I find you not such as I wish, and that *I* be found by you such as ye do not wish: lest [there might be] strifes, jealousies, angers, contentions, evil speakings, whisperings, puffings up, disturbances;

title: II Corinthians 12:21
text: lest my God should humble me as to you when I come again, and that I shall grieve over many of those who have sinned before, and have not repented as to the uncleanness and fornication and licentiousness which they have practised.

title: II Corinthians 13:1
text: ¶This third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every matter be established.

title: II Corinthians 13:2
text: I have declared beforehand, and I say beforehand as present the second time, and now absent, to those that have sinned before, and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare.

title: II Corinthians 13:3
text: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, (who is not weak towards you, but is powerful among you,

title: II Corinthians 13:4
text: for if indeed he has been crucified in weakness, yet he lives by God's power; for indeed *we* are weak in him, but we shall live with him by God's power towards you,)

title: II Corinthians 13:5
text: examine your own selves if ye be in the faith; prove your own selves: do ye not recognise yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you, unless indeed ye be reprobates?

title: II Corinthians 13:6
text: Now I hope that ye will know that *we* are not reprobates.

title: II Corinthians 13:7
text: ¶But we pray to God that ye may do nothing evil; not that *we* may appear approved, but that *ye* may do what is right, and *we* be as reprobates.

title: II Corinthians 13:8
text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

title: II Corinthians 13:9
text: For we rejoice when *we* may be weak and *ye* may be powerful. But this also we pray for, your perfecting.

title: II Corinthians 13:10
text: On this account I write these things being absent, that being present I may not use severity according to the authority which the Lord has given me for building up, and not for overthrowing.

title: II Corinthians 13:11
text: ¶For the rest, brethren, rejoice; be perfected; be encouraged; be of one mind; be at peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

title: II Corinthians 13:12
text: Salute one another with a holy kiss.

title: II Corinthians 13:13
text: All the saints salute you.

title: II Corinthians 13:14
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, [be] with you all.

title: Galatians 1:1
text: ¶Paul, apostle, not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God [the] Father who raised him from among [the] dead,

title: Galatians 1:2
text: and all the brethren with me, to the assemblies of Galatia.

title: Galatians 1:3
text: Grace to you, and peace, from God [the] Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Galatians 1:4
text: who gave himself for our sins, so that he should deliver us out of the present evil world, according to the will of our God and Father;

title: Galatians 1:5
text: to whom [be] glory to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: Galatians 1:6
text: ¶I wonder that ye thus quickly change, from him that called you in Christ's grace, to a different gospel,

title: Galatians 1:7
text: which is not another [one]; but there are some that trouble you, and desire to pervert the glad tidings of the Christ.

title: Galatians 1:8
text: But if even *we* or an angel out of heaven announce as glad tidings to you [anything] besides what we have announced as glad tidings to you, let him be accursed.

title: Galatians 1:9
text: As we have said before, now also again I say, If any one announce to you as glad tidings [anything] besides what ye have received, let him be accursed.

title: Galatians 1:10
text: ¶For do I now seek to satisfy men or God? or do I seek to please men? If I were yet pleasing men, I were not Christ's bondman.

title: Galatians 1:11
text: But I let you know, brethren, [as to] the glad tidings which were announced by me, that they are not according to man.

title: Galatians 1:12
text: For neither did I receive them from man, neither was I taught [them], but by revelation of Jesus Christ.

title: Galatians 1:13
text: For ye have heard [what was] my conversation formerly in Judaism, that I excessively persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it;

title: Galatians 1:14
text: and advanced in Judaism beyond many [my] contemporaries in my nation, being exceedingly zealous of the doctrines of my fathers.

title: Galatians 1:15
text: But when God, who set me apart [even] from my mother's womb, and called [me] by his grace,

title: Galatians 1:16
text: was pleased to reveal his Son in me, that I may announce him as glad tidings among the nations, immediately I took not counsel with flesh and blood,

title: Galatians 1:17
text: nor went I up to Jerusalem to those [who were] apostles before me; but I went to Arabia, and again returned to Damascus.

title: Galatians 1:18
text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to make acquaintance with Peter, and I remained with him fifteen days;

title: Galatians 1:19
text: but I saw none other of the apostles, but James the brother of the Lord.

title: Galatians 1:20
text: Now what I write to you, behold, before God, I do not lie.

title: Galatians 1:21
text: Then I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

title: Galatians 1:22
text: But I was unknown personally to the assemblies of Judaea which [are] in Christ;

title: Galatians 1:23
text: only they were hearing that he who persecuted us formerly now announces the glad tidings of the faith which formerly he ravaged:

title: Galatians 1:24
text: and they glorified God in me.

title: Galatians 2:1
text: ¶Then after a lapse of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with [me];

title: Galatians 2:2
text: and I went up according to revelation, and I laid before them the glad tidings which I preach among the nations, but privately to those conspicuous [among them], lest in any way I run or had run in vain;

title: Galatians 2:3
text: (but neither was Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, compelled to be circumcised;)

title: Galatians 2:4
text: and [it was] on account of the false brethren brought in surreptitiously, who came in surreptitiously to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

title: Galatians 2:5
text: to whom we yielded in subjection not even for an hour, that the truth of the glad tidings might remain with you.

title: Galatians 2:6
text: But from those who were conspicuous as being somewhat--whatsoever they were, it makes no difference to me: God does not accept man's person; for to me those who were conspicuous communicated nothing;

title: Galatians 2:7
text: but, on the contrary, seeing that the glad tidings of the uncircumcision were confided to me, even as to Peter that of the circumcision,

title: Galatians 2:8
text: (for he that wrought in Peter for [the] apostleship of the circumcision wrought also in me towards the Gentiles,)

title: Galatians 2:9
text: and recognising the grace given to me, James and Cephas and John, who were conspicuous as being pillars, gave to me and Barnabas [the] right hands of fellowship, that *we* [should go] to the nations, and *they* to the circumcision;

title: Galatians 2:10
text: only that we should remember the poor, which same thing also I was diligent to do.

title: Galatians 2:11
text: ¶But when Peter came to Antioch, I withstood him to [the] face, because he was to be condemned:

title: Galatians 2:12
text: for before that certain came from James, he ate with [those of] the nations; but when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those of [the] circumcision;

title: Galatians 2:13
text: and the rest of the Jews also played the same dissembling part with him; so that even Barnabas was carried away too by their dissimulation.

title: Galatians 2:14
text: But when I saw that they do not walk straightforwardly, according to the truth of the glad tidings, I said to Peter before all, If *thou*, being a Jew, livest as the nations and not as the Jews, how dost thou compel the nations to Judaize?

title: Galatians 2:15
text: We, Jews by nature, and not sinners of [the] nations,

title: Galatians 2:16
text: but knowing that a man is not justified on the principle of works of law [nor] but by the faith of Jesus Christ, *we* also have believed on Christ Jesus, that we might be justified on the principle of [the] faith of Christ; and not of works of law; because on the principle of works of law no flesh shall be justified.

title: Galatians 2:17
text: Now if in seeking to be justified in Christ we also have been found sinners, then [is] Christ minister of sin? Far be the thought.

title: Galatians 2:18
text: For if the things I have thrown down, these I build again, I constitute myself a transgressor.

title: Galatians 2:19
text: For *I*, through law, have died to law, that I may live to God.

title: Galatians 2:20
text: I am crucified with Christ, and no longer live, *I*, but Christ lives in me; but [in] that I now live in flesh, I live by faith, the [faith] of the Son of God, who has loved me and given himself for me.

title: Galatians 2:21
text: I do not set aside the grace of God; for if righteousness [is] by law, then Christ has died for nothing.

title: Galatians 3:1
text: ¶O senseless Galatians, who has bewitched you; to whom, as before your very eyes, Jesus Christ has been portrayed, crucified [among you]?

title: Galatians 3:2
text: This only I wish to learn of you, Have ye received the Spirit on the principle of works of law, or of [the] report of faith?

title: Galatians 3:3
text: Are ye so senseless? having begun in Spirit, are ye going to be made perfect in flesh?

title: Galatians 3:4
text: Have ye suffered so many things in vain, if indeed also in vain?

title: Galatians 3:5
text: He therefore who ministers to you the Spirit, and works miracles among you, [is it] on the principle of works of law, or of [the] report of faith?

title: Galatians 3:6
text: ¶Even as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness.

title: Galatians 3:7
text: Know then that they that are on the principle of faith, these are Abraham's sons;

title: Galatians 3:8
text: and the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the nations on the principle of faith, announced beforehand the glad tidings to Abraham: In thee all the nations shall be blessed.

title: Galatians 3:9
text: So that they who are on the principle of faith are blessed with believing Abraham.

title: Galatians 3:10
text: For as many as are on the principle of works of law are under curse. For it is written, Cursed is every one who does not continue in all things which [are] written in the book of the law to do them;

title: Galatians 3:11
text: but that by law no one is justified with God [is] evident, because The just shall live on the principle of faith;

title: Galatians 3:12
text: but the law is not on the principle of faith; but, He that shall have done these things shall live by them.

title: Galatians 3:13
text: Christ has redeemed us out of the curse of the law, having become a curse for us, (for it is written, Cursed [is] every one hanged upon a tree,)

title: Galatians 3:14
text: that the blessing of Abraham might come to the nations in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

title: Galatians 3:15
text: Brethren, (I speak according to man,) even man's confirmed covenant no one sets aside, or adds other dispositions to.

title: Galatians 3:16
text: But to Abraham were the promises addressed, and to his seed: he does not say, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed; which is Christ.

title: Galatians 3:17
text: Now I say this, A covenant confirmed beforehand by God, the law, which took place four hundred and thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

title: Galatians 3:18
text: For if the inheritance [be] on the principle of law, [it is] no longer on the principle of promise; but God gave it in grace to Abraham by promise.

title: Galatians 3:19
text: ¶Why then the law? It was added for the sake of transgressions, until the seed came to whom the promise was made, ordained through angels in [the] hand of a mediator.

title: Galatians 3:20
text: But a mediator is not of one, but God is one.

title: Galatians 3:21
text: [Is] then the law against the promises of God? Far be the thought. For if a law had been given able to quicken, then indeed righteousness were on the principle of law;

title: Galatians 3:22
text: but the scripture has shut up all things under sin, that the promise, on the principle of faith of Jesus Christ, should be given to those that believe.

title: Galatians 3:23
text: But before faith came, we were guarded under law, shut up to faith [which was] about to be revealed.

title: Galatians 3:24
text: So that the law has been our tutor up to Christ, that we might be justified on the principle of faith.

title: Galatians 3:25
text: But, faith having come, we are no longer under a tutor;

title: Galatians 3:26
text: for ye are all God's sons by faith in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 3:27
text: For ye, as many as have been baptised unto Christ, have put on Christ.

title: Galatians 3:28
text: There is no Jew nor Greek; there is no bondman nor freeman; there is no male and female; for ye are all one in Christ Jesus:

title: Galatians 3:29
text: but if *ye* [are] of Christ, then ye are Abraham's seed, heirs according to promise.

title: Galatians 4:1
text: ¶Now I say, As long as the heir is a child, he differs nothing from a bondman, though he be lord of all;

title: Galatians 4:2
text: but he is under guardians and stewards until the period fixed by the father.

title: Galatians 4:3
text: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the principles of the world;

title: Galatians 4:4
text: but when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, come of woman, come under law,

title: Galatians 4:5
text: that he might redeem those under law, that we might receive sonship.

title: Galatians 4:6
text: But because ye are sons, God has sent out the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

title: Galatians 4:7
text: So thou art no longer bondman, but son; but if son, heir also through God.

title: Galatians 4:8
text: ¶But then indeed, not knowing God, ye were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods;

title: Galatians 4:9
text: but now, knowing God, but rather being known by God, how do ye turn again to the weak and beggarly principles to which ye desire to be again anew in bondage?

title: Galatians 4:10
text: Ye observe days and months and times and years.

title: Galatians 4:11
text: I am afraid of you, lest indeed I have laboured in vain as to you.

title: Galatians 4:12
text: ¶Be as *I* [am], for *I* also [am] as *ye*, brethren, I beseech you: ye have not at all wronged me.

title: Galatians 4:13
text: But ye know that in weakness of the flesh I announced the glad tidings to you at the first;

title: Galatians 4:14
text: and my temptation, which [was] in my flesh, ye did not slight nor reject with contempt; but ye received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 4:15
text: What then [was] your blessedness? for I bear you witness that, if possible, plucking out your own eyes ye would have given [them] to me.

title: Galatians 4:16
text: So I have become your enemy in speaking the truth to you?

title: Galatians 4:17
text: ¶They are not rightly zealous after you, but desire to shut you out [from us], that ye may be zealous after them.

title: Galatians 4:18
text: But [it is] right to be zealous at all times in what is right, and not only when I am present with you--

title: Galatians 4:19
text: ¶my children, of whom I again travail in birth until Christ shall have been formed in you:

title: Galatians 4:20
text: and I should wish to be present with you now, and change my voice, for I am perplexed as to you.

title: Galatians 4:21
text: ¶Tell me, ye who are desirous of being under law, do ye not listen to the law?

title: Galatians 4:22
text: For it is written that Abraham had two sons; one of the maid servant, and one of the free woman.

title: Galatians 4:23
text: But he [that was] of the maid servant was born according to flesh, and he [that was] of the free woman through the promise.

title: Galatians 4:24
text: Which things have an allegorical sense; for these are two covenants: one from mount Sinai, gendering to bondage, which is Hagar.

title: Galatians 4:25
text: For Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and corresponds to Jerusalem which [is] now, for she is in bondage with her children;

title: Galatians 4:26
text: but the Jerusalem above is free, which is our mother.

title: Galatians 4:27
text: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break out and cry, thou that travailest not; because the children of the desolate are more numerous than [those] of her that has a husband.

title: Galatians 4:28
text: But *ye*, brethren, after the pattern of Isaac, are children of promise.

title: Galatians 4:29
text: But as then he that was born according to flesh persecuted him [that was born] according to Spirit, so also [it is] now.

title: Galatians 4:30
text: But what says the scripture? Cast out the maid servant and her son; for the son of the maid servant shall not inherit with the son of the free woman.

title: Galatians 4:31
text: So then, brethren, we are not maid servant's children, but [children] of the free woman.

title: Galatians 5:1
text: ¶Christ has set us free in freedom; stand fast therefore, and be not held again in a yoke of bondage.

title: Galatians 5:2
text: Behold, I, Paul, say to you, that if ye are circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

title: Galatians 5:3
text: And I witness again to every man [who is] circumcised, that he is debtor to do the whole law.

title: Galatians 5:4
text: Ye are deprived of all profit from the Christ as separated [from him], as many as are justified by law; ye have fallen from grace.

title: Galatians 5:5
text: For we, by [the] Spirit, on the principle of faith, await the hope of righteousness.

title: Galatians 5:6
text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision has any force, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.

title: Galatians 5:7
text: Ye ran well; who has stopped you that ye should not obey the truth?

title: Galatians 5:8
text: The persuasibleness [is] not of him that calls you.

title: Galatians 5:9
text: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.

title: Galatians 5:10
text: *I* have confidence as to you in [the] Lord, that ye will have no other mind; and he that is troubling you shall bear the guilt [of it], whosoever he may be.

title: Galatians 5:11
text: But *I*, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why am I yet persecuted? Then the scandal of the cross has been done away.

title: Galatians 5:12
text: I would that they would even cut themselves off who throw you into confusion.

title: Galatians 5:13
text: ¶For *ye* have been called to liberty, brethren; only [do] not [turn] liberty into an opportunity to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

title: Galatians 5:14
text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself;

title: Galatians 5:15
text: but if ye bite and devour one another, see that ye are not consumed one of another.

title: Galatians 5:16
text: But I say, Walk in [the] Spirit, and ye shall no way fulfil flesh's lust.

title: Galatians 5:17
text: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these things are opposed one to the other, that ye should not do those things which ye desire;

title: Galatians 5:18
text: but if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under law.

title: Galatians 5:19
text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are fornication, uncleanness, licentiousness,

title: Galatians 5:20
text: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strifes, jealousies, angers, contentions, disputes, schools of opinion,

title: Galatians 5:21
text: envyings, murders, drunkennesses, revels, and things like these; as to which I tell you beforehand, even as I also have said before, that they who do such things shall not inherit God's kingdom.

title: Galatians 5:22
text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, fidelity,

title: Galatians 5:23
text: meekness, self-control: against such things there is no law.

title: Galatians 5:24
text: But they that [are] of the Christ have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts.

title: Galatians 5:25
text: If we live by the Spirit, let us walk also by the Spirit.

title: Galatians 5:26
text: Let us not become vain-glorious, provoking one another, envying one another.

title: Galatians 6:1
text: ¶Brethren, if even a man be taken in some fault, ye who are spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of meekness, considering thyself lest *thou* also be tempted.

title: Galatians 6:2
text: Bear one another's burdens, and thus fulfil the law of the Christ.

title: Galatians 6:3
text: For if any man reputes himself to be something, being nothing, he deceives himself;

title: Galatians 6:4
text: but let each prove his own work, and then he will have his boast in what belongs to himself alone, and not in what belongs to another.

title: Galatians 6:5
text: For each shall bear his own burden.

title: Galatians 6:6
text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate to him that teaches in all good things.

title: Galatians 6:7
text: Be not deceived: God is not mocked; for whatever a man shall sow, that also shall he reap.

title: Galatians 6:8
text: For he that sows to his own flesh, shall reap corruption from the flesh; but he that sows to the Spirit, from the Spirit shall reap eternal life:

title: Galatians 6:9
text: but let us not lose heart in doing good; for in due time, if we do not faint, we shall reap.

title: Galatians 6:10
text: So then, as we have occasion, let us do good towards all, and specially towards those of the household of faith.

title: Galatians 6:11
text: ¶See how long a letter I have written to you with my own hand.

title: Galatians 6:12
text: As many as desire to have a fair appearance in [the] flesh, these compel you to be circumcised, only that they may not be persecuted because of the cross of Christ.

title: Galatians 6:13
text: For neither do they that are circumcised themselves keep the law; but they wish you to be circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

title: Galatians 6:14
text: But far be it from me to boast save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom [the] world is crucified to me, and I to the world.

title: Galatians 6:15
text: For [in Christ Jesus] neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision; but new creation.

title: Galatians 6:16
text: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace upon them and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

title: Galatians 6:17
text: For the rest let no one trouble me, for *I* bear in my body the brands of the Lord Jesus.

title: Galatians 6:18
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit, brethren. Amen.

title: Ephesians 1:1
text: ¶Paul, apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, to the saints and faithful in Christ Jesus who are at Ephesus.

title: Ephesians 1:2
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Ephesians 1:3
text: ¶Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenlies in Christ;

title: Ephesians 1:4
text: according as he has chosen us in him before [the] world's foundation, that we should be holy and blameless before him in love;

title: Ephesians 1:5
text: having marked us out beforehand for adoption through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

title: Ephesians 1:6
text: to [the] praise of [the] glory of his grace, wherein he has taken us into favour in the Beloved:

title: Ephesians 1:7
text: in whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of offences, according to the riches of his grace;

title: Ephesians 1:8
text: which he has caused to abound towards us in all wisdom and intelligence,

title: Ephesians 1:9
text: having made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in himself

title: Ephesians 1:10
text: for [the] administration of the fulness of times; to head up all things in the Christ, the things in the heavens and the things upon the earth; in him,

title: Ephesians 1:11
text: in whom we have also obtained an inheritance, being marked out beforehand according to the purpose of him who works all things according to the counsel of his own will,

title: Ephesians 1:12
text: that we should be to [the] praise of his glory who have pre-trusted in the Christ:

title: Ephesians 1:13
text: in whom *ye* also [have trusted], having heard the word of the truth, the glad tidings of your salvation; in whom also, having believed, ye have been sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

title: Ephesians 1:14
text: who is [the] earnest of our inheritance to the redemption of the acquired possession to [the] praise of his glory.

title: Ephesians 1:15
text: ¶Wherefore *I* also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which [is] in you, and the love which [ye have] towards all the saints,

title: Ephesians 1:16
text: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention [of you] at my prayers,

title: Ephesians 1:17
text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, would give you [the] spirit of wisdom and revelation in the full knowledge of him,

title: Ephesians 1:18
text: being enlightened in the eyes of your heart, so that ye should know what is the hope of his calling, [and] what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

title: Ephesians 1:19
text: and what the surpassing greatness of his power towards us who believe, according to the working of the might of his strength,

title: Ephesians 1:20
text: [in] which he wrought in the Christ [in] raising him from among [the] dead, and he set him down at his right hand in the heavenlies,

title: Ephesians 1:21
text: above every principality, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name named, not only in this age, but also in that to come;

title: Ephesians 1:22
text: and has put all things under his feet, and gave him [to be] head over all things to the assembly,

title: Ephesians 1:23
text: which is his body, the fulness of him who fills all in all:

title: Ephesians 2:1
text: ¶and *you*, being dead in your offences and sins--

title: Ephesians 2:2
text: in which ye once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, the spirit who now works in the sons of disobedience:

title: Ephesians 2:3
text: among whom *we* also all once had our conversation in the lusts of our flesh, doing what the flesh and the thoughts willed to do, and were children, by nature, of wrath, even as the rest:

title: Ephesians 2:4
text: ¶but God, being rich in mercy, because of his great love wherewith he loved us,

title: Ephesians 2:5
text: (we too being dead in offences,) has quickened us with the Christ, (ye are saved by grace,)

title: Ephesians 2:6
text: and has raised [us] up together, and has made [us] sit down together in the heavenlies in Christ Jesus,

title: Ephesians 2:7
text: that he might display in the coming ages the surpassing riches of his grace in kindness towards us in Christ Jesus.

title: Ephesians 2:8
text: For ye are saved by grace, through faith; and this not of yourselves; it is God's gift:

title: Ephesians 2:9
text: not on the principle of works, that no one might boast.

title: Ephesians 2:10
text: For we are his workmanship, having been created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God has before prepared that we should walk in them.

title: Ephesians 2:11
text: ¶Wherefore remember that *ye*, once nations in [the] flesh, who [are] called uncircumcision by that called circumcision in [the] flesh done with the hand;

title: Ephesians 2:12
text: that ye were at that time without Christ, aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

title: Ephesians 2:13
text: but now in Christ Jesus *ye* who once were afar off are become nigh by the blood of the Christ.

title: Ephesians 2:14
text: ¶For *he* is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of enclosure,

title: Ephesians 2:15
text: having annulled the enmity in his flesh, the law of commandments in ordinances, that he might form the two in himself into one new man, making peace;

title: Ephesians 2:16
text: and might reconcile both in one body to God by the cross, having by it slain the enmity;

title: Ephesians 2:17
text: and, coming, he has preached the glad tidings of peace to you who [were] afar off, and [the glad tidings of] peace to those [who were] nigh.

title: Ephesians 2:18
text: For through him we have both access by one Spirit to the Father.

title: Ephesians 2:19
text: So then ye are no longer strangers and foreigners, but ye are fellow-citizens of the saints, and of the household of God,

title: Ephesians 2:20
text: being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the corner-stone,

title: Ephesians 2:21
text: in whom all [the] building fitted together increases to a holy temple in the Lord;

title: Ephesians 2:22
text: in whom *ye* also are built together for a habitation of God in [the] Spirit.

title: Ephesians 3:1
text: ¶For this reason *I* Paul, prisoner of the Christ Jesus for you nations,

title: Ephesians 3:2
text: (if indeed ye have heard of the administration of the grace of God which has been given to me towards you,

title: Ephesians 3:3
text: that by revelation the mystery has been made known to me, (according as I have written before briefly,

title: Ephesians 3:4
text: by which, in reading it, ye can understand my intelligence in the mystery of the Christ,)

title: Ephesians 3:5
text: which in other generations has not been made known to the sons of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in [the power of the] Spirit,

title: Ephesians 3:6
text: that [they who are of] the nations should be joint heirs, and a joint body, and joint partakers of [his] promise in Christ Jesus by the glad tidings;

title: Ephesians 3:7
text: of which I am become minister according to the gift of the grace of God given to me, according to the working of his power.

title: Ephesians 3:8
text: To me, less than the least of all saints, has this grace been given, to announce among the nations the glad tidings of the unsearchable riches of the Christ,

title: Ephesians 3:9
text: and to enlighten all [with the knowledge of] what is the administration of the mystery hidden throughout the ages in God, who has created all things,

title: Ephesians 3:10
text: in order that now to the principalities and authorities in the heavenlies might be made known through the assembly the all-various wisdom of God,

title: Ephesians 3:11
text: according to [the] purpose of the ages, which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord,

title: Ephesians 3:12
text: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence by the faith of him.

title: Ephesians 3:13
text: Wherefore I beseech [you] not to faint through my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

title: Ephesians 3:14
text: ¶For this reason I bow my knees to the Father [of our Lord Jesus Christ],

title: Ephesians 3:15
text: of whom every family in [the] heavens and on earth is named,

title: Ephesians 3:16
text: in order that he may give you according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with power by his Spirit in the inner man;

title: Ephesians 3:17
text: that the Christ may dwell, through faith, in your hearts, being rooted and founded in love,

title: Ephesians 3:18
text: in order that ye may be fully able to apprehend with all the saints what [is] the breadth and length and depth and height;

title: Ephesians 3:19
text: and to know the love of the Christ which surpasses knowledge; that ye may be filled [even] to all the fulness of God.

title: Ephesians 3:20
text: But to him that is able to do far exceedingly above all which we ask or think, according to the power which works in us,

title: Ephesians 3:21
text: to him be glory in the assembly in Christ Jesus unto all generations of the age of ages. Amen).

title: Ephesians 4:1
text: ¶*I*, the prisoner in [the] Lord, exhort you therefore to walk worthy of the calling wherewith ye have been called,

title: Ephesians 4:2
text: ¶with all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, bearing with one another in love;

title: Ephesians 4:3
text: using diligence to keep the unity of the Spirit in the uniting bond of peace.

title: Ephesians 4:4
text: [There is] one body and one Spirit, as ye have been also called in one hope of your calling;

title: Ephesians 4:5
text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;

title: Ephesians 4:6
text: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.

title: Ephesians 4:7
text: But to each one of us has been given grace according to the measure of the gift of the Christ.

title: Ephesians 4:8
text: Wherefore he says, Having ascended up on high, he has led captivity captive, and has given gifts to men.

title: Ephesians 4:9
text: But that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended into the lower parts of the earth?

title: Ephesians 4:10
text: He that descended is the same who has also ascended up above all the heavens, that he might fill all things;

title: Ephesians 4:11
text: and *he* has given some apostles, and some prophets, and some evangelists, and some shepherds and teachers,

title: Ephesians 4:12
text: for the perfecting of the saints; with a view to [the] work of [the] ministry, with a view to the edifying of the body of Christ;

title: Ephesians 4:13
text: until we all arrive at the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, at [the] full-grown man, at [the] measure of the stature of the fulness of the Christ;

title: Ephesians 4:14
text: in order that we may be no longer babes, tossed and carried about by every wind of *that* teaching [which is] in the sleight of men, in unprincipled cunning with a view to systematized error;

title: Ephesians 4:15
text: but, holding the truth in love, we may grow up to him in all things, who is the head, the Christ:

text: Now, I rejoice in sufferings for you, and I fill up that which is behind of the tribulations of Christ in my flesh, for his body, which is the assembly;

title: Colossians 1:25
text: of which *I* became minister, according to the dispensation of God which [is] given me towards you to complete the word of God,

title: Colossians 1:26
text: the mystery which [has been] hidden from ages and from generations, but has now been made manifest to his saints;

title: Colossians 1:27
text: to whom God would make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the nations, which is Christ in you the hope of glory:

title: Colossians 1:28
text: whom *we* announce, admonishing every man, and teaching every man, in all wisdom, to the end that we may present every man perfect in Christ.

title: Colossians 1:29
text: Whereunto also I toil, combating according to his working, which works in me in power.

title: Colossians 2:1
text: ¶For I would have you know what combat I have for you, and those in Laodicea, and as many as have not seen my face in flesh;

title: Colossians 2:2
text: to the end that their hearts may be encouraged, being united together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to [the] full knowledge of the mystery of God;

title: Colossians 2:3
text: in which are hid all the treasures of wisdom and of knowledge.

title: Colossians 2:4
text: ¶And I say this to the end that no one may delude you by persuasive speech.

title: Colossians 2:5
text: For if indeed in the flesh I am absent, yet I am with you in spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the firmness of your faith in Christ.

title: Colossians 2:6
text: As therefore ye have received the Christ, Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

title: Colossians 2:7
text: rooted and built up in him, and assured in the faith, even as ye have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving.

title: Colossians 2:8
text: See that there be no one who shall lead *you* away as a prey through philosophy and vain deceit, according to the teaching of men, according to the elements of the world, and not according to Christ.

title: Colossians 2:9
text: For in him dwells all the fulness of the Godhead bodily;

title: Colossians 2:10
text: and ye are complete in him, who is the head of all principality and authority,

title: Colossians 2:11
text: in whom also ye have been circumcised with circumcision not done by hand, in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of the Christ;

title: Colossians 2:12
text: buried with him in baptism, in which ye have been also raised with [him] through faith of the working of God who raised him from among the dead.

title: Colossians 2:13
text: ¶And you, being dead in offences and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, he has quickened together with him, having forgiven us all the offences;

title: Colossians 2:14
text: having effaced the handwriting in ordinances which [stood out] against us, which was contrary to us, he has taken it also out of the way, having nailed it to the cross;

title: Colossians 2:15
