title: Hebrews 6:20
text: where Jesus is entered as forerunner for us, become for ever a high priest according to the order of Melchisedec.

title: Hebrews 7:1
text: ¶For this Melchisedec, King of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from smiting the kings, and blessed him;

title: Hebrews 7:2
text: to whom Abraham gave also the tenth portion of all; first being interpreted King of righteousness, and then also King of Salem, which is King of peace;

title: Hebrews 7:3
text: without father, without mother, without genealogy; having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but assimilated to the Son of God, abides a priest continually.

title: Hebrews 7:4
text: Now consider how great this [personage] was, to whom [even] the patriarch Abraham gave a tenth out of the spoils.

title: Hebrews 7:5
text: And they indeed from among the sons of Levi, who receive the priesthood, have commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is from their brethren, though these are come out of the loins of Abraham:

title: Hebrews 7:6
text: but he who has no genealogy from them has tithed Abraham, and blessed him who had the promises.

title: Hebrews 7:7
text: But beyond all gainsaying, the inferior is blessed by the better.

title: Hebrews 7:8
text: And here dying men receive tithes; but there [one] of whom the witness is that he lives;

title: Hebrews 7:9
text: and, so to speak, through Abraham, Levi also, who received tithes, has been made to pay tithes.

title: Hebrews 7:10
text: For he was yet in the loins of his father when Melchisedec met him.

title: Hebrews 7:11
text: ¶If indeed then perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, for the people had their law given to them in connexion with *it*, what need [was there] still that a different priest should arise according to the order of Melchisedec, and not be named after the order of Aaron?

title: Hebrews 7:12
text: For, the priesthood being changed, there takes place of necessity a change of law also.

title: Hebrews 7:13
text: For he, of whom these things are said, belongs to a different tribe, of which no one has [ever] been attached to the service of the altar.

title: Hebrews 7:14
text: For it is clear that our Lord has sprung out of Juda, as to which tribe Moses spake nothing as to priests.

title: Hebrews 7:15
text: And it is yet more abundantly evident, since a different priest arises according to the similitude of Melchisedec,

title: Hebrews 7:16
text: who has been constituted not according to law of fleshly commandment, but according to power of indissoluble life.

title: Hebrews 7:17
text: For it is borne witness, *Thou* art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedec.

title: Hebrews 7:18
text: For there is a setting aside of the commandment going before for its weakness and unprofitableness,

title: Hebrews 7:19
text: (for the law perfected nothing,) and the introduction of a better hope by which we draw nigh to God.

title: Hebrews 7:20
text: And by how much [it was] not without the swearing of an oath;

title: Hebrews 7:21
text: (for they are become priests without the swearing of an oath, but he with the swearing of an oath, by him who said, as to him, The Lord has sworn, and will not repent [of it], *Thou* [art] priest for ever [according to the order of Melchisedec];)

title: Hebrews 7:22
text: by so much Jesus became surety of a better covenant.

title: Hebrews 7:23
text: And they have been many priests, on account of being hindered from continuing by death;

title: Hebrews 7:24
text: but he, because of his continuing for ever, has the priesthood unchangeable.

title: Hebrews 7:25
text: Whence also he is able to save completely those who approach by him to God, always living to intercede for them.

title: Hebrews 7:26
text: For such a high priest became us, holy, harmless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and become higher than the heavens:

title: Hebrews 7:27
text: who has not day by day need, as the high priests, first to offer up sacrifices for his own sins, then [for] those of the people; for this he did once for all [in] having offered up himself.

title: Hebrews 7:28
text: For the law constitutes men high priests, having infirmity; but the word of the swearing of the oath which [is] after the law, a Son perfected for ever.

title: Hebrews 8:1
text: ¶Now a summary of the things of which we are speaking [is], We have such a one high priest who has sat down on [the] right hand of the throne of the greatness in the heavens;

title: Hebrews 8:2
text: minister of the holy places and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord has pitched, [and] not man.

title: Hebrews 8:3
text: For every high priest is constituted for the offering both of gifts and sacrifices; whence it is needful that this one also should have something which he may offer.

title: Hebrews 8:4
text: If then indeed he were upon earth, he would not even be a priest, there being those who offer the gifts according to the law,

title: Hebrews 8:5
text: (who serve the representation and shadow of heavenly things, according as Moses was oracularly told [when] about to make the tabernacle; for See, saith He, that thou make all things according to the pattern which has been shewn to thee in the mountain.)

title: Hebrews 8:6
text: ¶But now he has got a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is mediator of a better covenant, which is established on the footing of better promises.

title: Hebrews 8:7
text: For if that first was faultless, place had not been sought for a second.

title: Hebrews 8:8
text: For finding fault, he says to them, Behold, days come, saith the Lord, and I will consummate a new covenant as regards the house of Israel, and as regards the house of Juda;

title: Hebrews 8:9
text: not according to the covenant which I made to their fathers in [the] day of my taking their hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because *they* did not continue in my covenant, and *I* did not regard them, saith [the] Lord.

title: Hebrews 8:10
text: Because this [is] the covenant that I will covenant to the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord: Giving my laws into their mind, I will write them also upon their hearts; and I will be to them for God, and *they* shall be to me for people.

title: Hebrews 8:11
text: And they shall not teach each his fellow-citizen, and each his brother, saying, Know the Lord; because all shall know me in themselves, from [the] little one [among them] unto [the] great among them.

title: Hebrews 8:12
text: Because I will be merciful to their unrighteousnesses, and their sins and their lawlessnesses I will never remember any more.

title: Hebrews 8:13
text: In that he says New, he has made the first old; but that which grows old and aged [is] near disappearing.

title: Hebrews 9:1
text: ¶The first therefore also indeed had ordinances of service, and the sanctuary, a worldly one.

title: Hebrews 9:2
text: For a tabernacle was set up; the first, in which [were] both the candlestick and the table and the exposition of the loaves, which is called Holy;

title: Hebrews 9:3
text: but after the second veil a tabernacle which is called Holy of holies,

title: Hebrews 9:4
text: having a golden censer, and the ark of the covenant, covered round in every part with gold, in which [were] the golden pot that had the manna, and the rod of Aaron that had sprouted, and the tables of the covenant;

title: Hebrews 9:5
text: and above over it the cherubim of glory shadowing the mercy-seat; concerning which it is not now [the time] to speak in detail.

title: Hebrews 9:6
text: Now these things being thus ordered, into the first tabernacle the priests enter at all times, accomplishing the services;

title: Hebrews 9:7
text: but into the second, the high priest only, once a year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people:

title: Hebrews 9:8
text: ¶the Holy Spirit shewing this, that the way of the [holy of] holies has not yet been made manifest while as yet the first tabernacle has [its] standing;

title: Hebrews 9:9
text: the which [is] an image for the present time, according to which both gifts and sacrifices, unable to perfect as to conscience him that worshipped, are offered,

title: Hebrews 9:10
text: [consisting] only of meats and drinks and divers washings, ordinances of flesh, imposed until [the] time of setting things right.

title: Hebrews 9:11
text: But Christ being come high priest of the good things to come, by the better and more perfect tabernacle not made with hand, (that is, not of this creation,)

title: Hebrews 9:12
text: nor by blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood, has entered in once for all into the [holy of] holies, having found an eternal redemption.

title: Hebrews 9:13
text: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and a heifer's ashes sprinkling the defiled, sanctifies for the purity of the flesh,

title: Hebrews 9:14
text: how much rather shall the blood of the Christ, who by the eternal Spirit offered himself spotless to God, purify your conscience from dead works to worship [the] living God?

title: Hebrews 9:15
text: ¶And for this reason he is mediator of a new covenant, so that, death having taken place for redemption of the transgressions under the first covenant, the called might receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

title: Hebrews 9:16
text: (For where [there is] a testament, the death of the testator must needs come in.

title: Hebrews 9:17
text: For a testament [is] of force when men are dead, since it is in no way of force while the testator is alive.)

title: Hebrews 9:18
text: Whence neither the first was inaugurated without blood.

title: Hebrews 9:19
text: For every commandment having been spoken according to [the] law by Moses to all the people; having taken the blood of calves and goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, he sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

title: Hebrews 9:20
text: saying, This [is] the blood of the covenant which God has enjoined to you.

title: Hebrews 9:21
text: And the tabernacle too and all the vessels of service he sprinkled in like manner with blood;

title: Hebrews 9:22
text: and almost all things are purified with blood according to the law, and without blood-shedding there is no remission.

title: Hebrews 9:23
text: ¶[It was] necessary then that the figurative representations of the things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with sacrifices better than these.

title: Hebrews 9:24
text: For the Christ is not entered into holy places made with hand, figures of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear before the face of God for us:

title: Hebrews 9:25
text: nor in order that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy places every year with blood not his own;

title: Hebrews 9:26
text: since he had [then] been obliged often to suffer from the foundation of the world. But now once in the consummation of the ages he has been manifested for [the] putting away of sin by his sacrifice.

title: Hebrews 9:27
text: And forasmuch as it is the portion of men once to die, and after this judgment;

title: Hebrews 9:28
text: thus the Christ also, having been once offered to bear the sins of many, shall appear to those that look for him the second time without sin for salvation.

title: Hebrews 10:1
text: ¶For the law, having a shadow of the coming good things, not the image itself of the things, can never, by the same sacrifices which they offer continually yearly, perfect those who approach.

title: Hebrews 10:2
text: Since, would they not indeed have ceased being offered, on account of the worshippers once purged having no longer any conscience of sins?

title: Hebrews 10:3
text: But in these [there is] a calling to mind of sins yearly.

title: Hebrews 10:4
text: For blood of bulls and goats [is] incapable of taking away sins.

title: Hebrews 10:5
text: Wherefore coming into the world he says, Sacrifice and offering thou willedst not; but thou hast prepared me a body.

title: Hebrews 10:6
text: Thou tookest no pleasure in burnt-offerings and sacrifices for sin.

title: Hebrews 10:7
text: ¶Then I said, Lo, I come (in [the] roll of the book it is written of me) to do, O God, thy will.

title: Hebrews 10:8
text: Above, saying Sacrifices and offerings and burnt-offerings and sacrifices for sin thou willedst not, neither tookest pleasure in (which are offered according to the law);

title: Hebrews 10:9
text: then he said, Lo, I come to do thy will. He takes away the first that he may establish the second;

title: Hebrews 10:10
text: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

title: Hebrews 10:11
text: And every priest stands daily ministering, and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

title: Hebrews 10:12
text: But *he*, having offered one sacrifice for sins, sat down in perpetuity at [the] right hand of God,

title: Hebrews 10:13
text: waiting from henceforth until his enemies be set [for the] footstool of his feet.

title: Hebrews 10:14
text: For by one offering he has perfected in perpetuity the sanctified.

title: Hebrews 10:15
text: And the Holy Spirit also bears us witness [of it]; for after what was said:

title: Hebrews 10:16
text: This [is] the covenant which I will establish towards them after those days, saith [the] Lord: Giving my laws into their hearts, I will write them also in their understandings;

title: Hebrews 10:17
text: and their sins and their lawlessnesses I will never remember any more.

title: Hebrews 10:18
text: But where there [is] remission of these, [there is] no longer a sacrifice for sin.

title: Hebrews 10:19
text: ¶Having therefore, brethren, boldness for entering into the [holy of] holies by the blood of Jesus,

title: Hebrews 10:20
text: the new and living way which he has dedicated for us through the veil, that is, his flesh,

title: Hebrews 10:21
text: and [having] a great priest over the house of God,

title: Hebrews 10:22
text: let us approach with a true heart, in full assurance of faith, sprinkled as to our hearts from a wicked conscience, and washed as to our body with pure water.

title: Hebrews 10:23
text: Let us hold fast the confession of the hope unwavering, (for he [is] faithful who has promised;)

title: Hebrews 10:24
text: and let us consider one another for provoking to love and good works;

title: Hebrews 10:25
text: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the custom [is] with some; but encouraging [one another], and by so much the more as ye see the day drawing near.

title: Hebrews 10:26
text: For where we sin wilfully after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains any sacrifice for sins,

title: Hebrews 10:27
text: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and heat of fire about to devour the adversaries.

title: Hebrews 10:28
text: Any one that has disregarded Moses' law dies without mercy on [the testimony of] two or three witnesses:

title: Hebrews 10:29
text: of how much worse punishment, think ye, shall he be judged worthy who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and esteemed the blood of the covenant, whereby he has been sanctified, common, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

title: Hebrews 10:30
text: For we know him that said, To me [belongs] vengeance; *I* will recompense, saith the Lord: and again, The Lord shall judge his people.

title: Hebrews 10:31
text: [It is] a fearful thing falling into [the] hands of [the] living God.

title: Hebrews 10:32
text: But call to mind the earlier days in which, having been enlightened, ye endured much conflict of sufferings;

title: Hebrews 10:33
text: on the one hand, when ye were made a spectacle both in reproaches and afflictions; and on the other, when ye became partakers with those who were passing through them.

title: Hebrews 10:34
text: For ye both sympathised with prisoners and accepted with joy the plunder of your goods, knowing that ye have for yourselves a better substance, and an abiding one.

title: Hebrews 10:35
text: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which has great recompense.

title: Hebrews 10:36
text: For ye have need of endurance in order that, having done the will of God, ye may receive the promise.

title: Hebrews 10:37
text: For yet a very little while he that comes will come, and will not delay.

title: Hebrews 10:38
text: But the just shall live by faith; and, if he draw back, my soul does not take pleasure in him.

title: Hebrews 10:39
text: But *we* are not drawers back to perdition, but of faith to saving [the] soul.

title: Hebrews 11:1
text: ¶Now faith is [the] substantiating of things hoped for, [the] conviction of things not seen.

title: Hebrews 11:2
text: For in [the power of] this the elders have obtained testimony.

title: Hebrews 11:3
text: By faith we apprehend that the worlds were framed by [the] word of God, so that that which is seen should not take its origin from things which appear.

title: Hebrews 11:4
text: ¶By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained testimony of being righteous, God bearing testimony to his gifts, and by it, having died, he yet speaks.

title: Hebrews 11:5
text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him; for before [his] translation he has the testimony that he had pleased God.

title: Hebrews 11:6
text: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]. For he that draws near to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them who seek him out.

title: Hebrews 11:7
text: By faith, Noah, oracularly warned concerning things not yet seen, moved with fear, prepared an ark for the saving of his house; by which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which [is] according to faith.

title: Hebrews 11:8
text: By faith Abraham, being called, obeyed to go out into the place which he was to receive for an inheritance, and went out, not knowing where he was going.

title: Hebrews 11:9
text: By faith he sojourned as a stranger in the land of promise as a foreign country, having dwelt in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with [him] of the same promise;

title: Hebrews 11:10
text: for he waited for the city which has foundations, of which God is [the] artificer and constructor.

title: Hebrews 11:11
text: By faith also Sarah herself received strength for [the] conception of seed, and [that] beyond a seasonable age; since she counted him faithful who promised.

title: Hebrews 11:12
text: Wherefore also there have been born of one, and that of one become dead, even as the stars of heaven in multitude, and as the countless sand which [is] by the sea shore.

title: Hebrews 11:13
text: All these died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them from afar off and embraced [them], and confessed that they were strangers and sojourners on the earth.

title: Hebrews 11:14
text: For they who say such things shew clearly that they seek [their] country.

title: Hebrews 11:15
text: And if they had called to mind that from whence they went out, they had had opportunity to have returned;

title: Hebrews 11:16
text: but now they seek a better, that is, a heavenly; wherefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God; for he has prepared for them a city.

title: Hebrews 11:17
text: By faith Abraham, [when] tried, offered up Isaac, and he who had received to himself the promises offered up his only begotten [son],

title: Hebrews 11:18
text: as to whom it had been said, In Isaac shall thy seed be called:

title: Hebrews 11:19
text: counting that God [was] able to raise [him] even from among [the] dead, whence also he received him in a figure.

title: Hebrews 11:20
text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

title: Hebrews 11:21
text: By faith Jacob [when] dying blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshipped on the top of his staff.

title: Hebrews 11:22
text: By faith Joseph [when] dying called to mind the going forth of the sons of Israel, and gave commandment concerning his bones.

title: Hebrews 11:23
text: By faith Moses, being born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw the child beautiful; and they did not fear the injunction of the king.

title: Hebrews 11:24
text: By faith Moses, when he had become great, refused to be called son of Pharaoh's daughter;

title: Hebrews 11:25
text: choosing rather to suffer affliction along with the people of God than to have [the] temporary pleasure of sin;

title: Hebrews 11:26
text: esteeming the reproach of the Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt, for he had respect to the recompense.

title: Hebrews 11:27
text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he persevered, as seeing him who is invisible.

title: Hebrews 11:28
text: By faith he celebrated the passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn might not touch them.

title: Hebrews 11:29
text: By faith they passed through the Red sea as through dry land; of which the Egyptians having made trial were swallowed up.

title: Hebrews 11:30
text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, having been encircled for seven days.

title: Hebrews 11:31
text: By faith Rahab the harlot did not perish along with the unbelieving, having received the spies in peace.

title: Hebrews 11:32
text: ¶And what more do I say? For the time would fail me telling of Gideon, and Barak, and Samson, and Jephthah, and David and Samuel, and of the prophets:

title: Hebrews 11:33
text: who by faith overcame kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped lions' mouths,

title: Hebrews 11:34
text: quenched [the] power of fire, escaped [the] edge of the sword, became strong out of weakness, became mighty in war, made [the] armies of strangers give way.

title: Hebrews 11:35
text: Women received their dead again by resurrection; and others were tortured, not having accepted deliverance, that they might get a better resurrection;

title: Hebrews 11:36
text: and others underwent trial of mockings and scourgings, yea, and of bonds and imprisonment.

title: Hebrews 11:37
text: They were stoned, were sawn asunder, were tempted, died by the death of the sword; they went about in sheepskins, in goatskins, destitute, afflicted, evil treated,

title: Hebrews 11:38
text: (of whom the world was not worthy,) wandering in deserts and mountains, and [in] dens and caverns of the earth.

title: Hebrews 11:39
text: And these all, having obtained witness through faith, did not receive the promise,

title: Hebrews 11:40
text: God having foreseen some better thing for us, that they should not be made perfect without us.

title: Hebrews 12:1
text: ¶Let *us* also therefore, having so great a cloud of witnesses surrounding us, laying aside every weight, and sin which so easily entangles us, run with endurance the race that lies before us,

title: Hebrews 12:2
text: looking stedfastly on Jesus the leader and completer of faith: who, in view of the joy lying before him, endured [the] cross, having despised [the] shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

title: Hebrews 12:3
text: For consider well him who endured so great contradiction from sinners against himself, that ye be not weary, fainting in your minds.

title: Hebrews 12:4
text: ¶Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, wrestling against sin.

title: Hebrews 12:5
text: And ye have quite forgotten the exhortation which speaks to you as to sons: My son, despise not [the] chastening of [the] Lord, nor faint [when] reproved by him;

title: Hebrews 12:6
text: for whom [the] Lord loves he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.

title: Hebrews 12:7
text: Ye endure for chastening, God conducts himself towards you as towards sons; for who is the son that the father chastens not?

title: Hebrews 12:8
text: But if ye are without chastening, of which all have been made partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

title: Hebrews 12:9
text: Moreover we have had the fathers of our flesh as chasteners, and we reverenced [them]; shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?

title: Hebrews 12:10
text: For they indeed chastened for a few days, as seemed good to them; but he for profit, in order to the partaking of his holiness.

title: Hebrews 12:11
text: But no chastening at the time seems to be [matter] of joy, but of grief; but afterwards yields [the] peaceful fruit of righteousness to those exercised by it.

title: Hebrews 12:12
text: Wherefore lift up the hands that hang down, and the failing knees;

title: Hebrews 12:13
text: and make straight paths for your feet, that that which is lame be not turned aside; but that rather it may be healed.

title: Hebrews 12:14
text: Pursue peace with all, and holiness, without which no one shall see the Lord:

title: Hebrews 12:15
text: watching lest [there be] any one who lacks the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble [you], and many be defiled by it;

title: Hebrews 12:16
text: lest [there be] any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one meal sold his birthright;

title: Hebrews 12:17
text: for ye know that also afterwards, desiring to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, (for he found no place for repentance) although he sought it earnestly with tears.

title: Hebrews 12:18
text: ¶For ye have not come to [the mount] that might be touched and was all on fire, and to obscurity, and darkness, and tempest,

title: Hebrews 12:19
text: and trumpet's sound, and voice of words; which they that heard, excusing themselves, declined [the] word being addressed to them any more:

title: Hebrews 12:20
text: (for they were not able to bear what was enjoined: And if a beast should touch the mountain, it shall be stoned;

title: Hebrews 12:21
text: and, so fearful was the sight, Moses said, I am exceedingly afraid and full of trembling;)

title: Hebrews 12:22
text: but ye have come to mount Zion; and to [the] city of [the] living God, heavenly Jerusalem; and to myriads of angels,

title: Hebrews 12:23
text: the universal gathering; and to [the] assembly of the firstborn [who are] registered in heaven; and to God, judge of all; and to [the] spirits of just [men] made perfect;

title: Hebrews 12:24
text: and to Jesus, mediator of a new covenant; and to [the] blood of sprinkling, speaking better than Abel.

title: Hebrews 12:25
text: See that ye refuse not him that speaks. For if those did not escape who had refused him who uttered the oracles on earth, much more we who turn away from him [who does so] from heaven:

title: Hebrews 12:26
text: whose voice then shook the earth; but now he has promised, saying, Yet once will *I* shake not only the earth, but also the heaven.

title: Hebrews 12:27
text: But this Yet once, signifies the removing of what is shaken, as being made, that what is not shaken may remain.

title: Hebrews 12:28
text: Wherefore let us, receiving a kingdom not to be shaken, have grace, by which let us serve God acceptably with reverence and fear.

title: Hebrews 12:29
text: For also our God [is] a consuming fire.

title: Hebrews 13:1
text: ¶Let brotherly love abide.

title: Hebrews 13:2
text: Be not forgetful of hospitality; for by it some have unawares entertained angels.

title: Hebrews 13:3
text: Remember prisoners, as bound with [them]; those that are evil-treated, as being yourselves also in [the] body.

title: Hebrews 13:4
text: [Let] marriage [be held] every way in honour, and the bed [be] undefiled; for fornicators and adulterers will God judge.

title: Hebrews 13:5
text: [Let your] conversation [be] without love of money, satisfied with [your] present circumstances; for *he* has said, I will not leave thee, neither will I forsake thee.

title: Hebrews 13:6
text: So that, taking courage, we may say, The Lord [is] my helper, and I will not be afraid: what will man do unto me?

title: Hebrews 13:7
text: Remember your leaders who have spoken to you the word of God; and considering the issue of their conversation, imitate their faith.

title: Hebrews 13:8
text: Jesus Christ [is] the same yesterday, and to-day, and to the ages [to come].

title: Hebrews 13:9
text: Be not carried away with various and strange doctrines; for [it is] good that the heart be confirmed with grace, not meats; those who have walked in which have not been profited by [them].

title: Hebrews 13:10
text: We have an altar of which they have no right to eat who serve the tabernacle;

title: Hebrews 13:11
text: for of those beasts whose blood is carried [as sacrifices for sin] into the [holy of] holies by the high priest, of these the bodies are burned outside the camp.

title: Hebrews 13:12
text: Wherefore also Jesus, that he might sanctify the people by his own blood, suffered without the gate:

title: Hebrews 13:13
text: therefore let us go forth to him without the camp, bearing his reproach:

title: Hebrews 13:14
text: for we have not here an abiding city, but we seek the coming one.

title: Hebrews 13:15
text: By him therefore let us offer [the] sacrifice of praise continually to God, that is, [the] fruit of [the] lips confessing his name.

title: Hebrews 13:16
text: But of doing good and communicating [of your substance] be not forgetful, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

title: Hebrews 13:17
text: Obey your leaders, and be submissive; for *they* watch over your souls as those that shall give account; that they may do this with joy, and not groaning, for this [would be] unprofitable for you.

title: Hebrews 13:18
text: ¶Pray for us: for we persuade ourselves that we have a good conscience, in all things desirous to walk rightly.

title: Hebrews 13:19
text: But I much more beseech [you] to do this, that I may the more quickly be restored to you.

title: Hebrews 13:20
text: But the God of peace, who brought again from among [the] dead our Lord Jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, in [the power of the] blood of [the] eternal covenant,

title: Hebrews 13:21
text: perfect you in every good work to the doing of his will, doing in you what is pleasing before him through Jesus Christ; to whom [be] glory for the ages of ages. Amen.

title: Hebrews 13:22
text: But I beseech you, brethren, bear the word of exhortation, for it is but in few words that I have written to you.

title: Hebrews 13:23
text: Know that our brother Timotheus is set at liberty; with whom, if he should come soon, I will see you.

title: Hebrews 13:24
text: Salute all your leaders, and all the saints. They from Italy salute you.

title: Hebrews 13:25
text: Grace [be] with you all. Amen.

title: James 1:1
text: ¶James, bondman of God and of [the] Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which [are] in the dispersion, greeting.

title: James 1:2
text: ¶Count it all joy, my brethren, when ye fall into various temptations,

title: James 1:3
text: knowing that the proving of your faith works endurance.

title: James 1:4
text: But let endurance have [its] perfect work, that ye may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

title: James 1:5
text: But if any one of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all freely and reproaches not, and it shall be given to him:

title: James 1:6
text: but let him ask in faith, nothing doubting. For he that doubts is like a wave of the sea driven by the wind and tossed about;

title: James 1:7
text: for let not that man think that he shall receive anything from the Lord;

title: James 1:8
text: [he is] a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

title: James 1:9
text: But let the brother of low degree glory in his elevation,

title: James 1:10
text: and the rich in his humiliation, because as [the] grass's flower he will pass away.

title: James 1:11
text: For the sun has risen with its burning heat, and has withered the grass, and its flower has fallen, and the comeliness of its look has perished: thus the rich also shall wither in his goings.

title: James 1:12
text: Blessed [is the] man who endures temptation; for, having been proved, he shall receive the crown of life, which He has promised to them that love him.

title: James 1:13
text: ¶Let no man, being tempted, say, I am tempted of God. For God cannot be tempted by evil things, and himself tempts no one.

title: James 1:14
text: But every one is tempted, drawn away, and enticed by his own lust;

title: James 1:15
text: then lust, having conceived, gives birth to sin; but sin fully completed brings forth death.

title: James 1:16
text: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

title: James 1:17
text: Every good gift and every perfect gift comes down from above, from the Father of lights, with whom is no variation nor shadow of turning.

title: James 1:18
text: According to his own will begat he us by the word of truth, that we should be a certain first-fruits of *his* creatures.

title: James 1:19
text: ¶So that, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath;

title: James 1:20
text: for man's wrath does not work God's righteousness.

title: James 1:21
text: Wherefore, laying aside all filthiness and abounding of wickedness, accept with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

title: James 1:22
text: But be ye doers of [the] word and not hearers only, beguiling yourselves.

title: James 1:23
text: For if any man be a hearer of [the] word and not a doer, *he* is like to a man considering his natural face in a mirror:

title: James 1:24
text: for he has considered himself and is gone away, and straightway he has forgotten what he was like.

title: James 1:25
text: But *he* that fixes his view on [the] perfect law, that of liberty, and abides in [it], being not a forgetful hearer but a doer of [the] work, *he* shall be blessed in his doing.

title: James 1:26
text: If any one think himself to be religious, not bridling his tongue, but deceiving his heart, this man's religion is vain.

title: James 1:27
text: Pure and undefiled religion before God and the Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their affliction, to keep oneself unspotted from the world.

title: James 2:1
text: ¶My brethren, do not have the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, [Lord] of glory, with respect of persons:

title: James 2:2
text: for if there come unto your synagogue a man with a gold ring in splendid apparel, and a poor man also come in in vile apparel,

title: James 2:3
text: and ye look upon him who wears the splendid apparel, and say, Do thou sit here well, and say to the poor, Do thou stand there, or sit here under my footstool:

title: James 2:4
text: have ye not made a difference among yourselves, and become judges having evil thoughts?

title: James 2:5
text: Hear, my beloved brethren: Has not God chosen the poor as to the world, rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom, which he has promised to them that love him?

title: James 2:6
text: But *ye* have despised the poor [man]. Do not the rich oppress you, and [do not] *they* drag you before [the] tribunals?

title: James 2:7
text: And [do not] *they* blaspheme the excellent name which has been called upon you?

title: James 2:8
text: ¶If indeed ye keep [the] royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well.

title: James 2:9
text: But if ye have respect of persons, ye commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

title: James 2:10
text: For whoever shall keep the whole law and shall offend in one [point], he has come under the guilt of [breaking] all.

title: James 2:11
text: For he who said, Thou shalt not commit adultery, said also, Thou shalt not kill. Now if thou dost not commit adultery, but killest, thou art become transgressor of [the] law.

title: James 2:12
text: So speak ye, and so act, as those that are to be judged by [the] law of liberty;

title: James 2:13
text: for judgment [will be] without mercy to him that has shewn no mercy. Mercy glories over judgment.

title: James 2:14
text: ¶What [is] the profit, my brethren, if any one say he have faith, but have not works? can faith save him?

title: James 2:15
text: Now if a brother or a sister is naked and destitute of daily food,

title: James 2:16
text: and one from amongst you say to them, Go in peace, be warmed and filled; but give not to them the needful things for the body, what [is] the profit?

title: James 2:17
text: So also faith, if it have not works, is dead by itself.

title: James 2:18
text: But some one will say, *Thou* hast faith and *I* have works. Shew me thy faith without works, and *I* from my works will shew thee my faith.

title: James 2:19
text: *Thou* believest that God is one. Thou doest well. The demons even believe, and tremble.

title: James 2:20
text: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

title: James 2:21
text: Was not Abraham our father justified by works when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

title: James 2:22
text: Thou seest that faith wrought with his works, and that by works faith was perfected.

title: James 2:23
text: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness, and he was called Friend of God.

title: James 2:24
text: Ye see that a man is justified on the principle of works, and not on the principle of faith only.

title: James 2:25
text: But was not in like manner also Rahab the harlot justified on the principle of works, when she had received the messengers and put [them] forth by another way?

title: James 2:26
text: For as the body without a spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.

title: James 3:1
text: ¶Be not many teachers, my brethren, knowing that we shall receive greater judgment.

title: James 3:2
text: For we all often offend. If any one offend not in word, *he* [is] a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body too.

title: James 3:3
text: Behold, we put the bits in the mouths of the horses, that they may obey us, and we turn round their whole bodies.

title: James 3:4
text: Behold also the ships, which are so great, and driven by violent winds, are turned about by a very small rudder, wherever the pleasure of the helmsman will.

title: James 3:5
text: Thus also the tongue is a little member, and boasts great things. See how little a fire, how large a wood it kindles!

title: James 3:6
text: and the tongue [is] fire, the world of unrighteousness; the tongue is set in our members, the defiler of the whole body, and which sets fire to the course of nature, and is set on fire of hell.

title: James 3:7
text: For every species both of beasts and of birds, both of creeping things and of sea animals, is tamed and has been tamed by the human species;

title: James 3:8
text: but the tongue can no one among men tame; [it is] an unsettled evil, full of death-bringing poison.

title: James 3:9
text: Therewith bless we the Lord and Father, and therewith curse we men made after [the] likeness of God.

title: James 3:10
text: Out of the same mouth goes forth blessing and cursing. It is not right, my brethren, that these things should be thus.

title: James 3:11
text: Does the fountain, out of the same opening, pour forth sweet and bitter?

title: James 3:12
text: Can, my brethren, a fig produce olives, or a vine figs? Neither [can] salt [water] make sweet water.

title: James 3:13
text: ¶Who [is] wise and understanding among you; let him shew out of a good conversation his works in meekness of wisdom;

title: James 3:14
text: but if ye have bitter emulation and strife in your hearts, do not boast and lie against the truth.

title: James 3:15
text: This is not the wisdom which comes down from above, but earthly, natural, devilish.

title: James 3:16
text: For where emulation and strife [are], there [is] disorder and every evil thing.

title: James 3:17
text: But the wisdom from above first is pure, then peaceful, gentle, yielding, full of mercy and good fruits, unquestioning, unfeigned.

title: James 3:18
text: But [the] fruit of righteousness in peace is sown for them that make peace.

title: James 4:1
text: ¶Whence [come] wars and whence fightings among you? [Is it] not thence, --from your pleasures, which war in your members?

title: James 4:2
text: Ye lust and have not: ye kill and are full of envy, and cannot obtain; ye fight and war; ye have not because ye ask not.

title: James 4:3
text: Ye ask and receive not, because ye ask evilly, that ye may consume [it] in your pleasures.

title: James 4:4
text: Adulteresses, know ye not that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore is minded to be [the] friend of the world is constituted enemy of God.

title: James 4:5
text: Think ye that the scripture speaks in vain? Does the Spirit which has taken his abode in us desire enviously?

title: James 4:6
text: But he gives more grace. Wherefore he says, God sets himself against [the] proud, but gives grace to [the] lowly.

title: James 4:7
text: Subject yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

title: James 4:8
text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse [your] hands, sinners, and purify [your] hearts, ye double-minded.

title: James 4:9
text: Be wretched, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and [your] joy to heaviness.

title: James 4:10
text: Humble yourselves before [the] Lord, and he shall exalt you.

title: James 4:11
text: ¶Speak not against one another, brethren. He that speaks against [his] brother, or judges his brother, speaks against [the] law and judges [the] law. But if thou judgest [the] law, thou art not doer of [the] law, but judge.

title: James 4:12
text: One is the lawgiver and judge, who is able to save and to destroy: but who art *thou* who judgest thy neighbour?

title: James 4:13
text: Go to now, ye who say, To-day or to-morrow will we go into such a city and spend a year there, and traffic and make gain,

title: James 4:14
text: ye who do not know what will be on the morrow, ([for] what [is] your life? It is even a vapour, appearing for a little while, and then disappearing,)

title: James 4:15
text: instead of your saying, If the Lord should [so] will and we should live, we will also do this or that.

title: James 4:16
text: But now ye glory in your vauntings: all such glorying is evil.

title: James 4:17
text: To him therefore who knows how to do good, and does it not, to him it is sin.

title: James 5:1
text: ¶Go to now, ye rich, weep, howling over your miseries that [are] coming upon [you].

title: James 5:2
text: Your wealth is become rotten, and your garments moth-eaten.

title: James 5:3
text: Your gold and silver is eaten away, and their canker shall be for a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as fire. Ye have heaped up treasure in [the] last days.

title: James 5:4
text: Behold, the wages of your labourers, who have harvested your fields, wrongfully kept back by you, cry, and the cries of those that have reaped are entered into the ears of [the] Lord of sabaoth.

title: James 5:5
text: Ye have lived luxuriously on the earth and indulged yourselves; ye have nourished your hearts [as] in a day of slaughter;

title: James 5:6
text: ye have condemned, ye have killed the just; he does not resist you.

title: James 5:7
text: Have patience, therefore, brethren, till the coming of the Lord. Behold, the labourer awaits the precious fruit of the earth, having patience for it until it receive [the] early and [the] latter rain.

title: James 5:8
text: *Ye* also have patience: stablish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is drawn nigh.

title: James 5:9
text: Complain not one against another, brethren, that ye be not judged. Behold, the judge stands before the door.

title: James 5:10
text: Take [as] an example, brethren, of suffering and having patience, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of [the] Lord.

title: James 5:11
text: Behold, we call them blessed who have endured. Ye have heard of the endurance of Job, and seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is full of tender compassion and pitiful.

title: James 5:12
text: ¶But before all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath; but let your yea be yea, and your nay, nay, that ye do not fall under judgment.

title: James 5:13
text: Does any one among you suffer evil? let him pray. Is any happy? let him sing psalms.

title: James 5:14
text: Is any sick among you? let him call to [him] the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of [the] Lord;

title: James 5:15
text: and the prayer of faith shall heal the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he be one who has committed sins, it shall be forgiven him.

title: James 5:16
text: Confess therefore your offences to one another, and pray for one another, that ye may be healed. [The] fervent supplication of the righteous [man] has much power.

title: James 5:17
text: Elias was a man of like passions to us, and he prayed with prayer that it should not rain; and it did not rain upon the earth three years and six months;

title: James 5:18
text: and again he prayed, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth caused its fruit to spring forth.

title: James 5:19
text: My brethren, if any one among you err from the truth, and one bring him back,

title: James 5:20
text: let him know that he that brings back a sinner from [the] error of his way shall save a soul from death and shall cover a multitude of sins.

title: I Peter 1:1
text: ¶Peter, apostle of Jesus Christ, to [the] sojourners of [the] dispersion of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

title: I Peter 1:2
text: elect according to [the] foreknowledge of God [the] Father, by sanctification of [the] Spirit, unto [the] obedience and sprinkling of [the] blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

title: I Peter 1:3
text: ¶Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who, according to his great mercy, has begotten us again to a living hope through [the] resurrection of Jesus Christ from among [the] dead,

title: I Peter 1:4
text: to an incorruptible and undefiled and unfading inheritance, reserved in [the] heavens for you,

title: I Peter 1:5
text: who are kept guarded by [the] power of God through faith for salvation ready to be revealed in [the] last time.

title: I Peter 1:6
text: ¶Wherein ye exult, for a little while at present, if needed, put to grief by various trials,

title: I Peter 1:7
text: that the proving of your faith, much more precious than of gold which perishes, though it be proved by fire, be found to praise and glory and honour in [the] revelation of Jesus Christ:

title: I Peter 1:8
text: whom, having not seen, ye love; on whom [though] not now looking, but believing, ye exult with joy unspeakable and filled with [the] glory,

title: I Peter 1:9
text: receiving the end of your faith, [the] salvation of [your] souls.

title: I Peter 1:10
text: ¶Concerning which salvation prophets, who have prophesied of the grace towards you, sought out and searched out;

title: I Peter 1:11
text: searching what, or what manner of time, the Spirit of Christ which [was] in them pointed out, testifying before of the sufferings which [belonged] to Christ, and the glories after these.

title: I Peter 1:12
text: To whom it was revealed, that not to themselves but to you they ministered those things, which have now been announced to you by those who have declared to you the glad tidings by [the] Holy Spirit, sent from heaven, which angels desire to look into.

title: I Peter 1:13
text: ¶Wherefore, having girded up the loins of your mind, [be] sober [and] hope with perfect stedfastness in the grace [which will be] brought to you at [the] revelation of Jesus Christ;

title: I Peter 1:14
text: as children of obedience, not conformed to [your] former lusts in your ignorance;

title: I Peter 1:15
text: but as he who has called you is holy, be ye also holy in all [your] conversation;

title: I Peter 1:16
text: because it is written, Be ye holy, for *I* am holy.

title: I Peter 1:17
text: And if ye invoke as Father him who, without regard of persons, judges according to the work of each, pass your time of sojourn in fear,

title: I Peter 1:18
text: knowing that ye have been redeemed, not by corruptible [things, as] silver or gold, from your vain conversation handed down from [your] fathers,

title: I Peter 1:19
text: but by precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot, [the blood] of Christ,

title: I Peter 1:20
text: foreknown indeed before [the] foundation of [the] world, but who has been manifested at the end of times for your sakes,

title: I Peter 1:21
text: who by him do believe on God, who has raised him from among [the] dead and given him glory, that your faith and hope should be in God.

title: I Peter 1:22
text: Having purified your souls by obedience to the truth to unfeigned brotherly love, love one another out of a pure heart fervently;

title: I Peter 1:23
text: being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by [the] living and abiding word of God.

title: I Peter 1:24
text: ¶Because all flesh [is] as grass, and all its glory as [the] flower of grass. The grass has withered and [its] flower has fallen;

title: I Peter 1:25
text: but the word of [the] Lord abides for eternity. But this is the word which in the glad tidings [is] preached to you.

title: I Peter 2:1
text: ¶Laying aside therefore all malice and all guile and hypocrisies and envyings and all evil speakings,

title: I Peter 2:2
text: as newborn babes desire earnestly the pure mental milk of the word, that by it ye may grow up to salvation,

title: I Peter 2:3
text: if indeed ye have tasted that the Lord [is] good.

title: I Peter 2:4
text: ¶To whom coming, a living stone, cast away indeed as worthless by men, but with God chosen, precious,

title: I Peter 2:5
text: yourselves also, as living stones, are being built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

title: I Peter 2:6
text: Because it is contained in the scripture: Behold, I lay in Zion a corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believes on him shall not be put to shame.

title: I Peter 2:7
text: To you therefore who believe [is] the preciousness; but to the disobedient, the stone which the builders cast away as worthless, this is become head of [the] corner,

title: I Peter 2:8
text: and a stone of stumbling and rock of offence; [who] stumble at the word, being disobedient to which also they have been appointed.

title: I Peter 2:9
text: But *ye* [are] a chosen race, a kingly priesthood, a holy nation, a people for a possession, that ye might set forth the excellencies of him who has called you out of darkness to his wonderful light;

title: I Peter 2:10
text: who once [were] not a people, but now God's people; who were not enjoying mercy, but now have found mercy.

title: I Peter 2:11
text: Beloved, I exhort [you], as strangers and sojourners, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

title: I Peter 2:12
text: having your conversation honest among the Gentiles, that [as to that] in which they speak against you as evildoers, they may through [your] good works, [themselves] witnessing [them], glorify God in [the] day of visitation.

title: I Peter 2:13
text: ¶Be in subjection [therefore] to every human institution for the Lord's sake; whether to [the] king as supreme,

title: I Peter 2:14
text: or to rulers as sent by him, for vengeance on evildoers, and praise to them that do well.

title: I Peter 2:15
text: Because so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye put to silence the ignorance of senseless men;

title: I Peter 2:16
text: as free, and not as having liberty as a cloak of malice, but as God's bondmen.

title: I Peter 2:17
text: Shew honour to all, love the brotherhood, fear God, honour the king.

title: I Peter 2:18
text: Servants, [be] subject with all fear to your masters, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the ill-tempered.

title: I Peter 2:19
text: For this [is] acceptable, if one, for conscience sake towards God, endure griefs, suffering unjustly.

title: I Peter 2:20
text: For what glory [is it], if sinning and being buffeted ye shall bear [it]? but if, doing good and suffering, ye shall bear [it], this is acceptable with God.

title: I Peter 2:21
text: For to this have ye been called; for Christ also has suffered for you, leaving you a model that ye should follow in his steps:

title: I Peter 2:22
text: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth;

title: I Peter 2:23
text: who, [when] reviled, reviled not again; [when] suffering, threatened not; but gave [himself] over into the hands of him who judges righteously;

title: I Peter 2:24
text: who himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, in order that, being dead to sins, we may live to righteousness: by whose stripes ye have been healed.

title: I Peter 2:25
text: For ye were going astray as sheep, but have now returned to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.

title: I Peter 3:1
text: ¶Likewise, wives, [be] subject to your own husbands, that, even if any are disobedient to the word, they may be gained without [the] word by the conversation of the wives,

title: I Peter 3:2
text: having witnessed your pure conversation [carried out] in fear;

title: I Peter 3:3
text: whose adorning let it not be that outward one of tressing of hair, and wearing gold, or putting on apparel;

title: I Peter 3:4
text: but the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible [ornament] of a meek and quiet spirit, which in the sight of God is of great price.

title: I Peter 3:5
text: For thus also the holy women who have hoped in God heretofore adorned themselves, being subject to their own husbands;

title: I Peter 3:6
text: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord; whose children ye have become, doing good, and not fearing with any kind of consternation.

title: I Peter 3:7
text: [Ye] husbands likewise, dwell with [them] according to knowledge, as with a weaker, [even] the female, vessel, giving [them] honour, as also fellow-heirs of [the] grace of life, that your prayers be not hindered.

title: I Peter 3:8
text: ¶Finally, [be] all of one mind, sympathising, full of brotherly love, tender hearted, humble minded;

title: I Peter 3:9
text: not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing; but on the contrary, blessing [others], because ye have been called to this, that ye should inherit blessing.

title: I Peter 3:10
text: For he that will love life and see good days, let him cause his tongue to cease from evil and his lips that they speak no guile.

title: I Peter 3:11
text: And let him avoid evil, and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it;

title: I Peter 3:12
text: because [the] eyes of [the] Lord [are] on [the] righteous, and his ears towards their supplications; but [the] face of [the] Lord [is] against them that do evil.

title: I Peter 3:13
text: And who shall injure you if ye have become imitators of that which [is] good?

title: I Peter 3:14
text: But if also ye should suffer for righteousness' sake, blessed [are ye]; but be not afraid of their fear, neither be troubled;

title: I Peter 3:15
text: but sanctify [the] Lord the Christ in your hearts, and [be] always prepared to [give] an answer [to] every one that asks you to give an account of the hope that [is] in you, but with meekness and fear;

title: I Peter 3:16
text: ¶having a good conscience, that [as to that] in which they speak against you as evildoers, they may be ashamed who calumniate your good conversation in Christ.

title: I Peter 3:17
text: For [it is] better, if the will of God should will it, to suffer [as] well-doers than [as] evildoers;

title: I Peter 3:18
text: ¶for Christ indeed has once suffered for sins, [the] just for [the] unjust, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in flesh, but made alive in [the] Spirit,

title: I Peter 3:19
text: in which also going he preached to the spirits [which are] in prison,

title: I Peter 3:20
text: heretofore disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in [the] days of Noah while the ark was preparing, into which few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:

title: I Peter 3:21
text: ¶which figure also now saves you, [even] baptism, not a putting away of [the] filth of flesh, but [the] demand as before God of a good conscience, by [the] resurrection of Jesus Christ,

title: I Peter 3:22
text: who is at [the] right hand of God, gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being subjected to him.

title: I Peter 4:1
text: ¶Christ, then, having suffered for us in [the] flesh, do *ye* also arm yourselves with the same mind; for he that has suffered in [the] flesh has done with sin,

title: I Peter 4:2
text: no longer to live the rest of [his] time in [the] flesh to men's lusts, but to God's will.

title: I Peter 4:3
text: For the time past [is] sufficient [for us] to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, walking in lasciviousness, lusts, wine-drinking, revels, drinkings, and unhallowed idolatries.

title: I Peter 4:4
text: ¶Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with [them] to the same sink of corruption, speaking injuriously [of you];

title: I Peter 4:5
text: who shall render account to him who is ready to judge [the] living and [the] dead.

title: I Peter 4:6
text: For to this [end] were the glad tidings preached to [the] dead also, that they might be judged, as regards men, after [the] flesh, but live, as regards God, after [the] Spirit.

title: I Peter 4:7
text: ¶But the end of all things is drawn nigh: be sober therefore, and be watchful unto prayers;

title: I Peter 4:8
text: but before all things having fervent love among yourselves, because love covers a multitude of sins;

title: I Peter 4:9
text: hospitable one to another, without murmuring;

title: I Peter 4:10
text: each according as he has received a gift, ministering it to one another, as good stewards of [the] various grace of God.

title: I Peter 4:11
text: If any one speak--as oracles of God; if any one minister--as of strength which God supplies; that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom is the glory and the might for the ages of ages. Amen.

title: I Peter 4:12
text: ¶Beloved, take not [as] strange the fire [of persecution] which has taken place amongst you for [your] trial, as if a strange thing was happening to you;

title: I Peter 4:13
text: but as ye have share in the sufferings of Christ, rejoice, that in the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exultation.

title: I Peter 4:14
text: If ye are reproached in [the] name of Christ, blessed [are ye]; for the [Spirit] of glory and the Spirit of God rests upon you: [on their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.]

title: I Peter 4:15
text: Let none of you suffer indeed as murderer, or thief, or evildoer, or as overseer of other people's matters;

title: I Peter 4:16
text: but if as a christian, let him not be ashamed, but glorify God in this name.

title: I Peter 4:17
text: For the time of having the judgment begin from the house of God [is come]; but if first from us, what [shall be] the end of those who obey not the glad tidings of God?

title: I Peter 4:18
text: And if the righteous is difficultly saved, where shall the impious and [the] sinner appear?

title: I Peter 4:19
text: Wherefore also let them who suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing to a faithful Creator.

title: I Peter 5:1
text: ¶The elders which [are] among you I exhort, who [am their] fellow-elder and witness of the sufferings of the Christ, who also [am] partaker of the glory about to be revealed:

title: I Peter 5:2
text: shepherd the flock of God which [is] among you, exercising oversight, not by necessity, but willingly; not for base gain, but readily;

title: I Peter 5:3
text: not as lording it over your possessions, but being models for the flock.

title: I Peter 5:4
text: And when the chief shepherd is manifested ye shall receive the unfading crown of glory.

title: I Peter 5:5
text: ¶Likewise [ye] younger, be subject to [the] elder, and all of you bind on humility towards one another; for God sets himself against [the] proud, but to [the] humble gives grace.

title: I Peter 5:6
text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in [the due] time;

title: I Peter 5:7
text: having cast all your care upon him, for he cares about you.

title: I Peter 5:8
text: ¶Be vigilant, watch. Your adversary [the] devil as a roaring lion walks about seeking whom he may devour.

title: I Peter 5:9
text: Whom resist, stedfast in faith, knowing that the selfsame sufferings are accomplished in your brotherhood which [is] in [the] world.

title: I Peter 5:10
text: ¶But the God of all grace who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ Jesus, when ye have suffered for a little while, himself shall make perfect, stablish, strengthen, ground:

title: I Peter 5:11
text: to him [be] the glory and the might for the ages of the ages. Amen.

title: I Peter 5:12
text: By Silvanus, the faithful brother, as I suppose, I have written to you briefly; exhorting and testifying that this is [the] true grace of God in which ye stand.

title: I Peter 5:13
text: She that is elected with [you] in Babylon salutes you, and Marcus my son.

title: I Peter 5:14
text: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be with you all who [are] in Christ.

title: II Peter 1:1
text: ¶Simon Peter, bondman and apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have received like precious faith with us through [the] righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ:

title: II Peter 1:2
text: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in [the] knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

title: II Peter 1:3
text: As his divine power has given to us all things which relate to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that has called us by glory and virtue,

title: II Peter 1:4
text: through which he has given to us the greatest and precious promises, that through these ye may become partakers of [the] divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

title: II Peter 1:5
text: ¶But for this very reason also, using therewith all diligence, in your faith have also virtue, in virtue knowledge,

title: II Peter 1:6
text: in knowledge temperance, in temperance endurance, in endurance godliness,

title: II Peter 1:7
text: in godliness brotherly love, in brotherly love love:

title: II Peter 1:8
text: for these things existing and abounding in you make [you] to be neither idle nor unfruitful as regards the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: II Peter 1:9
text: for he with whom these things are not present is blind, short-sighted, and has forgotten the purging of his former sins.

title: II Peter 1:10
text: Wherefore the rather, brethren, use diligence to make your calling and election sure, for doing these things ye will never fall;

title: II Peter 1:11
text: for thus shall the entrance into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ be richly furnished unto you.

title: II Peter 1:12
text: ¶Wherefore I will be careful to put you always in mind of these things, although knowing [them] and established in the present truth.

title: II Peter 1:13
text: But I account it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting [you] in remembrance,

title: II Peter 1:14
text: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle is speedily [to take place], as also our Lord Jesus Christ has manifested to me;

title: II Peter 1:15
text: but I will use diligence, that after my departure ye should have also, at any time, [in your power] to call to mind these things.

title: II Peter 1:16
text: ¶For we have not made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, following cleverly imagined fables, but having been eyewitnesses of *his* majesty.

title: II Peter 1:17
text: For he received from God [the] Father honour and glory, such a voice being uttered to him by the excellent glory: This is my beloved Son, in whom *I* have found my delight;

title: II Peter 1:18
text: and this voice *we* heard uttered from heaven, being with him on the holy mountain.

title: II Peter 1:19
text: ¶And we have the prophetic word [made] surer, to which ye do well taking heed (as to a lamp shining in an obscure place) until [the] day dawn and [the] morning star arise in your hearts;

title: II Peter 1:20
text: knowing this first, that [the scope of] no prophecy of scripture is had from its own particular interpretation,

title: II Peter 1:21
text: for prophecy was not ever uttered by [the] will of man, but holy men of God spake under the power of [the] Holy Spirit.

title: II Peter 2:1
text: ¶But there were false prophets also among the people, as there shall be also among you false teachers, who shall bring in by the bye destructive heresies, and deny the master that bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction;

title: II Peter 2:2
text: and many shall follow their dissolute ways, through whom the way of the truth shall be blasphemed.

title: II Peter 2:3
text: ¶And through covetousness, with well-turned words, will they make merchandise of you: for whom judgment of old is not idle, and their destruction slumbers not.

title: II Peter 2:4
text: For if God spared not [the] angels who had sinned, but having cast them down to the deepest pit of gloom has delivered them to chains of darkness [to be] kept for judgment;

title: II Peter 2:5
text: and spared not [the] old world, but preserved Noe, [the] eighth, a preacher of righteousness, having brought in [the] flood upon [the] world of [the] ungodly;

title: II Peter 2:6
text: and having reduced [the] cities of Sodom and Gomorrha to ashes, condemned [them] with an overthrow, setting [them as] an example to those that should [afterwards] live an ungodly life;

title: II Peter 2:7
text: ¶and saved righteous Lot, distressed with the abandoned conversation of the godless,

title: II Peter 2:8
text: (for the righteous man through seeing and hearing, dwelling among them, tormented [his] righteous soul day after day with [their] lawless works,)

title: II Peter 2:9
text: [the] Lord knows [how] to deliver the godly out of trial, and to keep [the] unjust to [the] day of judgment [to be] punished;

title: II Peter 2:10
text: ¶and specially those who walk after the flesh in [the] lust of uncleanness, and despise lordship. Bold [are they], self-willed; they do not fear speaking injuriously of dignities:

title: II Peter 2:11
text: when angels, who are greater in might and power, do not bring against them, before the Lord, an injurious charge.

title: II Peter 2:12
text: But these, as natural animals without reason, made to be caught and destroyed, speaking injuriously in things they are ignorant of, shall also perish in their own corruption,

title: II Peter 2:13
text: receiving [the] reward of unrighteousness; accounting ephemeral indulgence pleasure; spots and blemishes, rioting in their own deceits, feasting with you;

title: II Peter 2:14
text: having eyes full of adultery, and that cease not from sin, alluring unestablished souls; having a heart practised in covetousness, children of curse;

title: II Peter 2:15
text: having left [the] straight way they have gone astray, having followed in the path of Balaam [the son] of Bosor, who loved [the] reward of unrighteousness;

title: II Peter 2:16
text: but had reproof of his own wickedness--[the] dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the folly of the prophet.

title: II Peter 2:17
text: These are springs without water, and mists driven by storm, to whom the gloom of darkness is reserved [for ever].

title: II Peter 2:18
text: For [while] speaking great highflown words of vanity, they allure with [the] lusts of [the] flesh, by dissoluteness, those who have just fled those who walk in error,

title: II Peter 2:19
text: promising them liberty, while they themselves are slaves of corruption; for by whom a man is subdued, by him is he also brought into slavery.

title: II Peter 2:20
text: For if after having escaped the pollutions of the world through [the] knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, again entangled, they are subdued by these, their last state is worse than the first.

title: II Peter 2:21
text: For it were better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than having known [it] to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

title: II Peter 2:22
text: But that [word] of the true proverb has happened to them: [The] dog [has] turned back to his own vomit; and, [The] washed sow to [her] rolling in mud.

title: II Peter 3:1
text: ¶This, a second letter, beloved, I already write to you, in [both] which I stir up, in the way of putting you in remembrance, your pure mind,

title: II Peter 3:2
text: to be mindful of the words spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of the Lord and Saviour by your apostles;

title: II Peter 3:3
text: ¶knowing this first, that there shall come at [the] close of the days mockers with mocking, walking according to their own lusts,

title: II Peter 3:4
text: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for from the time the fathers fell asleep all things remain thus from [the] beginning of [the] creation.

title: II Peter 3:5
text: For this is hidden from them through their own wilfulness, that heavens were of old, and an earth, having its subsistence out of water and in water, by the word of God,

title: II Peter 3:6
text: through which [waters] the then world, deluged with water, perished.

title: II Peter 3:7
text: But the present heavens and the earth by his word are laid up in store, kept for fire unto a day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

title: II Peter 3:8
text: ¶But let not this one thing be hidden from you, beloved, that one day with [the] Lord [is] as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

title: II Peter 3:9
text: ¶[The] Lord does not delay his promise, as some account of delay, but is longsuffering towards you, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

title: II Peter 3:10
text: But the day of [the] Lord will come as a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a rushing noise, and [the] elements, burning with heat, shall be dissolved, and [the] earth and the works in it shall be burnt up.

title: II Peter 3:11
text: ¶All these things then being to be dissolved, what ought ye to be in holy conversation and godliness,

title: II Peter 3:12
text: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, by reason of which [the] heavens, being on fire, shall be dissolved, and [the] elements, burning with heat, shall melt?

title: II Peter 3:13
text: But, according to his promise, we wait for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwells righteousness.

title: II Peter 3:14
text: Wherefore, beloved, as ye wait for these things, be diligent to be found of him in peace, without spot and blameless;

title: II Peter 3:15
text: and account the longsuffering of our Lord [to be] salvation; according as our beloved brother Paul also has written to you according to the wisdom given to him,

title: II Peter 3:16
text: as also in all [his] epistles, speaking in them of these things; among which some things are hard to be understood, which the untaught and ill-established wrest, as also the other scriptures, to their own destruction.

title: II Peter 3:17
text: *Ye* therefore, beloved, knowing [these] things before, take care lest, being led away along with the error of the wicked, ye should fall from your own stedfastness:

title: II Peter 3:18
text: but grow in grace, and in [the] knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him [be] glory both now and to [the] day of eternity. Amen.

title: I John 1:1
text: ¶That which was from [the] beginning, that which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes; that which we contemplated, and our hands handled, concerning the word of life;

title: I John 1:2
text: (and the life has been manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and report to you the eternal life, which was with the Father, and has been manifested to us:)

title: I John 1:3
text: that which we have seen and heard we report to you, that *ye* also may have fellowship with us; and our fellowship [is] indeed with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

title: I John 1:4
text: And these things write we to you that your joy may be full.

title: I John 1:5
text: ¶And this is the message which we have heard from him, and declare to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

title: I John 1:6
text: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not practise the truth.

title: I John 1:7
text: But if we walk in the light as *he* is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

title: I John 1:8
text: ¶If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

title: I John 1:9
text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us [our] sins, and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

title: I John 1:10
text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

title: I John 2:1
text: ¶My children, these things I write to you in order that ye may not sin; and if any one sin, we have a patron with the Father, Jesus Christ [the] righteous;

title: I John 2:2
text: and *he* is the propitiation for our sins; but not for ours alone, but also for the whole world.

title: I John 2:3
text: ¶And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

title: I John 2:4
text: He that says, I know him, and does not keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;

title: I John 2:5
text: but whoever keeps his word, in him verily the love of God is perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him.

title: I John 2:6
text: He that says he abides in him ought, even as *he* walked, himself also [so] to walk.

title: I John 2:7
text: ¶Beloved, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment, which ye have had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye heard.

title: I John 2:8
text: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which thing is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light already shines.

title: I John 2:9
text: He who says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in the darkness until now.

title: I John 2:10
text: He that loves his brother abides in light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.

title: I John 2:11
text: But he that hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and knows not where he goes, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

title: I John 2:12
text: ¶I write to you, children, because [your] sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

title: I John 2:13
text: I write to you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked [one]. I write to you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

title: I John 2:14
text: I have written to you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and ye have overcome the wicked [one].

title: I John 2:15
text: Love not the world, nor the things in the world. If any one love the world, the love of the Father is not in him;

title: I John 2:16
text: because all that [is] in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

title: I John 2:17
text: And the world is passing, and its lust, but he that does the will of God abides for eternity.

title: I John 2:18
text: ¶Little children, it is [the] last hour, and, according as ye have heard that antichrist comes, even now there have come many antichrists, whence we know that it is [the] last hour.

title: I John 2:19
text: They went out from among us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have surely remained with us, but that they might be made manifest that none are of us.

title: I John 2:20
text: ¶And *ye* have [the] unction from the holy [one], and ye know all things.

title: I John 2:21
text: I have not written to you because ye do not know the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

title: I John 2:22
text: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? *He* is the antichrist who denies the Father and the Son.

title: I John 2:23
text: Whoever denies the Son has not the Father either; he who confesses the Son has the Father also.

title: I John 2:24
text: As for *you* let that which ye have heard from the beginning abide in you: if what ye have heard from the beginning abides in you, *ye* also shall abide in the Son and in the Father.

title: I John 2:25
text: And this is the promise which *he* has promised us, life eternal.

title: I John 2:26
text: These things have I written to you concerning those who lead you astray:

title: I John 2:27
text: and *yourselves*, the unction which ye have received from him abides in you, and ye have not need that any one should teach you; but as the same unction teaches you as to all things, and is true and is not a lie, and even as it has taught you, ye shall abide in him.

title: I John 2:28
text: ¶And now, children, abide in him, that if he be manifested we may have boldness, and not be put to shame from before him at his coming.

title: I John 2:29
text: If ye know that he is righteous, know that every one who practises righteousness is begotten of him.

title: I John 3:1
text: ¶See what love the Father has given to us, that we should be called [the] children of God. For this reason the world knows us not, because it knew him not.

title: I John 3:2
text: Beloved, now are we children of God, and what we shall be has not yet been manifested; we know that if it is manifested we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

title: I John 3:3
text: And every one that has this hope in him purifies himself, even as *he* is pure.

title: I John 3:4
text: ¶Every one that practises sin practises also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.

title: I John 3:5
text: And ye know that *he* has been manifested that he might take away our sins; and in him sin is not.

title: I John 3:6
text: Whoever abides in him, does not sin: whoever sins, has not seen him or known him.

title: I John 3:7
text: Children, let no man lead you astray; he that practises righteousness is righteous, even as *he* is righteous.

title: I John 3:8
text: He that practises sin is of the devil; for from [the] beginning the devil sins. To this end the Son of God has been manifested, that he might undo the works of the devil.

title: I John 3:9
text: Whoever has been begotten of God does not practise sin, because his seed abides in him, and he cannot sin, because he has been begotten of God.

title: I John 3:10
text: In this are manifest the children of God and the children of the devil. Whoever does not practise righteousness is not of God, and he who does not love his brother.

title: I John 3:11
text: ¶For this is the message which ye have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another:

title: I John 3:12
text: not as Cain was of the wicked one, and slew his brother; and on account of what slew he him? because his works were wicked, and those of his brother righteous.
