title: I John 3:13
text: Do not wonder, brethren, if the world hate you.

title: I John 3:14
text: ¶*We* know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brethren. He who does not love [his] brother abides in death.

title: I John 3:15
text: Every one that hates his brother is a murderer, and ye know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.

title: I John 3:16
text: Hereby we have known love, because *he* has laid down his life for us; and *we* ought for the brethren to lay down [our] lives.

title: I John 3:17
text: But whoso may have the world's substance, and see his brother having need, and shut up his bowels from him, how abides the love of God in him?

title: I John 3:18
text: Children, let us not love with word, nor with tongue, but in deed and in truth.

title: I John 3:19
text: And hereby we shall know that we are of the truth, and shall persuade our hearts before him--

title: I John 3:20
text: ¶that if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.

title: I John 3:21
text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have boldness towards God,

title: I John 3:22
text: and whatsoever we ask we receive from him, because we keep his commandments, and practise the things which are pleasing in his sight.

title: I John 3:23
text: ¶And this is his commandment, that we believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and that we love one another, even as he has given us commandment.

title: I John 3:24
text: And he that keeps his commandments abides in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abides in us, by the Spirit which he has given to us.

title: I John 4:1
text: ¶Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, if they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

title: I John 4:2
text: Hereby ye know the Spirit of God: every spirit which confesses Jesus Christ come in flesh is of God;

title: I John 4:3
text: and every spirit which does not confess Jesus Christ come in flesh is not of God: and this is that [power] of the antichrist, [of] which ye have heard that it comes, and now it is already in the world.

title: I John 4:4
text: ¶*Ye* are of God, children, and have overcome them, because greater is he that [is] in you than he that [is] in the world.

title: I John 4:5
text: *They* are of the world; for this reason they speak [as] of the world, and the world hears them.

title: I John 4:6
text: *We* are of God; he that knows God hears us; he who is not of God does not hear us. From this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

title: I John 4:7
text: ¶Beloved, let us love one another; because love is of God, and every one that loves has been begotten of God, and knows God.

title: I John 4:8
text: He that loves not has not known God; for God is love.

title: I John 4:9
text: Herein as to us has been manifested the love of God, that God has sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

title: I John 4:10
text: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son a propitiation for our sins.

title: I John 4:11
text: Beloved, if God has so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

title: I John 4:12
text: No one has seen God at any time: if we love one another, God abides in us, and his love is perfected in us.

title: I John 4:13
text: Hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, that he has given to us of his Spirit.

title: I John 4:14
text: ¶And *we* have seen, and testify, that the Father has sent the Son [as] Saviour of the world.

title: I John 4:15
text: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

title: I John 4:16
text: And *we* have known and have believed the love which God has to us. God is love, and he that abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

title: I John 4:17
text: ¶Herein has love been perfected with us that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, that even as *he* is, *we* also are in this world.

title: I John 4:18
text: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear; for fear has torment, and he that fears has not been made perfect in love.

title: I John 4:19
text: *We* love because *he* has first loved us.

title: I John 4:20
text: If any one say, I love God, and hate his brother, he is a liar: for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

title: I John 4:21
text: And this commandment have we from him, That he that loves God love also his brother.

title: I John 5:1
text: ¶Every one that believes that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God; and every one that loves him that has begotten loves also him that is begotten of him.

title: I John 5:2
text: Hereby know we that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

title: I John 5:3
text: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments; and his commandments are not grievous.

title: I John 5:4
text: For all that has been begotten of God gets the victory over the world; and this is the victory which has gotten the victory over the world, our faith.

title: I John 5:5
text: Who is he that gets the victory over the world, but he that believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

title: I John 5:6
text: ¶This is he that came by water and blood, Jesus [the] Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, for the Spirit is the truth.

title: I John 5:7
text: For they that bear witness are three:

title: I John 5:8
text: the Spirit, and the water, and the blood; and the three agree in one.

title: I John 5:9
text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater. For this is the witness of God [which] he has witnessed concerning his Son.

title: I John 5:10
text: ¶He that believes on the Son of God has the witness in himself; he that does not believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the witness which God has witnessed concerning his Son.

title: I John 5:11
text: And this is the witness, that God has given to us eternal life; and this life is in his Son.

title: I John 5:12
text: He that has the Son has life: he that has not the Son of God has not life.

title: I John 5:13
text: These things have I written to you that ye may know that ye have eternal life who believe on the name of the Son of God.

title: I John 5:14
text: ¶And this is the boldness which we have towards him, that if we ask him anything according to his will he hears us.

title: I John 5:15
text: And if we know that he hears us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

title: I John 5:16
text: If any one see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life, for those that do not sin unto death. There is a sin to death: I do not say of that that he should make a request.

title: I John 5:17
text: Every unrighteousness is sin; and there is a sin not to death.

title: I John 5:18
text: ¶We know that every one begotten of God does not sin, but he that has been begotten of God keeps himself, and the wicked [one] does not touch him.

title: I John 5:19
text: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the wicked [one].

title: I John 5:20
text: And we know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding that we should know him that [is] true; and we are in him that [is] true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

title: I John 5:21
text: Children, keep yourselves from idols.

title: II John 1:1
text: ¶The elder to [the] elect lady and her children, whom *I* love in truth, and not *I* only but also all who have known the truth,

title: II John 1:2
text: for the truth's sake which abides in us and shall be with us to eternity.

title: II John 1:3
text: Grace shall be with you, mercy, peace from God [the] Father, and from [the] Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

title: II John 1:4
text: I rejoiced greatly that I have found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received commandment from the Father.

title: II John 1:5
text: ¶And now I beseech thee, lady, not as writing to thee a new commandment, but that which we have had from [the] beginning, that we should love one another.

title: II John 1:6
text: And this is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, according as ye have heard from the beginning, that ye might walk in it.

title: II John 1:7
text: ¶For many deceivers have gone out into the world, they who do not confess Jesus Christ coming in flesh--this is the deceiver and the antichrist.

title: II John 1:8
text: See to yourselves, that we may not lose what we have wrought, but may receive full wages.

title: II John 1:9
text: Whosoever goes forward and abides not in the doctrine of the Christ has not God. He that abides in the doctrine, *he* has both the Father and the Son.

title: II John 1:10
text: ¶If any one come to you and bring not this doctrine, do not receive him into [the] house, and greet him not;

title: II John 1:11
text: for he who greets him partakes in his wicked works.

title: II John 1:12
text: ¶Having many things to write to you, I would not with paper and ink; but hope to come to you, and to speak mouth to mouth, that our joy may be full.

title: II John 1:13
text: The children of thine elect sister greet thee.

title: III John 1:1
text: ¶The elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.

title: III John 1:2
text: Beloved, I desire that in all things thou shouldest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospers.

title: III John 1:3
text: ¶For I rejoiced exceedingly when [the] brethren came and bore testimony to thy [holding fast the] truth, even as *thou* walkest in truth.

title: III John 1:4
text: I have no greater joy than these things that I hear of my children walking in the truth.

title: III John 1:5
text: Beloved, thou doest faithfully [in] whatever thou mayest have wrought towards the brethren and that strangers,

title: III John 1:6
text: (who have witnessed of thy love before [the] assembly,) in setting forward whom on their journey worthily of God, thou wilt do well;

title: III John 1:7
text: for for the name have they gone forth, taking nothing of those of the nations.

title: III John 1:8
text: *We* therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow-workers with the truth.

title: III John 1:9
text: ¶I wrote something to the assembly; but Diotrephes, who loves to have the first place among them, receives us not.

title: III John 1:10
text: For this reason, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he does, babbling against us with wicked words; and not content with these, neither does he himself receive the brethren; and those who would he prevents, and casts [them] out of the assembly.

title: III John 1:11
text: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. He that does good is of God. He that does evil has not seen God.

title: III John 1:12
text: ¶Demetrius has witness borne to him by all, and by the truth itself; and *we* also bear witness, and thou knowest that our witness is true.

title: III John 1:13
text: I had many things to write to thee, but I will not with ink and pen write to thee;

title: III John 1:14
text: but I hope soon to see thee, and we will speak mouth to mouth. Peace [be] to thee. The friends greet thee. Greet the friends by name.

title: Jude 1:1
text: ¶Jude, bondman of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to the called ones beloved in God [the] Father and preserved in Jesus Christ:

title: Jude 1:2
text: Mercy to you, and peace, and love be multiplied.

title: Jude 1:3
text: ¶Beloved, using all diligence to write to you of our common salvation, I have been obliged to write to you exhorting [you] to contend earnestly for the faith once delivered to the saints.

title: Jude 1:4
text: For certain men have got in unnoticed, they who of old were marked out beforehand to this sentence, ungodly [persons], turning the grace of our God into dissoluteness, and denying our only Master and Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Jude 1:5
text: But I would put you in remembrance, you who once knew all things, that the Lord, having saved a people out of [the] land of Egypt, in the second place destroyed those who had not believed.

title: Jude 1:6
text: And angels who had not kept their own original state, but had abandoned their own dwelling, he keeps in eternal chains under gloomy darkness, to [the] judgment of [the] great day;

title: Jude 1:7
text: as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities around them, committing greedily fornication, in like manner with them, and going after other flesh, lie there as an example, undergoing the judgment of eternal fire.

title: Jude 1:8
text: ¶Yet in like manner these dreamers also defile [the] flesh, and despise lordship, and speak railingly against dignities.

title: Jude 1:9
text: But Michael the archangel, when disputing with the devil he reasoned about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring a railing judgment against [him], but said, [The] Lord rebuke thee.

title: Jude 1:10
text: But these, whatever things they know not, they speak railingly against; but what even, as the irrational animals, they understand by mere nature, in these things they corrupt themselves.

title: Jude 1:11
text: Woe to them! because they have gone in the way of Cain, and given themselves up to the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

title: Jude 1:12
text: These are spots in your love-feasts, feasting together [with you] without fear, pasturing themselves; clouds without water, carried along by [the] winds; autumnal trees, without fruit, twice dead, rooted up;

title: Jude 1:13
text: raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shames; wandering stars, to whom has been reserved the gloom of darkness for eternity.

title: Jude 1:14
text: And Enoch, [the] seventh from Adam, prophesied also as to these, saying, Behold, [the] Lord has come amidst his holy myriads,

title: Jude 1:15
text: ¶to execute judgment against all; and to convict all the ungodly of them of all their works of ungodliness, which they have wrought ungodlily, and of all the hard [things] which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

title: Jude 1:16
text: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts; and their mouth speaks swelling words, admiring persons for the sake of profit.

title: Jude 1:17
text: But *ye*, beloved, remember the words spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Jude 1:18
text: that they said to you, that at [the] end of the time there should be mockers, walking after their own lusts of ungodlinesses.

title: Jude 1:19
text: These are they who set [themselves] apart, natural [men], not having [the] Spirit.

title: Jude 1:20
text: But *ye*, beloved, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

title: Jude 1:21
text: keep yourselves in the love of God, awaiting the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

title: Jude 1:22
text: And of some have compassion, making a difference,

title: Jude 1:23
text: but others save with fear, snatching [them] out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

title: Jude 1:24
text: But to him that is able to keep you without stumbling, and to set [you] with exultation blameless before his glory,

title: Jude 1:25
text: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, [be] glory, majesty, might, and authority, from before the whole age, and now, and to all the ages. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:1
text: ¶Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him, to shew to his bondmen what must shortly take place; and he signified [it], sending by his angel, to his bondman John,

title: Revelation of John 1:2
text: who testified the word of God, and the testimony of Jesus Christ, all things that he saw.

title: Revelation of John 1:3
text: ¶Blessed [is] he that reads, and they that hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things written in it; for the time [is] near.

title: Revelation of John 1:4
text: John to the seven assemblies which [are] in Asia: Grace to you and peace from [him] who is, and who was, and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits which [are] before his throne;

title: Revelation of John 1:5
text: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and has washed us from our sins in his blood,

title: Revelation of John 1:6
text: and made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father: to him [be] the glory and the might to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:7
text: Behold, he comes with the clouds, and every eye shall see him, and they which have pierced him, and all the tribes of the land shall wail because of him. Yea. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:8
text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith [the] Lord God, he who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 1:9
text: ¶I John, your brother and fellow-partaker in the tribulation and kingdom and patience, in Jesus, was in the island called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 1:10
text: I became in [the] Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a great voice as of a trumpet,

title: Revelation of John 1:11
text: saying, What thou seest write in a book, and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, and to Smyrna, and to Pergamos, and to Thyatira, and to Sardis, and to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.

title: Revelation of John 1:12
text: And I turned back to see the voice which spoke with me; and having turned, I saw seven golden lamps,

title: Revelation of John 1:13
text: and in the midst of the [seven] lamps [one] like [the] Son of man, clothed with a garment reaching to the feet, and girt about at the breasts with a golden girdle:

title: Revelation of John 1:14
text: his head and hair white like white wool, as snow; and his eyes as a flame of fire;

title: Revelation of John 1:15
text: and his feet like fine brass, as burning in a furnace; and his voice as the voice of many waters;

title: Revelation of John 1:16
text: and having in his right hand seven stars; and out of his mouth a sharp two-edged sword going forth; and his countenance as the sun shines in its power.

title: Revelation of John 1:17
text: And when I saw him I fell at his feet as dead; and he laid his right hand upon me, saying, Fear not; *I* am the first and the last,

title: Revelation of John 1:18
text: and the living one: and I became dead, and behold, I am living to the ages of ages, and have the keys of death and of hades.

title: Revelation of John 1:19
text: Write therefore what thou hast seen, and the things that are, and the things that are about to be after these.

title: Revelation of John 1:20
text: The mystery of the seven stars which thou hast seen on my right hand, and the seven golden lamps. --The seven stars are angels of the seven assemblies; and the seven lamps are seven assemblies.

title: Revelation of John 2:1
text: ¶To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: These things says he that holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lamps:

title: Revelation of John 2:2
text: I know thy works and [thy] labour, and thine endurance, and that thou canst not bear evil [men]; and thou hast tried them who say that themselves [are] apostles and are not, and hast found them liars;

title: Revelation of John 2:3
text: and endurest, and hast borne for my name's sake, and hast not wearied:

title: Revelation of John 2:4
text: but I have against thee, that thou hast left thy first love.

title: Revelation of John 2:5
text: Remember therefore whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works: but if not, I am coming to thee, and I will remove thy lamp out of its place, except thou shalt repent.

title: Revelation of John 2:6
text: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitanes, which *I* also hate.

title: Revelation of John 2:7
text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him that overcomes, I will give to him to eat of the tree of life which is in the paradise of God.

title: Revelation of John 2:8
text: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: These things says the first and the last, who became dead, and lived:

title: Revelation of John 2:9
text: I know thy tribulation and thy poverty; but thou art rich; and the railing of those who say that they themselves are Jews, and are not, but a synagogue of Satan.

title: Revelation of John 2:10
text: Fear nothing [of] what thou art about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to cast of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give to thee the crown of life.

title: Revelation of John 2:11
text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He that overcomes shall in no wise be injured of the second death.

title: Revelation of John 2:12
text: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Pergamos write: These things says he that has the sharp two-edged sword:

title: Revelation of John 2:13
text: I know where thou dwellest, where the throne of Satan [is]; and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in the days in which Antipas my faithful witness [was], who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.

title: Revelation of John 2:14
text: But I have a few things against thee: that thou hast there those who hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a snare before the sons of Israel, to eat [of] idol sacrifices and commit fornication.

title: Revelation of John 2:15
text: So thou also hast those who hold the doctrine of Nicolaitanes in like manner.

title: Revelation of John 2:16
text: Repent therefore: but if not, I come to thee quickly, and I will make war with them with the sword of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 2:17
text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him that overcomes, to him will I give of the hidden manna; and I will give to him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows but he that receives [it].

title: Revelation of John 2:18
text: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: These things says the Son of God, he that has his eyes as a flame of fire, and his feet [are] like fine brass:

title: Revelation of John 2:19
text: I know thy works, and love, and faith, and service, and thine endurance, and thy last works [to be] more than the first.

title: Revelation of John 2:20
text: But I have against thee that thou permittest the woman Jezebel, she who calls herself prophetess, and she teaches and leads astray my servants to commit fornication and eat of idol sacrifices.

title: Revelation of John 2:21
text: And I gave her time that she should repent, and she will not repent of her fornication.

title: Revelation of John 2:22
text: Behold, I cast her into a bed, and those that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of her works,

title: Revelation of John 2:23
text: and her children will I kill with death; and all the assemblies shall know that *I* am he that searches [the] reins and [the] hearts; and I will give to you each according to your works.

title: Revelation of John 2:24
text: But to you I say, the rest who [are] in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, who have not known the depths of Satan, as they say, I do not cast upon you any other burden;

title: Revelation of John 2:25
text: but what ye have hold fast till I shall come.

title: Revelation of John 2:26
text: And he that overcomes, and he that keeps unto the end my works, to him will I give authority over the nations,

title: Revelation of John 2:27
text: and he shall shepherd them with an iron rod; as vessels of pottery are they broken in pieces, as I also have received from my Father;

title: Revelation of John 2:28
text: and I will give to him the morning star.

title: Revelation of John 2:29
text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

title: Revelation of John 3:1
text: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: These things saith he that has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars: I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

title: Revelation of John 3:2
text: Be watchful, and strengthen the things that remain, which are about to die, for I have not found thy works complete before my God.

title: Revelation of John 3:3
text: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and keep [it] and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come [upon thee] as a thief, and thou shalt not know at what hour I shall come upon thee.

title: Revelation of John 3:4
text: But thou hast a few names in Sardis which have not defiled their garments, and they shall walk with me in white, because they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 3:5
text: He that overcomes, *he* shall be clothed in white garments, and I will not blot his name out of the book of life, and will confess his name before my Father and before his angels.

title: Revelation of John 3:6
text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

title: Revelation of John 3:7
text: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: These things saith the holy, the true; he that has the key of David, he who opens and no one shall shut, and shuts and no one shall open:

title: Revelation of John 3:8
text: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an opened door, which no one can shut, because thou hast a little power, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

title: Revelation of John 3:9
text: Behold, I make them of the synagogue of Satan who say that they are Jews, and are not, but lie; behold, I will cause that they shall come and shall do homage before thy feet, and shall know that *I* have loved thee.

title: Revelation of John 3:10
text: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, *I* also will keep thee out of the hour of trial, which is about to come upon the whole habitable world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 3:11
text: I come quickly: hold fast what thou hast, that no one take thy crown.

title: Revelation of John 3:12
text: He that overcomes, him will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more at all out; and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven, from my God, and my new name.

title: Revelation of John 3:13
text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

title: Revelation of John 3:14
text: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God:

title: Revelation of John 3:15
text: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot; I would thou wert cold or hot.

title: Revelation of John 3:16
text: Thus because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I am about to spue thee out of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 3:17
text: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and am grown rich, and have need of nothing, and knowest not that *thou* art the wretched and the miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked;

title: Revelation of John 3:18
text: I counsel thee to buy of me gold purified by fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white garments, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness may not be made manifest; and eye-salve to anoint thine eyes, that thou mayest see.

title: Revelation of John 3:19
text: I rebuke and discipline as many as I love; be zealous therefore and repent.

title: Revelation of John 3:20
text: Behold, I stand at the door and am knocking; if any one hear my voice and open the door, I will come in unto him and sup with him, and he with me.

title: Revelation of John 3:21
text: He that overcomes, to him will I give to sit with me in my throne; as *I* also have overcome, and have sat down with my Father in his throne.

title: Revelation of John 3:22
text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

title: Revelation of John 4:1
text: ¶After these things I saw, and behold, a door opened in heaven, and the first voice which I heard as of a trumpet speaking with me, saying, Come up here, and I will shew thee the things which must take place after these things.

title: Revelation of John 4:2
text: Immediately I became in [the] Spirit; and behold, a throne stood in the heaven, and upon the throne one sitting,

title: Revelation of John 4:3
text: and he [that was] sitting like in appearance to a stone [of] jasper and a sardius, and a rainbow round the throne like in appearance to an emerald.

title: Revelation of John 4:4
text: And round the throne twenty-four thrones, and on the thrones twenty-four elders sitting, clothed with white garments; and on their heads golden crowns.

title: Revelation of John 4:5
text: And out of the throne go forth lightnings, and voices, and thunders; and seven lamps of fire, burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God;

title: Revelation of John 4:6
text: and before the throne, as a glass sea, like crystal. And in the midst of the throne, and around the throne, four living creatures, full of eyes, before and behind;

title: Revelation of John 4:7
text: and the first living creature like a lion, and the second living creature like a calf, and the third living creature having the face as of a man, and the fourth living creature like a flying eagle.

title: Revelation of John 4:8
text: ¶And the four living creatures, each one of them having respectively six wings; round and within they are full of eyes; and they cease not day and night saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, who was, and who is, and who is to come.

title: Revelation of John 4:9
text: And when the living creatures shall give glory and honour and thanksgiving to him that sits upon the throne, who lives to the ages of ages,

title: Revelation of John 4:10
text: the twenty-four elders shall fall before him that sits upon the throne, and do homage to him that lives to the ages of ages; and shall cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

title: Revelation of John 4:11
text: Thou art worthy, O our Lord and [our] God, to receive glory and honour and power; for *thou* hast created all things, and for thy will they were, and they have been created.

title: Revelation of John 5:1
text: ¶And I saw on the right hand of him that sat upon the throne a book, written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals.

title: Revelation of John 5:2
text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who [is] worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?

title: Revelation of John 5:3
text: And no one was able in the heaven, or upon the earth, or underneath the earth, to open the book, or to regard it.

title: Revelation of John 5:4
text: And *I* wept much because no one had been found worthy to open the book nor to regard it.

title: Revelation of John 5:5
text: And one of the elders says to me, Do not weep. Behold, the lion which [is] of the tribe of Juda, the root of David, has overcome [so as] to open the book, and its seven seals.

title: Revelation of John 5:6
text: ¶And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God [which are] sent into all the earth:

title: Revelation of John 5:7
text: and it came and took [it] out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

title: Revelation of John 5:8
text: And when it took the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, having each a harp and golden bowls full of incenses, which are the prayers of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 5:9
text: And they sing a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open its seals; because thou hast been slain, and hast redeemed to God, by thy blood, out of every tribe, and tongue, and people, and nation,

title: Revelation of John 5:10
text: and made them to our God kings and priests; and they shall reign over the earth.

title: Revelation of John 5:11
text: And I saw, and I heard [the] voice of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and their number was ten thousands of ten thousands and thousands of thousands;

title: Revelation of John 5:12
text: saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that has been slain, to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

title: Revelation of John 5:13
text: And every creature which is in the heaven and upon the earth and under the earth, and [those that are] upon the sea, and all things in them, heard I saying, To him that sits upon the throne, and to the Lamb, blessing, and honour, and glory, and might, to the ages of ages.

title: Revelation of John 5:14
text: And the four living creatures said, Amen; and the elders fell down and did homage.

title: Revelation of John 6:1
text: ¶And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as a voice of thunder, Come [and see].

title: Revelation of John 6:2
text: And I saw: and behold, a white horse, and he that sat upon it having a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went forth conquering and that he might conquer.

title: Revelation of John 6:3
text: ¶And when it opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come [and see].

title: Revelation of John 6:4
text: And another, a red horse, went forth; and to him that sat upon it, to him it was given to take peace from the earth, and that they should slay one another; and there was given to him a great sword.

title: Revelation of John 6:5
text: And when it opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come [and see]. And I saw: and behold, a black horse, and he that sat upon it having a balance in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 6:6
text: And I heard as a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenixes of barley for a denarius: and do not injure the oil and the wine.

title: Revelation of John 6:7
text: And when it opened the fourth seal, I heard [the voice of] the fourth living creature saying, Come [and see].

title: Revelation of John 6:8
text: And I saw: and behold, a pale horse, and he that sat upon it, his name [was] Death, and hades followed with him; and authority was given to him over the fourth of the earth to slay with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and by the beasts of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 6:9
text: ¶And when it opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of them that had been slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held;

title: Revelation of John 6:10
text: and they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O sovereign Ruler, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell upon the earth?

title: Revelation of John 6:11
text: And there was given to them, to each one a white robe; and it was said to them that they should rest yet a little while, until both their fellow-bondmen and their brethren, who were about to be killed as they, should be fulfilled.

title: Revelation of John 6:12
text: And I saw when it opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as hair sackcloth, and the whole moon became as blood,

title: Revelation of John 6:13
text: and the stars of heaven fell upon the earth, as a fig tree, shaken by a great wind, casts its unseasonable figs.

title: Revelation of John 6:14
text: And the heaven was removed as a book rolled up, and every mountain and island were removed out of their places.

title: Revelation of John 6:15
text: And the kings of the earth, and the great, and the chiliarchs, and the rich, and the strong, and every bondman and freeman, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains;

title: Revelation of John 6:16
text: and they say to the mountains and to the rocks, Fall on us, and have us hidden from [the] face of him that sits upon the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb;

title: Revelation of John 6:17
text: because the great day of his wrath is come, and who is able to stand?

title: Revelation of John 7:1
text: ¶And after this I saw four angels standing upon the four corners of the earth, holding fast the four winds of the earth, that no wind might blow upon the earth, nor upon the sea, nor upon any tree.

title: Revelation of John 7:2
text: And I saw another angel ascending from [the] sunrising, having [the] seal of [the] living God; and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it had been given to hurt the earth and the sea,

title: Revelation of John 7:3
text: saying, Hurt not the earth, nor the sea, nor the trees, until we shall have sealed the bondmen of our God upon their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 7:4
text: And I heard the number of the sealed, a hundred [and] forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of [the] sons of Israel:

title: Revelation of John 7:5
text: out of [the] tribe of Juda, twelve thousand sealed; out of [the] tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; out of [the] tribe of Gad, twelve thousand;

title: Revelation of John 7:6
text: out of [the] tribe of Aser, twelve thousand; out of [the] tribe of Nepthalim, twelve thousand; out of [the] tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand;

title: Revelation of John 7:7
text: out of [the] tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; out of [the] tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; out of [the] tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand;

title: Revelation of John 7:8
text: out of [the] tribe of Zabulun, twelve thousand; out of [the] tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand; out of [the] tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand sealed.

title: Revelation of John 7:9
text: After these things I saw, and lo, a great crowd, which no one could number, out of every nation and tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palm branches in their hands.

title: Revelation of John 7:10
text: And they cry with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God who sits upon the throne, and to the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:11
text: And all the angels stood around the throne, and the elders, and the four living creatures, and fell before the throne upon their faces, and worshipped God,

title: Revelation of John 7:12
text: saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and strength, to our God, to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 7:13
text: ¶And one of the elders answered, saying to me, These who are clothed with white robes, who are they, and whence came they?

title: Revelation of John 7:14
text: And I said to him, My lord, *thou* knowest. And he said to me, These are they who come out of the great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and have made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:15
text: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple, and he that sits upon the throne shall spread his tabernacle over them.

title: Revelation of John 7:16
text: They shall not hunger any more, neither shall they thirst any more, nor shall the sun at all fall on them, nor any burning heat;

title: Revelation of John 7:17
text: because the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall shepherd them, and shall lead them to fountains of waters of life, and God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes.

title: Revelation of John 8:1
text: ¶And when it opened the seventh seal, there was silence in the heaven about half an hour.

title: Revelation of John 8:2
text: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

title: Revelation of John 8:3
text: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and much incense was given to him, that he might give [efficacy] to the prayers of all saints at the golden altar which [was] before the throne.

title: Revelation of John 8:4
text: And the smoke of the incense went up with the prayers of the saints, out of the hand of the angel before God.

title: Revelation of John 8:5
text: And the angel took the censer, and filled it from the fire of the altar, and cast [it] on the earth: and there were voices, and thunders and lightnings, and an earthquake.

title: Revelation of John 8:6
text: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves that they might sound with [their] trumpets.

title: Revelation of John 8:7
text: ¶And the first sounded [his] trumpet: and there was hail and fire, mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth; and the third part of the earth was burnt up, and the third part of the trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

title: Revelation of John 8:8
text: And the second angel sounded [his] trumpet: and as a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea, and the third part of the sea became blood;

title: Revelation of John 8:9
text: and the third part of the creatures which were in the sea which had life died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

title: Revelation of John 8:10
text: And the third angel sounded [his] trumpet: and there fell out of the heaven a great star, burning as a torch, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters.

title: Revelation of John 8:11
text: And the name of the star is called Wormwood; and the third part of the waters became wormwood, and many of the men died of the waters because they were made bitter.

title: Revelation of John 8:12
text: And the fourth angel sounded [his] trumpet: and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so that the third part of them should be darkened, and that the day should not appear [for] the third part of it, and the night the same.

title: Revelation of John 8:13
text: And I saw, and I heard an eagle flying in mid-heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to them that dwell upon the earth, for the remaining voices of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound.

title: Revelation of John 9:1
text: ¶And the fifth angel sounded [his] trumpet: and I saw a star out of the heaven fallen to the earth; and there was given to it the key of the pit of the abyss.

title: Revelation of John 9:2
text: And it opened the pit of the abyss; and there went up smoke out of the pit as [the] smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened with the smoke of the pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:3
text: And out of the smoke came forth locusts on the earth, and power was given to them as the scorpions of the earth have power;

title: Revelation of John 9:4
text: and it was said to them, that they should not injure the grass of the earth, nor any green thing, nor any tree, but the men who have not the seal of God on their foreheads:

title: Revelation of John 9:5
text: and it was given to them that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months; and their torment [was] as [the] torment of a scorpion when it strikes a man.

title: Revelation of John 9:6
text: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall in no way find it; and shall desire to die, and death flees from them.

title: Revelation of John 9:7
text: And the likenesses of the locusts [were] like to horses prepared for war; and upon their heads as crowns like gold, and their faces as faces of men;

title: Revelation of John 9:8
text: and they had hair as women's hair, and their teeth were as of lions,

title: Revelation of John 9:9
text: and they had breastplates as breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings [was] as the sound of chariots of many horses running to war;

title: Revelation of John 9:10
text: and they have tails like scorpions, and stings; and their power [was] in their tails to hurt men five months.

title: Revelation of John 9:11
text: They have a king over them, the angel of the abyss: his name in Hebrew, Abaddon, and in Greek he has [for] name Apollyon.

title: Revelation of John 9:12
text: The first woe has passed. Behold, there come yet two woes after these things.

title: Revelation of John 9:13
text: ¶And the sixth angel sounded [his] trumpet: and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which [is] before God,

title: Revelation of John 9:14
text: saying to the sixth angel that had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound at the great river Euphrates.

title: Revelation of John 9:15
text: And the four angels were loosed, who are prepared for the hour and day and month and year, that they might slay the third part of men;

title: Revelation of John 9:16
text: and the number of the hosts of horse [was] twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.

title: Revelation of John 9:17
text: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those that sat upon them, having breastplates of fire and jacinth and brimstone; and the heads of the horses [were] as heads of lions, and out of their mouths goes out fire and smoke and brimstone.

title: Revelation of John 9:18
text: By these three plagues were the third part of men killed, by the fire and the smoke and the brimstone which goes out of their mouths.

title: Revelation of John 9:19
text: For the power of the horses is in their mouth and in their tails: for their tails [are] like serpents, having heads, and with them they injure.

title: Revelation of John 9:20
text: And the rest of men who were not killed with these plagues repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and the golden and silver and brazen and stone and wooden idols, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.

title: Revelation of John 9:21
text: And they repented not of their murders, nor of their witchcrafts, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

title: Revelation of John 10:1
text: ¶And I saw another strong angel coming down out of the heaven, clothed with a cloud, and the rainbow upon his head, and his countenance as the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire,

title: Revelation of John 10:2
text: and having in his hand a little opened book. And he set his right foot on the sea, and the left upon the earth,

title: Revelation of John 10:3
text: and cried with a loud voice as a lion roars. And when he cried, the seven thunders uttered their own voices.

title: Revelation of John 10:4
text: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write: and I heard a voice out of the heaven saying, Seal the things which the seven thunders have spoken, and write them not.

title: Revelation of John 10:5
text: And the angel whom I saw stand on the sea and on the earth lifted up his right hand to the heaven,

title: Revelation of John 10:6
text: and swore by him that lives to the ages of ages, who created the heaven and the things that are in it, and the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there should be no longer delay;

title: Revelation of John 10:7
text: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound the trumpet, the mystery of God also shall be completed, as he has made known the glad tidings to his own bondmen the prophets.

title: Revelation of John 10:8
text: ¶And the voice which I heard out of the heaven [was] again speaking with me, and saying, Go, take the little book which is opened in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 10:9
text: And I went to the angel, saying to him to give me the little book. And he says to me, Take and eat it up: and it shall make thy belly bitter, but in thy mouth it shall be sweet as honey.

title: Revelation of John 10:10
text: And I took the little book out of the hand of the angel, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth as honey, sweet; and when I had eaten it my belly was made bitter.

title: Revelation of John 10:11
text: And it was said to me, Thou must prophesy again as to peoples and nations and tongues and many kings.

title: Revelation of John 11:1
text: ¶And there was given to me a reed like a staff, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship in it.

title: Revelation of John 11:2
text: And the court which [is] without the temple cast out, and measure it not; because it has been given [up] to the nations, and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty-two months.

title: Revelation of John 11:3
text: ¶And I will give [power] to my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred [and] sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.

title: Revelation of John 11:4
text: These are the two olive trees and the two lamps which stand before the Lord of the earth;

title: Revelation of John 11:5
text: and if any one wills to injure them, fire goes out of their mouth, and devours their enemies. And if any one wills to injure them, thus must he be killed.

title: Revelation of John 11:6
text: These have power to shut the heaven that no rain may fall during the days of their prophecy; and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to smite the earth as often as they will with every plague.

title: Revelation of John 11:7
text: And when they shall have completed their testimony, the beast who comes up out of the abyss shall make war with them, and shall conquer them, and shall kill them:

title: Revelation of John 11:8
text: and their body [shall be] on the street of the great city, which is called spiritually Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

title: Revelation of John 11:9
text: And [men] of the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations see their body three days and a half, and they do not suffer their bodies to be put into a sepulchre.

title: Revelation of John 11:10
text: And they that dwell upon the earth rejoice over them, and are full of delight, and shall send gifts one to another, because these, the two prophets, tormented them that dwell upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:11
text: And after the three days and a half [the] spirit of life from God came into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon those beholding them.

title: Revelation of John 11:12
text: And I heard a great voice out of the heaven saying to them, Come up here; and they went up to the heaven in the cloud, and their enemies beheld them.

title: Revelation of John 11:13
text: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand names of men were slain in the earthquake. And the remnant were filled with fear, and gave glory to the God of the heaven.

title: Revelation of John 11:14
text: ¶The second woe has passed; behold, the third woe comes quickly.

title: Revelation of John 11:15
text: And the seventh angel sounded [his] trumpet: and there were great voices in the heaven, saying, The kingdom of the world of our Lord and of his Christ is come, and he shall reign to the ages of ages.

title: Revelation of John 11:16
text: And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

title: Revelation of John 11:17
text: saying, We give thee thanks, Lord God Almighty, [He] who is, and who was, that thou hast taken thy great power and hast reigned.

title: Revelation of John 11:18
text: And the nations have been full of wrath, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead to be judged, and to give the recompense to thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and to those who fear thy name, small and great; and to destroy those that destroy the earth.
